Désignation des marchandises

Roche favorise la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion, représentant les communautés que nous servons. Lorsqu'on traite de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, la diversité est un élément essentiel au succès. Nous croyons que l'inclusion est la clé pour comprendre les besoins variés des gens en matière de soins de santé.

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et faire en sorte que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Le service Audit et Conformité fournit des services aux affiliés de la région de l'EMEA. Nos principaux domaines couverts sont: Conformité financière, Autorisation SAP, Conformité Voyage et Dépenses.

Nous vous recherchons pour rejoindre notre TALENT POOL au Centre de Services et Solutions Roche à Budapest!

Votre opportunité

En tant qu'analyste de la conformité aux frais et aux frais, vous serez responsable de travailler avec les services financiers, de vérification, de conformité et d'autres départements des affiliés sélectionnés de Roche.

- Vérification des demandes de remboursement des frais de T&E du point de vue de la TVA - Gestion de l'intégration entre Concur et SAP - Appui à la préparation des rapports et du matériel de formation, au besoin, périodiquement pour traiter des mises à jour du processus de surveillance de la conformité - Collaboration avec l'équipe pour déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer les documents de conformité (p. ex. manuels d'examen, codage des motifs de renvoi, etc.) - Prise en charge de l'évaluation de la conformité des demandes de remboursement des dépenses des employés en temps opportun et avec exactitude, en regard des politiques, procédures et exigences réglementaires externes de la compagnie.

- Participer aux programmes, projets et autres tâches ad hoc assignés par le superviseur/le HOD.

Qui vous êtes

Nous recherchons une personne qui est motivée par son propre sens, passionnée par son travail et qui comprend que la prestation d'un service de qualité est cruciale pour l'organisation. En tant que membre idéal de l'équipe, vous êtes ouvert d'esprit, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert au développement constant.

- Au moins 1 an d'expérience dans un poste pertinent dans le domaine des finances/de l'amortissement - Baccalauréat en comptabilité, finances ou affaires - Bonnes compétences en administration et communication - Engagement élevé pour maintenir/améliorer les niveaux de service - Esprit ouvert et orientation client - Compétence en anglais et en hébreu

Désireux

- Connaissance des principes financiers et comptables - Expérience dans le système SAP / Concur system

Nous vous aidons à trouver votre équilibre : le bureau à domicile est une pratique courante (1 jour/semaine de bureau en moyenne et nous fournissons des conditions de travail totalement éloignées en Hongrie). Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. Notre leadership est très concentré sur les gens, créant une culture forte et inclusive, vous avez donc toujours la chance de partager votre opinion.

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your Opportunity
As a Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates. In this position you will focus on:

• Verifying T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handling integration between Concur and SAP

• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Taking responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participating in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and customer focus

• Proficiency in English and Arabic

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (1 office day/week on average, and we provide fully remote working conditions within Hungary). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

*Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni su Roche

Roche promuove la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione, rappresentando le comunità che serviamo. Quando si tratta di assistenza sanitaria su scala globale, la diversità è un ingrediente essenziale per il successo. Crediamo che l'inclusione sia fondamentale per comprendere le diverse esigenze sanitarie delle persone. Insieme, abbracciamo l'individualità e condividiamo la passione per l'assistenza eccezionale. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

Un futuro più sano. E' ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Avanzerà continuamente la scienza e garantirà a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria di cui hanno bisogno oggi e alle generazioni future. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.

E' questo che ci rende Roche.

La posizione

Stiamo cercando di VOI per partecipare alla nostra PISCINA TALENT presso il nostro centro di servizi e soluzioni Roche a Budapest!

Il dipartimento Audit e Compliance fornisce servizi per gli affiliati nella regione EMEA. I nostri principali settori coperti sono: Conformità finanziaria, Autorizzazione SAP, Viaggi e Conformità Expense.

La tua opportunità

Come Analista di Compliance di Viaggio ed Esperienze sarete responsabili per lavorare con la finanza, audit, conformità e altri dipartimenti di affiliati selezionati Roche. In questa posizione vi concentrerete su:

- Verificare i crediti di spesa T&E dal punto di vista IVA - Gestione dell'integrazione tra Concur e SAP - Supporto della preparazione di report e materiale di formazione, ove richiesto periodicamente per indirizzare gli aggiornamenti al processo di monitoraggio della conformità - Lavorare in collaborazione con il team per individuare opportunità di migliorare la documentazione sulla conformità (ad esempio.

revisione manuale, codice del motivo di ritorno ecc.) - Prendersi la responsabilità di valutare la conformità dei crediti di spesa dei dipendenti in modo tempestivo e accurato, contro le Politiche, le Procedure e i requisiti normativi esterni della Società - Partecipare a programmi di conformità, progetti e altri compiti ad hoc assegnati da supervisore/HOD

Chi sei

Siamo alla ricerca di qualcuno che si auto-Yoannichi, davvero appassionato del suo lavoro e che capisce che fornire un servizio di alta qualità è fondamentale per l'organizzazione. Come membro ideale del team siete di mentalità aperta, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, avete:

- Almeno 1 anno di esperienza in una posizione rilevante nel campo della finanza/A

Desiderabile

- Conoscenza dei principi finanziari e contabili - Esperienza nel sistema SAP / Concur

Cosa offriamo

- Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Offriamo opportunità di sviluppo costanti, corsi di lingua e formazione gratuiti, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera. - Ottimi benefici e flessibilità: stipendio competitivo e pacchetto cafeteria, indennità di lingua (se la posizione richiede una lingua supplementare), bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare Sportpass, coaching / opportunità di mentoring, buddy programma, team building, festa di vacanza.

Garantiamo anche flessibilità per aiutarvi a trovare il vostro equilibrio: l'home office è una pratica comune (1 giorno di ufficio/settimana in media, e forniamo condizioni di lavoro completamente remote in Ungheria). Creiamo l'opportunità di libertà nel lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesiste in armonia. - Una comunità globale diversificata, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, discutiamo, prendiamo decisioni, celebrano i successi e divertiamoci come un team. La nostra leadership è molto concentrata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi avete sempre la possibilità di condividere la vostra opinione.

*Si prega di notare che questo è un disordine per scopi di costruzione di piscina di ipoteca, il che significa che non può necessariamente riflettere un'apertura corrente con in corso

• Proficiency in English and Spanish

• Requisiti Desiderabili - Connaissance des principes financiers et comptables - Expérience dans le système SAP / Concur En échange, nous vous fournissons : - Des opportunités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage.

Nous assurons également la flexibilité, pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre: le bureau à domicile est une pratique courante (1 jour/semaine de bureau en moyenne, et nous fournissons des conditions de travail totalement éloignées en Hongrie). Garantiamo anche flessibilità per aiutarvi a trovare il vostro equilibrio: l'home office è una pratica comune (1 giorno di ufficio/settimana in media, e forniamo condizioni di lavoro completamente remote in Ungheria). Creiamo l'opportunità di libertà nel lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesiste in armonia. - Una comunità globale diversificata, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your Opportunity
As a Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates. In this position you will focus on:

• Verifying T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handling integration between Concur and SAP

• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Taking responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participating in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and customer focus

• Proficiency in English and Italian

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (1 office day/week on average, and we provide fully remote working conditions within Hungary). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Roche

Roche fördert Vielfalt, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion, die die Gemeinschaften repräsentiert, die wir bedienen. Diversität ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des Erfolgs im Bereich der Gesundheitsversorgung. Wir glauben, dass Inklusion der Schlüssel ist, um die unterschiedlichen Bedürfnisse der Menschen im Gesundheitswesen zu verstehen. Gemeinsam setzen wir auf Individualität und teilen die Leidenschaft für außergewöhnliche Pflege.

Die Position

Wir suchen nach Ihnen, um unserem TALENT POOL in unserem Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest beizutreten!

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zu Innovationen. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für die kommenden Generationen braucht.

Das macht uns zu Roche.

Die Abteilung Audit und Compliance bietet Dienstleistungen für die Tochtergesellschaften in der EMEA-Region. Unsere Hauptbereiche sind: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Ihre Gelegenheit

Als Travel and Expense Compliance-Ansager sind Sie für die Arbeit mit der Finanz-, Audit-, Compliance- und anderen Abteilungen ausgewählter Roche-Partner zuständig. In dieser Position werden Sie sich auf folgende Themen konzentrieren:

- Überprüfung der T&E-Aufwendungsansprüche aus der Sicht der Mehrwertsteuer - Handhabung der Integration zwischen Concur und SAP - Unterstützung der Erstellung von Berichten und Schulungsmaterial, wenn es regelmäßig erforderlich ist, Aktualisierungen des Compliance-Monitoring-Prozesses zu adressieren - Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team, um Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Compliance-Dokumentation zu ermitteln (z.B. Überprüfungshandbücher, Codierung der Rückgabegründe usw.) - Verantwortung für die rechtzeitige und genaue Bewertung der Einhaltung der Personalaufwandsansprüche gegenüber den Richtlinien, Verfahren und externen regulatorischen Anforderungen des Unternehmens.

- Teilnahme an Compliance-Programmen, Projekten und anderen Ad-hoc-Aufgaben, die von Supervisor/HOD zugewiesen werden.

Wer du bist

Wir suchen jemanden, der sich selbst bewegt, seine Arbeit wirklich leidenschaftlich mitbringt und versteht, dass die Bereitstellung eines hochwertigen Service für die Organisation entscheidend ist. Als ideales Teammitglied sind Sie aufgeschlossen, engagiert, um etwas zu bewirken und offen für ständige Weiterentwicklung. Außerdem haben Sie:

- Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung in einer relevanten Position im Bereich Finanzen/Berichterstattung - Bachelor in Buchhaltung, Finanzen oder Business-bezogenen Bereich - Gute Verwaltungs- und Kommunikationskompetenz - Hohes Engagement für die Aufrechterhaltung / Verbesserung der Service-Levels - Offene Einstellung und Kundenorientierung - Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch und Italienisch

Wünschenswert:

- Kenntnis der Finanz- und Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze - Erfahrung in SAP / Concur system

Was wir anbieten

- Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen. Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Schulungen, die Möglichkeit internationaler Einsätze, interne Positionsänderungen und die Möglichkeit, Ihre eigene Karriere zu gestalten. - Ausgezeichnete Vorteile & Flexibilität: wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Cafeteria-Paket, Sprachzulage (wenn die Position erfordert zusätzliche Sprache), Jahresbonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, Coaching / Mentoring-Möglichkeit, Buddy-Programm, Team-Gebäude, Urlaub Partei.

Wir sorgen auch für Flexibilität, um Ihnen dabei zu helfen, Ihr Gleichgewicht zu finden: Home Office ist eine gängige Praxis (1 Bürotag/Woche im Durchschnitt, und wir bieten Ihnen in Ungarn völlig abgelegene Arbeitsbedingungen). Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit für freies Arbeiten, wo Ihr unternehmerisches und privates Leben in Harmonie zusammenlebt. - Eine globale, vielfältige Gemeinschaft, in der wir voneinander lernen. Bei Roche kooperieren, diskutieren, entscheiden, feiern Erfolge und haben Spaß als Team. Unsere Führung konzentriert sich sehr auf Menschen, die eine starke, inklusive Kultur schaffen, sodass Sie immer die Chance haben, Ihre Meinung zu teilen.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass dies eine Requisition für Talent Pool-Gebäude ist, was bedeutet, dass es nicht unbedingt eine aktuelle Eröffnung mit laufenden
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Roche

Roche favorise la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion, représentant les communautés que nous servons. Lorsqu'on traite de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, la diversité est un élément essentiel au succès. Nous croyons que l'inclusion est la clé pour comprendre les besoins variés des gens en matière de soins de santé.

La position

Nous vous recherchons pour rejoindre notre TALENT POOL au Centre de Services et Solutions Roche à Budapest!

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et faire en sorte que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Le service Audit et Conformité fournit des services aux affiliés de la région de l'EMEA. Nos principaux domaines couverts sont: Conformité financière, Autorisation SAP, Conformité Voyage et Dépenses.

Votre opportunité

En tant qu'analyste de la conformité aux frais et aux frais, vous serez responsable de travailler avec les services financiers, de vérification, de conformité et d'autres départements des affiliés sélectionnés de Roche.

- Vérification des demandes de remboursement des frais de T&E du point de vue de la TVA - Gestion de l'intégration entre Concur et SAP - Appui à la préparation des rapports et du matériel de formation, au besoin, périodiquement pour traiter des mises à jour du processus de surveillance de la conformité - Collaboration avec l'équipe pour déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer les documents de conformité (p. ex. manuels d'examen, codage des motifs de renvoi, etc.) - Prise en charge de l'évaluation de la conformité des demandes de remboursement des dépenses des employés en temps opportun et avec exactitude, en regard des politiques, procédures et exigences réglementaires externes de la compagnie.

- Participer aux programmes, projets et autres tâches ad hoc assignés par le superviseur/le HOD.

Qui vous êtes

Nous recherchons une personne qui est motivée par son propre sens, passionnée par son travail et qui comprend que la prestation d'un service de qualité est cruciale pour l'organisation. En tant que membre idéal de l'équipe, vous êtes ouvert d'esprit, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert au développement constant.

- Au moins 1 an d'expérience dans un poste pertinent dans le domaine des finances/de l'amortissement - Baccalauréat en comptabilité, finances ou affaires - Bonnes compétences en administration et communication - Engagement élevé pour maintenir / améliorer les niveaux de service - Esprit ouvert et orientation client - Compétence en anglais et en italien

Désireux :

- Connaissance des principes financiers et comptables - Expérience dans le système SAP / Concur system

Ce que nous offrons

- Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constantes, des cours et des formations linguistiques gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de poste internes et la chance de façonner votre propre carrière. - Excellents avantages et flexibilité : salaire et forfait cafétéria concurrentiels, allocation linguistique (si le poste nécessite une langue supplémentaire), bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, occasion de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, team buildings, fête.

Nous vous aidons à trouver votre équilibre : le bureau à domicile est une pratique courante (1 jour/semaine de bureau en moyenne et nous fournissons des conditions de travail totalement éloignées en Hongrie). Nous créons la possibilité de la liberté de travailler, où votre vie privée et professionnelle coexistent en harmonie. - Une communauté mondiale diversifiée, où nous apprenons les uns des autres. Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. Notre leadership est très concentré sur les gens, créant une culture forte et inclusive, vous avez donc toujours la chance de partager votre opinion.

Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'une demande pour des fins de construction de piscines de talents, ce qui signifie qu'elle ne reflète pas nécessairement une ouverture actuelle avec des activités continues.

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Customer Identity & Access Management Analyst

We focus on the long - term, leading investment in research and development, striving to improve lives today and for generations to come. In Roche Informatics we are a diverse team of open and friendly people, enthusiastic about technological novelties and efficient IT solutions.

The opportunity:

• Participate in all aspect of the implementation of Enterprise CIAM strategies, policies, and procedures, ensuring they align with overall security and risk management objectives

• Assist with the delivery of CIAM projects and programs, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to a high standard of quality

• Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure CIAM solutions are integrated with existing systems and processes.

• Perform security assessments and identify potential improvements.

• Participate in incident response and troubleshooting efforts

• To stay aware of operational challenges and opportunities; works with support teams to provide internal escalation support as needed

• Actively focus on self-development in creating actionable plans to improve.

• Assist in the evaluation of solutions and their feasibility to Customer-Facing Application owners in a variety of environments including backend (PHP, Java, .NET), and client-side (REST, JavaScript) while ensuring procedures, processes and documentation are in compliance with regulatory guidelines and organizational standards,

• Demonstrate business awareness and understand the needs of the Application owners, and any other supporting IT Partner organization.

Who you are:

• 2 years of experience in administering and/or implementing CIAM or IAM solutions

• Experience in integrating with other solutions including APIs

• Someone who wants to influence their own development, demonstrate intellectual curiosity, a self-starter and embrace continuous improvement.

• Are execution-oriented with an agile mindset and looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field

• Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and best practices

• Ability to work independently and manage time effectively

• Excited to help our customers to improve their consumer journeys

What you bring:

• Backend Development skills with at least one server platform such as .NET, Java, PHP.

• Front-end Development skills with at least one server platform such as HTML, CSS, REST, JavaScript and JS Libraries.

• SAP CDC (Gigya) Technical expertise.

• Experience in integration projects involving identity management aspects and web development and customer facing experience.

• Experience with SAML and OIDC

• Understanding of Identity and Access Management, and Customer Identity Management,

• Strong verbal and written English with excellent communication, negotiation and documentation skills.

• Awareness of Agile techniques like Scrum, SAFe, etc are a plus for this position.

At Roche, we believe in diversity and inclusion as essential values for our success. We have special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams. If you have a disability, for us it is a plus, and we have special benefits for you: Go ahead and present your candidacy!

APPLY DIRECTLY
Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche IT first-hand? Check out our blog!
https://careers.roche.com/global/en/we-are-roche

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

In Roche Informatics siamo un team di persone aperte e amichevoli, entusiasti delle novità tecnologiche e delle soluzioni IT efficienti. L'opportunità - Partecipare a tutti gli aspetti dell'implementazione di strategie, politiche e procedure Enterprise CIAM, assicurando che si allineano con gli obiettivi generali di sicurezza e gestione dei rischi - Assistere con la consegna di progetti e programmi CIAM, assicurando che siano completati nel tempo, nel budget, e ad un alto livello di qualità - Lavorare a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali per garantire che le soluzioni CIAM siano integrate con sistemi e processi esistenti. - Eseguire le valutazioni di sicurezza e identificare potenziali miglioramenti. - Partecipare alla risposta degli incidenti e alla risoluzione dei problemi - Per rimanere consapevoli delle sfide e delle opportunità operative; lavorare con i team di supporto per fornire il supporto all'escalation interna secondo le necessità - Concentrarsi attivamente sull'autosviluppo nella creazione di piani attuabili per migliorare. - Assistere nella valutazione di soluzioni e la loro fattibilità ai proprietari di applicazioni di Customer-Facing in una varietà di ambienti tra cui backend (PHP, Java, .NET), e client-side (REST, JavaScript) assicurando al contempo procedure, processi e documentazione sono conformi alle linee guida normative e agli standard organizzativi, - Dimostrare la consapevolezza aziendale e comprendere le esigenze dei proprietari delle applicazioni, e qualsiasi altra organizzazione partner IT.
• Requisiti - 2 anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione e/o nell'attuazione delle soluzioni CIAM o IAM - Esperienza nell'integrazione con altre soluzioni tra cui API - Qualcuno che vuole influenzare il proprio sviluppo, dimostrare curiosità intellettuale, un auto-starter e abbracciare il miglioramento continuo. - Sono orientati all'esecuzione con una mentalità agile e alla ricerca di una società in cui si ha la possibilità di perseguire i vostri interessi attraverso funzioni e geografie. - Corso di laurea in Informatica, sicurezza delle informazioni, o un campo relativo - Conoscenza dei principi della sicurezza informatica e delle migliori pratiche - Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e gestire il tempo in modo efficace - Eccitato per aiutare i nostri clienti a migliorare i loro viaggi di consumo Cosa significa? - Backend Capacità di sviluppo con almeno una piattaforma server come .NET, Java, PHP. - Capacità di sviluppo front-end con almeno una piattaforma server come HTML, CSS, REST, JavaScript e JS Libraries. - SAP CDC (Gigya) Competenza tecnica. - Esperienza in progetti di integrazione che coinvolgono aspetti di gestione dell'identità e sviluppo del web e l'esperienza del cliente. - Esperienza con SAML e OIDC - Comprensione dell'identità e della gestione dell'accesso e della gestione dell'identità del cliente, - Forte inglese verbale e scritto con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e documentazione. - La consapevolezza delle tecniche Agile come Scrum, SAFe, ecc sono un vantaggio per questa posizione. Contatto A Roche, crediamo nella diversità e nell'inclusione come valori essenziali per il nostro successo. Abbiamo un interesse particolare per integrare le persone con disabilità nelle nostre squadre. Se avete una disabilità, per noi è un plus, e abbiamo benefici speciali per voi: Avanti e presentare la vostra candidatura! DIRETTA APPLICA Vuoi sapere com'è essere parte di Roche IT di prima mano? Guarda il nostro blog! https://careers.roche.com/global/en/we-are-roche Se sentite questa offerta si adatta ad un tuo amico, sentitevi liberi di condividerla. .... Amministratore Pani/Pana danych

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

Position
Deine Abteilung

Als Referendar der Rechtswissenschaft (m/w/d) unterstützt und begleitest Du die Roche-Datenschutzorganisation bei allen Anliegen innerhalb des Datenschutzrechts und angrenzender rechtlicher Themenfelder. Du gewinnst so Einblicke in ein global tätiges Healthcare-Unternehmen und erhältst die Möglichkeit, Deine rechtlichen Kenntnisse in spannenden Projekten und im Austausch mit Deinen Kolleg:innen der Rechtsabteilungen anzuwenden und auszubauen. Die Tätigkeit kann nach Absprache ganz oder teilweise im Home Office sowie an den Standorten Mannheim, Penzberg (Großraum München) oder Grenzach erfolgen.

Deine Aufgaben

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at Roche Diagnostics Germany!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As an Account Manager at Roche Sequencing Solutions, you will be at the forefront of revolutionizing the sequencing landscape. Embrace this unique opportunity to collaborate with a dynamic team and drive our innovative products to market success.

The Opportunity
As an Account Manager, you will:

• Identify and Cultivate Leads: Discover sales opportunities, cultivate new business relationships, and engage key decision-makers in the sequencing community.

• Execute Growth Plans: Develop and monitor regional commercial growth plans, focusing on key success metrics to achieve revenue and strategic goals.

• Optimize Sales Opportunities: Manage sales opportunities effectively through Salesforce/CRM.

• Present and Consult: Conduct product presentations and consultative discussions to showcase the value of our sequencing solutions.

• Drive Technical Sales: Provide technical expertise throughout the sales process, including application consultations and data analysis support.

• Enhance Brand Visibility: Represent Roche at conferences, trade shows, and networking events to establish thought leadership and engage potential customers.

• Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with marketing, product management, service, and support teams to align sales efforts with company objectives and customer needs.

• Regional Execution: Partner with subregional teams across Europe to develop and implement strategic plans for successful market penetration.

Who You Are
You possess:

• Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Life Science, Business, or a related field.

• Sales Experience: Proven experience in selling capital equipment within the diagnostics/life sciences industry.

• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Next Generation Sequencing and related genomic techniques.

• Strategic and Negotiation Skills: Demonstrated excellence in negotiation, strategic planning, and organizational abilities.

• Consultative Selling: Ability to identify technical needs and provide business solutions.

• Entrepreneurial Spirit: Strong business acumen and drive to navigate complex sales processes.

• Communication Skills: Ability to deliver impactful group presentations and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• Travel Requirements: Willingness to undertake national and international travel.

• Preferred Experience: 5+ years in a clinical research or academic laboratory environment, experience selling Sequencers for NGS applications, and proficiency in NGS data analysis.

• Language Skills: Fluent in English. Knowledge of German and/or other European languages is an advantage.

Join Roche Sequencing Solutions to make a difference in the genomic landscape and deliver state-of-the-art sequencing solutions to the world. Apply now and become a part of a company dedicated to innovation and excellence.

Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing recruitment or selection process, but a position we are frequently recruiting for or we are planning to open in the near future.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso alla sanità oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Stiamo cercando voi per unirsi al nostro TALENT POOL a Roche Diagnostics Germania!

Un futuro più sano. E' ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Avanzerà continuamente la scienza e garantirà a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria di cui hanno bisogno oggi e alle generazioni future. Creare un mondo dove tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.

E' questo che ci rende Roche.

Come Account Manager di Roche Sequencing Solutions, sarete in prima linea nella rivoluzione del paesaggio di animazione. Embrace questa opportunità unica per collaborare con un team dinamico e guidare i nostri prodotti innovativi al successo del mercato.

L'opportunità

- Identificare e Cultivate Leads: Scoprire opportunità di vendita, coltivare nuove relazioni commerciali e coinvolgere i decisori chiave nella comunità del sequencing. - Eseguire piani di crescita: sviluppare e monitorare piani di crescita commerciale regionali, concentrandosi su metriche di successo chiave per raggiungere ricavi e obiettivi strategici. - Ottimizzare le opportunità di vendita: Gestire efficacemente le opportunità di vendita attraverso Salesforce/CRM. - Presente e Consulto: Condurre presentazioni di prodotti e discussioni consultive per mostrare il valore delle nostre soluzioni di sequencing.

- Drive Technical Sales: fornire competenze tecniche durante tutto il processo di vendita, comprese le consultazioni sulle applicazioni e il supporto per l'analisi dei dati. - Migliorare la visibilità del marchio: rappresentare Roche a conferenze, fiere e eventi di networking per stabilire la leadership dei pensieri e coinvolgere i potenziali clienti. - Collaborare con team di marketing, gestione dei prodotti, assistenza e supporto per allineare gli sforzi di vendita con gli obiettivi aziendali e le esigenze dei clienti.

- Esecuzione regionale: collaborare con squadre subregionali in tutta Europa per sviluppare e attuare piani strategici per una penetrazione riuscita del mercato.

Chi sei

- Background didattico: Laurea in Scienze della Vita, Business o un campo correlato. - Esperienza commerciale: Esperienza di Proven nella vendita di attrezzature di capitale all'interno del settore diagnostico/scienze della vita. - Conoscenza tecnica: comprensione approfondita della sequenziazione di prossima generazione e tecniche genomiche correlate. - Capacità strategiche e negoziali: eccellenza dimostrata nella negoziazione, pianificazione strategica e capacità organizzative. - Consultativo Seling: Capacità di identificare le esigenze tecniche e fornire soluzioni aziendali.

- Spirito Entrepreneurale: Acumen di impresa forte e guidare a navigare in processi di vendita complessi. - Capacità di comunicazione: Capacità di fornire presentazioni di gruppo di impatto e comunicare efficacemente con diversi stakeholder. - Requisiti di viaggio: volontà di intraprendere viaggi nazionali e internazionali. - Esperienza preferita: 5+ anni in un ambiente di ricerca clinica o di laboratorio accademico, esperienza di vendita Sequenziatori per applicazioni NGS, e competenza nell'analisi dei dati NGS. - Capacità linguistiche: fluente in inglese. Conoscenza del tedesco e / o altre lingue europee è un vantaggio.

Iscriviti a Roche Sequencing Solutions per fare la differenza nel paesaggio genomico e offrire soluzioni di sequenziamento all'avanguardia al mondo. Applica ora e diventa parte di un'azienda dedicata all'innovazione e all'eccellenza.

Si prega di notare che si tratta di un dissidente per la costruzione di una piscina di TT, il che significa che non necessariamente riflette una corrente apertura con il reclutamento o il processo di selezione in corso, ma una posizione che stiamo reclutando spesso per o stiamo progettando di aprire nel prossimo futuro.

Chi siamo

Un futuro più sano ci spinge

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zu Innovationen. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für die kommenden Generationen braucht.

Das macht uns zu Roche.

Als Account Manager bei Roche Sequencing Solutions stehen Sie bei der Revolutionierung der Sequenzierungslandschaft an der Spitze. Umfassen Sie diese einzigartige Gelegenheit, mit einem dynamischen Team zusammenzuarbeiten und unsere innovativen Produkte zum Markterfolg zu bringen.

Die Gelegenheit

- Identifizieren und Beseitigen von Leads: Entdecken Sie Vertriebschancen, pflegen Sie neue Geschäftsbeziehungen und engagieren Sie sich für wichtige Entscheidungsträger in der Sequenzierungs-Community. - Growth Plans durchführen: Regionale kommerzielle Wachstumspläne entwickeln und überwachen, wobei der Fokus auf Schlüsselerfolgsmetriken gelegt wird, um Umsatz und strategische Ziele zu erreichen. - Vertriebschancen optimieren: Vertriebschancen effektiv über Salesforce/CRM verwalten. - Present and Consult: Führen Sie Produktpräsentationen und beratende Diskussionen, um den Wert unserer Sequenzierungslösungen zu präsentieren.

- Technischer Vertrieb vorantreiben: Technische Expertise während des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses bereitstellen, einschließlich Anwendungsberatung und Datenanalyseunterstützung. - Markenvisibilität verbessern: Roche auf Konferenzen, Messen und Networking-Events vertreten, um die führende Rolle von Ideen zu etablieren und potenzielle Kunden zu engagieren. - AcrossTeams kollaborieren: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Marketing, Produktmanagement, Service und Support-Teams zusammen, um die Vertriebsanstrengungen mit den Unternehmenszielen und Kundenbedürfnissen abzustimmen.

- Regionale Durchführung: Partner mit subregionalen Teams in ganz Europa zur Entwicklung und Umsetzung strategischer Pläne für eine erfolgreiche Marktdurchdringung.

Wer du bist

- Lehr- und Lernhintergrund: Bachelor in Life Science, Business oder einem verwandten Bereich. - Vertriebserfahrung: Bewährte Erfahrung im Verkauf von Kapitalausstattung in der Diagnostik-/Life Sciences-Industrie. - Technisches Wissen: Tiefes Verständnis der Next Generation Sequenzierung und verwandter genomischer Techniken. - Strategische und Verhandlungskompetenzen: Vorgestellte Exzellenz in Verhandlungen, strategischer Planung und organisatorischen Fähigkeiten. - Beratung Verkauf: Fähigkeit, technische Bedürfnisse zu identifizieren und Geschäftslösungen zu bieten.

- Unternehmergeist: Starkes Geschäftsklima und Antrieb, komplexe Verkaufsprozesse zu navigieren. - Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Fähigkeit, wirkungsvolle Gruppenpräsentationen zu liefern und effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren. - Reiseanforderungen: Bereitschaft, nationale und internationale Reisen zu unternehmen. - Bevorzugte Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre in einer klinischen Forschung oder akademischen Laborumgebung, Erfahrung mit dem Verkauf von Sequenzern für NGS-Anwendungen und Kenntnisse in NGS-Datenanalyse. - Sprachkenntnisse: Fließend in Englisch. Kenntnisse in Deutsch und/oder anderen europäischen Sprachen sind ein Vorteil.

Mit Roche Sequencing Solutions können Sie die genomische Landschaft verändern und weltweit modernste Sequenzierungslösungen anbieten. Jetzt bewerben und Teil eines Unternehmens werden, das sich der Innovation und Exzellenz widmet.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass dies eine Requisition für Talent Pool-Gebäude ist, was bedeutet, dass es nicht unbedingt eine aktuelle Eröffnung mit laufenden Rekrutierungs- oder Auswahlverfahren widerspiegelt, sondern eine Position, für die wir häufig rekrutieren oder die wir in naher Zukunft eröffnen wollen.

Wer wir sind

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns an

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à assurer que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

La position

Nous vous cherchons pour rejoindre notre POOL TALENT chez Roche Diagnostics Allemagne!

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et faire en sorte que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

En tant que responsable de compte chez Roche Sequencing Solutions, vous serez à l'avant-garde de la révolution du séquençage. Embrassez cette occasion unique de collaborer avec une équipe dynamique et de conduire nos produits innovants au succès du marché.

Les possibilités

- Identifier et faire connaître les pistes : Découvrez les opportunités de vente, cultivez de nouvelles relations d'affaires et engagez les décideurs clés dans la communauté de séquençage. - Exécuter des plans de croissance : Élaborer et surveiller des plans de croissance commerciale régionaux, en mettant l'accent sur les principales mesures de succès pour atteindre les revenus et les objectifs stratégiques. - Optimiser les opportunités de vente : Gérer efficacement les occasions de vente par Salesforce/CRM. - Présenter et consulter : Mener des présentations de produits et des discussions consultatives pour mettre en valeur la valeur de nos solutions de séquençage.

- Améliorer la visibilité de la marque : Représenter Roche lors de conférences, de salons et de réseautages pour établir un leadership de pensée et engager les clients potentiels. - Collaborer entre les équipes : Travailler étroitement avec le marketing, la gestion de produits, le service et les équipes de soutien pour aligner les efforts de vente sur les objectifs de l'entreprise et les besoins des clients.

- Exécution régionale : Partenaire avec des équipes sous-régionales en Europe pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans stratégiques pour une pénétration réussie du marché.

Qui vous êtes

- Contexte éducatif : Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, en affaires ou dans un domaine connexe. - Expérience en vente : Expérience éprouvée dans la vente d'équipement d'immobilisations dans l'industrie du diagnostic et des sciences de la vie. - Connaissances techniques : compréhension approfondie du séquençage de la prochaine génération et des techniques génomiques connexes. - Compétences stratégiques et de négociation : excellence démontrée dans la négociation, la planification stratégique et les capacités organisationnelles. - Vente consultative : Capacité d'identifier les besoins techniques et de fournir des solutions commerciales.

- Esprit entrepreneurial : un sens des affaires et un dynamisme pour naviguer dans des processus de vente complexes. - Compétences en communication : Capacité de présenter des présentations de groupe et de communiquer efficacement avec divers intervenants. - Exigences de voyage : Volonté d'entreprendre des voyages nationaux et internationaux. - Expérience privilégiée : 5 ans et plus dans un environnement de recherche clinique ou de laboratoire universitaire, expérience de vente de Sequencers pour les applications de la NGS et compétence en analyse des données de la NGS. - Compétences linguistiques : Fluent en anglais.

Rejoignez Roche Sequencing Solutions pour faire la différence dans le paysage génomique et fournir des solutions de séquençage de pointe au monde. Postulez maintenant et devenez membre d'une entreprise dédiée à l'innovation et à l'excellence.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
岗位名称：（高级）渠道拓展策略经理
工作地点：上海/北京

负责从战略规划到绩效达成的全流程管理。基于美多芭产品特性，构建医院广阔市场与院外零售市场双轨战略，与跨部门建立基于产品的高效合作机制，充分整合内外部资源、赋A能经销商，创新业务模式，最终实现业务的成功转型与稳健增长。

您将有机会：
负责核心战略规划与绩效管理：

• 分渠道策略制定： 深度洞察VBP政策、市场竞争及患者需求，分别制定美多芭在医院广阔市场与零售市场的精准业务策略、目标与实施路径。

• 整合策略设计： 主导制定医院与零售渠道的协同整合策略，确保患者在不同场景间的无缝流转。

• 策略迭代与优化： 建立策略追踪与评估体系，紧密监控落地过程，基于市场反馈与数据洞察，及时发起并领导策略的动态调整，确保战略敏捷性。

• 绩效目标设定： 主导设定两大渠道的年度/季度绩效目标，并确保目标清晰传达至所有相关执行团队及合作伙伴。

• 绩效监控与分析： 建立并主导定期的业务绩效复盘会议，深入分析绩效差距的根本原因，识别风险与机会。

负责跨部门领导与资源统筹：

• 横向协同枢纽：主动与销售市场部、销售部、医学部、财务及数字化团队进行无缝沟通与协调，确保各职能部门对整体战略的理解一致与行动同步。

• 资源整合与分配： 根据双轨策略的优先级，统筹并优化市场与渠道投入的预算与资源，向管理层提供基于投资回报分析的资金分配建议，确保资源投向最高价值领域。

负责生态构建与伙伴策略：

• 全域伙伴管理：主导构建基于产品特性的全域伙伴网络，从战略层面规划合作模式，赋能伙伴共同成长。

• 零售生态打造： 探索并推动与互联网医院、线上平台及患者社区等多元主体的深度合作，构建一个服务患者的创新零售生态体系。

创新模式探索与落地：

• 创新推广与患者管理： 探索并试点两个渠道的创新推广模式及患者管理模式。

• 创新支付与医疗生态： 牵头探索创新支付模式，并积极布局与各类医疗健康服务提供方的合作，共同构建服务于帕金森病患者的“诊-疗-付-管”一体化医疗新生态。

我们期待您：

• 本科及以上学历

• 8年以上药企经验，至少3年担任全国市场经理、高级产品经理或战略项目经理等职位，具有从策略制定到落地，并直接对业务指标达成负责的成功经验。

• 必须拥有深厚的绩效管理经验，包括但不限于：KPI体系设计、业务复盘、预算与资源分配的绩效导向管理。

• 必须同时具备医院市场与零售市场的深厚知识，并拥有直接管理或深度协同销售团队及外部伙伴达成业绩的成功案例。

• 政策理解和行业洞察力、较强的策略分析能力、大客户管理和谈判能力、项目管理和敏捷执行能力、跨部门沟通协调能力。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. The Position 岗位名称：（高级）渠道拓展策略经理 工作地点：上海/北京负责从战略规划到绩效达成的全流程管理.基于美多芭产品特性,构建医院广阔市场与院外零售市场双轨战略,与跨部门建立基于产品的高效合作机制, 充分整合内外部资源, 赋A能经销商, 创新业务模式, 最终实现业务的成功转型与稳健增长.您将有机会: 负责核心战略规划与绩效管理:
• 分渠道策略制定:深度洞察VBP政策、市场竞争及患者需求, 分别制定美多芭在医院广阔市场与零售市场的精准业务策略、目标与实施路径。
• 整合策略设计:确保患者在不同场景间的无缝流转. •策略迭代与优化:建立策略追踪与评估体系, 紧密监控落地过程, 基于市场反馈与数据洞察, 及时发起并领导策略的动态调整, 确保战略敏捷性.
• 绩效目标设定:主导设定两大渠道的年度/季度绩效目标，并确保目标清晰传达至所有相关执行团队及合作伙伴.
• 绩效监控与分析:建立并主导定期的业务绩效复盘会议,深入分析绩效差距的根本原因,识别风险与机会.负责跨部门领导与资源统筹: •横向协同枢纽:主动与销售市场部、销售部、医学部、财务及数字化团队进行无缝沟通与协调,确保各职能部门对整体战略的理解一致与行动同步.
• 资源整合与分配:根据双轨策略的优先级, 统筹并优化市场与渠道投入的预算与资源,向管理层提供基于投资回报分析的资金分配建议, 确保资源投向最高价值领域.负责生态构建与伙伴策略: •全域伙伴管理:主导构建基于产品特性的全域伙伴网络,从战略层面规划合作模式,赋能伙伴共同成长.

• 创新支付与医疗生态:牵头探索创新支付模式, 并积极布局与各类医疗健康服务提供方的合作,共同构建服务于帕金森病患者的„诊-疗-付-管“一体化医疗新生态.我们期待您:
• 本科及以上学历

Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, fördern Kreativität und halten unsere Ambitionen hoch, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die eine globale Wirkung haben. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
We are currently looking for two Process Technicians to join our Process Engineering team on a 12-month contract , with the possibility of extension. Both positions will involve the same day-to-day responsibilities outlined below; however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

As a Process Technician you will work closely with the sensor manufacture and packaging teams and will become highly skilled and competent in all aspects of manufacturing (e.g. line operation & packaging, processes and procedures). Be able to diagnose product and process issues quickly and effectively using a logical approach. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring the highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained. Analyse manufacturing data and conduct product / process testing to ensure CTQs are met. Update documentation such as standard operating procedures, work instructions and bills of material.

This is an on-site role based at our Athena Motherwell location. Please note that you will spend approximately 70% of your time working from our Bathgate site, however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

Responsibilities:
Technical:

• Work in close collaboration with manufacturing technicians and engineers to become highly competent in sensor manufacture line operation, processes and procedures

• Support monitoring of product and process data using statistical analysis techniques

• Quick and effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems using a methodical approach and report progress in a structured way

• Conduct CTQ testing and material / product analysis techniques

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances and help develop robust OCAP’s and preventative measures

• Support NPD projects through transfer of pilot work to high volume manufacture

• Support validation activities and completion of validation documentation in line with business needs

• Help drive continuous improvement initiatives through engagement of production team on shift

• Ensures highest levels of quality and compliance are maintained

• Lead/support change control updates to manufacturing documentation.

Who you are:

Essential Education/ Qualifications:

• Process Excellence Yellow or Green belt additional advantage.

• Preferably Degree qualified or relevant experience.

• Experience in rotary converting and / or reel to reel printing (rotary screen / flexographic etc.) additional advantage

• Knowledge of Statistical Analysis methods / techniques

Requirements (incl. Key Skills):

• GMP experience

• A hands-on Process Technician with a good level of relevant industry experience (preferably medical device related)

• Experience of optimising product and processes

• High level of computer literacy

• Team player and takes accountability for any manufacturing challenges

• Analyse production data and conduct process / product analysis to ensure CTQs are met

• Strong problem-solving skills and sense of urgency

• Detail orientated and ensures highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained on a daily basis

Recruitment process

Phase I:

• Submission of Cover Letter & CV: Evaluation of technical skills and motivation.

Phase II:

• In-person interview in Athena Motherwell (will be shared with the shortlisted candidates later)

Purpose - our focus in the

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità: Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di due tecnici di processo per aderire al nostro team di Process Engineering in un contratto di 12 mesi, con la possibilità di estensione. Entrambe le posizioni coinvolgeranno le stesse responsabilità quotidiane descritte di seguito; tuttavia, uno dei ruoli richiederà anche di lavorare nella nostra posizione Dumyat. In qualità di tecnico di processo lavorerai a stretto contatto con i team di produzione e confezionamento dei sensori e diventerai altamente qualificato e competente in tutti gli aspetti della produzione (ad esempio il funzionamento della linea e l'imballaggio, i processi e le procedure). Essere in grado di diagnosticare i problemi di prodotto e processo in modo rapido ed efficace utilizzando un approccio logico. Supporta e guida iniziative di miglioramento continuo garantendo al contempo i massimi livelli di qualità e produttività. Analizzare i dati di produzione e condurre i test di prodotto / processo per garantire CTQ sono soddisfatti. Documentazione di aggiornamento come procedure operative standard, istruzioni di lavoro e bollette di materiale. Questo è un ruolo in loco basato sulla nostra sede Athena Motherwell. Si prega di notare che trascorrerete circa il 70% del vostro tempo lavorando dal nostro sito Bathgate, tuttavia, uno dei ruoli richiederà anche di lavorare nella nostra posizione Dumyat. Responsabilità: Tecnica:
• Lavorare in stretta collaborazione con tecnici e ingegneri di produzione per diventare altamente competenti nel funzionamento, processi e procedure della linea di produzione dei sensori
• Monitoraggio del supporto dei dati dei prodotti e dei processi utilizzando tecniche di analisi statistica
• Diagnosi rapida ed efficace e risoluzione dei problemi utilizzando un approccio metodologico e riferire i progressi in modo strutturato
• Condurre test CTQ e tecniche di analisi dei materiali / prodotti
• Indagare e risolvere non conformità e contribuire a sviluppare misure di prevenzione e di OCAP robuste
• Sostenere i progetti NPD attraverso il trasferimento di lavori pilota alla fabbricazione di volumi elevati
• Supportare le attività di validazione e il completamento della documentazione di validazione in linea con le esigenze aziendali
• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso l'impegno del team di produzione a turni
• Garantisce elevati livelli di qualità e conformità sono mantenuti
• Aggiornamenti di controllo delle modifiche di piombo/supporto alla documentazione di produzione. Chi sei: Educazione Essenziale/ Qualifiche:
• Processo Eccellenza Giallo o Verde cintura ulteriore vantaggio.
• Preferibilmente Laurea esperienza qualificata o rilevante.
• Esperienza nella conversione rotante e/o bobina nella stampa a bobina (schermo rotatorio / flessografico ecc.) ulteriore vantaggio
• Conoscenza dei metodi / tecniche di analisi statistica Requisiti (incl. competenze chiave):
• Esperienza GMP
• Un tecnico di processo pratico con un buon livello di esperienza industriale rilevante (preferibilmente dispositivo medico correlato)
• Esperienza di ottimizzazione dei prodotti e dei processi
• Alti livelli di alfabetizzazione del computer
• Giocatore di squadra e tiene conto delle sfide di produzione
• Analizzare i dati di produzione e condurre l'analisi del processo / del prodotto per garantire il raggiungimento di CTQ
• Forte capacità di problem solving e senso di urgenza
• Dettagli orientati e assicura elevati livelli di qualità e produttività sono mantenuti ogni giorno Processo di assunzione Fase I:
• Presentazione di Cover Letter & CV: Valutazione delle competenze tecniche e della motivazione. Fase II:
• Intervista in persona a Athena Motherwell (sarà condivisa con i candidati più brevi in seguito) Scopo - la nostra attenzione

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY AND PURPOSE:
Roche’s Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing the late development (Phase II – III) clinical strategies and plans that deliver medically-differentiated therapies that provide meaningful improvement to patients.
The Lead Medical Director leads or makes major contributions to development of the Clinical Development (CD) strategy and plan and is responsible for effective and efficient execution for the assigned molecule(s)/indication(s).
Lead Medical Directors are expected to perform their responsibilities with more independence by comparison to Medical Directors.
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

• M.D. Required

• Relevant clinical, scientific, or clinical trial/development experience in same/similar therapeutic area required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Significant experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Significant pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized expert in the field

• Significant experience designing and conducting clinical trials (i.e. one or more trials)

• Experience authoring a global development plan is preferred

• Understanding of Phase II – III drug development

• Knowledge and understanding of Phase I & IV drug development is a plus

• Understanding of product and safety profiles

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is required

• 4 or more years pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized local expert in the field (e.g Assistant Professor or equivalent)

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Is regarded as knowledgeable in his/her field, is respected by others, can effectively contribute to longer-range drug development, and can lead cross-functional teams to successful results

• Business Acumen: Has sound knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process.

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills: Strong interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority and has proven experience building and cultivating relationships with key partners and stakeholders, both internally and externally

• Writing: Outstanding written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Strong business presentation skills: effective at summarizing and presenting the key considerations and decision-points.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills: can effectively drive discussions and decisions toward desired end-results

• Decision Making: Makes good business decisions and exercises sound judgment. Balances decisions with imperatives for ethics and efficacy. Able to mak

Experience

• 8 or more years work experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related industry and CMC, quality, regulatory or related experience.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Principal Business Analyst is a senior, high-impact role that sits at the crossroads of clinical science, product strategy, and technology delivery. While positioned as a Business Analyst, this role operates with the breadth, depth, and strategic influence of a seasoned analyst owning the vision, innovation pipeline, and feature delivery of the Study Designer, a flagship product enabling clinical trial teams to design smarter, faster, and more impactful studies.This individual brings a rare combination of deep scientific credibility, product leadership, and technical fluency - capable of earning the trust of Clinical Scientists in one meeting and driving an engineering sprint in the next. They are relentlessly curious, innovation-driven, and passionate about using technology to transform how clinical trials are conceived and executed - ultimately accelerating therapies to patients.

The Opportunity

• Clinical & Scientific Collaboration : Act as the primary link between clinical/scientific teams and product engineering, building long-term relationships and facilitating discovery workshops with medical experts to deeply understand trial design and represent the clinical user's voice.

• Product Feature Innovation: Define and own the feature roadmap by balancing business, scientific, and technical needs; foster innovation through design thinking sprints to identify new opportunities, create compelling business cases, and track feature success metrics/KPIs post-release.

• Feature Design & Requirements Excellence: Author precise, actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; partner with UX to create wireframes and prototypes, ruthlessly filter requests based on value, and maintain a living product specification traceable to user needs.

• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act as a technical translator by converting complex clinical workflows into structured requirements, leveraging strong literacy in architecture, data modeling, and APIs to collaborate with engineers on technical risks, dependencies, and solutions.

• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner with architects, senior engineers, and QA leads throughout the development build cycle to ensure feature scalability and quality, while supporting UAT design and execution to meet scientific intent and usability standards.

• Agile Leadership & Delivery: Drive iterative delivery, rapid feedback, and hypothesis-driven development; own and groom a sprint-ready product backl

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics e la prova clinica Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Il Principal Business Analyst è un ruolo senior, ad alto impatto che siede al crocevia della scienza clinica, della strategia del prodotto e della consegna della tecnologia. Mentre si posiziona come Business Analyst, questo ruolo opera con l'ampiezza, la profondità e l'influenza strategica di un analista esperto che possiede la visione, l'innovazione pipeline, e la consegna caratteristica dello Studio Designer, un prodotto di punta che consente ai team di prova clinici di progettare studi più intelligenti, più veloci e più efficaci. Questo individuo porta una rara combinazione di profonda credibilità scientifica, leadership di prodotto e fluidità tecnica - in grado di guadagnare la fiducia degli scienziati clinici in un incontro e di guidare uno sprint di ingegneria nel prossimo. Sono instancabilmente curiosi, orientati all'innovazione e appassionati di utilizzare la tecnologia per trasformare come le sperimentazioni cliniche sono concepite e eseguite - alla fine accelerando le terapie ai pazienti. L'opportunità
• Collaborazione clinica e scientifica: agire come collegamento primario tra team clinici/scientifici e ingegneria dei prodotti, costruire relazioni a lungo termine e facilitare i laboratori di scoperta con esperti medici per comprendere profondamente il design di prova e rappresentare la voce dell'utente clinico.
• Innovazione di funzionalità del prodotto: Definire e possedere la roadmap caratteristica bilanciando le esigenze aziendali, scientifiche e tecniche; promuovere l'innovazione attraverso progetti di pensiero di progettazione per identificare nuove opportunità, creare casi aziendali convincenti, e tracciare metriche di successo / KPI post-release. Eccellenza: Autore storie utente precise e attuabili, epici e criteri di accettazione; partner con UX per creare wireframe e prototipi, filtrare senza scrupoli richieste basate sul valore, e mantenere una specifica di prodotto vivente tracciabile alle esigenze dell'utente.
• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Agire come traduttore tecnico convertendo complessi flussi di lavoro clinici in requisiti strutturati, sfruttando una forte alfabetizzazione in architettura, modellazione dei dati e API per collaborare con gli ingegneri sui rischi tecnici, dipendenze e soluzioni.
• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner con architetti, ingegneri senior e QA porta in tutto il ciclo di costruzione dello sviluppo per garantire scalabilità e qualità delle funzionalità, supportando al contempo la progettazione e l'esecuzione UAT per soddisfare gli standard di intenti scientifici e di usabilità.
• Leadership Agile & Delivery: consegna iterativa di guida, feedback rapido e sviluppo basato su ipotesi; proprio e sposo un backl prodotto pronto sprint

Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Ils sont inlassablement curieux, motivés par l'innovation et passionnés par l'utilisation de la technologie pour transformer la façon dont les essais cliniques sont conçus et exécutés - en fin de compte, accélérer les traitements aux patients. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Good business presentation skills; is comfortable and effective when presenting to others, internally or externally.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

• Stays abreast of internal and external developments, trends and other dynamics relevant to the work of CD to maintain, at all times, a fully current view and perspective of internal/external influences and/or implications for the assigned therapeutic and disease area(s)

• As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects

• Maintains the highest standards and levels of scientific and clinical knowledge in the specific therapeutic and disease area(s) of assignment

• Collaborates with a variety of internal and external partners and stakeholders, such as clinical investigators, clinicians, scientists and key opinion leaders (KOLs), as well as multidisciplinary internal groups, including other groups in PD, research, business development, commercial ope

La posizione

• M.D. Richiesto
