• Sfondo accademico / insegnamento è un plus

• Esperienza di lavoro con i principi e le tecniche di analisi dei dati, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica

• Esperienza risultati editoriali di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed è preferito

• Regolazione: Conoscenza degli aspetti medici del GCP (buona pratica clinica), ICH (Conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei farmaci per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti è preferito

• Durata dell'esperienza: 2 o più anni di esperienza accademica post-laurea o clinica

• Fino al 30% di viaggio globale

Abilità e comportamenti chiave

• Etica: Ha un'etica impeccabile. Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, Valori Roche

• Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli

• Business Acumen: Ha la conoscenza del settore farmaceutico/biotecnico, le molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo della droga. Regolarmente conduce lo sviluppo di strategie e piani di malattia

• Organizzazione: Può dare priorità a più compiti e obiettivi nel tempo, sul bersaglio e nel budget

• Competenze interpersonali: buona comunicazione interpersonale, verbale e capacità di influenza: può influenzare senza autorità

• Scrittura: Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta

• Capacità di presentazione: Buone capacità di presentazione aziendale; è comodo ed efficace quando si presenta ad altri, internamente o esternamente. Confidente e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e on-point, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo

• Competenze di negoziazione: Buone competenze di negoziazione: sa come completare i consegnabili lavorando efficacemente con altri internamente ed esternamente

• Decision Making: Sa come prendere decisioni di compromesso mentre bilanciare l'etica e l'efficacia

• Lavoro di squadra: forte orientamento al lavoro di squadra

DUTI SPECIFICHE E RESPONSABILITÀ:
Strategia e pianificazione CDP

• Partecipa allo sviluppo del piano CD per molecola/indicazioni assegnate

• Raccoglie e analizza i dati e le informazioni necessarie per creare il piano CD

• Funziona con altri membri del CST e sub-team rilevanti per sviluppare componenti del piano CD (ad esempio, strategia di analisi/dati, sviluppo di KOL, strategia di pubblicazioni, ecc.)

• Funziona con CST e altri team rilevanti per sviluppare e fornire informazioni e input per i requisiti di budget/resource necessari per implementare ed eseguire il piano CD

• Rimangono al di fuori degli sviluppi interni ed esterni, delle tendenze e di altre dinamiche rilevanti per il lavoro del CD per mantenere, in ogni momento, una visione e una prospettiva completamente attuali di influenze interne/esterne e/o implicazioni per l'area terapeutica e malattia assegnata(i)

• Come opportuno, partecipa a attività e progetti di valutazione dell'intelligence competitiva e/o di altri mercati/industria

• Mantiene i più elevati standard e livelli di conoscenza scientifica e clinica nella specifica area terapeutica e malattia di assegnazione

• Collabora con una varietà di partner e stakeholder interni ed esterni, come investigatori clinici, clinici, scienziati e leader di opinione chiave (KOL), così come gruppi interni multidisciplinari, tra cui altri gruppi in PD, ricerca, sviluppo aziendale, ope commerciale

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
ERFAHRUNG UND QUALIFIKATIONEN:

• Akademisch/wissenschaftlich/klinisch:
• M.D. erforderlich

• Therapeutisches Wissen über Stoffwechsel, Fettleibigkeit und Diabetes mit relevanter klinischer, wissenschaftlicher und klinischer Studien- / Entwicklungserfahrung erforderlich

• Akademischer / Lehrhintergrund ist ein Plus

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit den Prinzipien und Techniken der Datenanalyse, Interpretation und klinischen Relevanz

• Erfahrungen mit der Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen einer wissenschaftlichen Studie in einer Peer-Review-Zeitschrift werden bevorzugt

• Regulatory: Kenntnisse der medizinischen Aspekte von GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA und anderen relevanten Richtlinien und Vorschriften werden bevorzugt

• Dauer der Erfahrung: 2 oder mehr Jahre postgraduale akademische oder klinische Erfahrung

• Bis zu 30% globale Reisen

Schlüsselkompetenzen und -verhalten

• Ethik: Hat eine tadellose Ethik. Nachweis oder Nachweisfähigkeit von Roche Values

• Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail: Hervorragende Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail

• Business Acumen: Hat Kenntnisse in der Pharma- / Biotech-Industrie, den verschiedenen Funktionen und Rollen, die an der Arzneimittelentwicklung beteiligt sind. Führt regelmäßig die Entwicklung von Krankheitsstrategien und -plänen

• Organisation: Kann mehrere Aufgaben und Ziele rechtzeitig, zielgenau und innerhalb des Budgets priorisieren

• Zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten: Gute zwischenmenschliche, verbale Kommunikation und Einflussfähigkeiten: kann ohne Autorität beeinflussen

• Schreiben: Starke schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Gute Geschäftspräsentationsfähigkeiten; ist komfortabel und effektiv, wenn sie sich intern oder extern anderen präsentieren. Selbstsicher und kompetent, wenn man intern und extern mit anderen interagiert: bleibt konzentriert und punktgenau, ist in der Lage, Probleme oder Herausforderungen produktiv und reif zu stellen

• Verhandlungsfähigkeiten: Gute Verhandlungsfähigkeiten: weiß, wie man Ergebnisse durch effektive interne und externe Zusammenarbeit mit anderen erledigt

• Entscheidungsfindung: Wissen, wie man Kompromissentscheidungen trifft, während man Ethik und Wirksamkeit in Einklang bringt

• Teamwork: Starke Orientierung an Teamwork

BESONDERE ZÖLLE UND ZUSTÄNDIGKEITEN:
CDP Strategie und Planung

• Beteiligt sich an der Entwicklung des CD-Plans für zugeordnete Moleküle/Indikationen

• Sammelt und analysiert Daten und Informationen, die für die Erstellung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind

• Arbeitet mit anderen CST-Mitgliedern und relevanten Subteams zusammen, um CD-Plankomponenten zu entwickeln (z. B. Analyse- / Datenstrategie, KOL-Entwicklung, Publikationsstrategie usw.)

• Arbeitet mit CST und anderen relevanten Teams zusammen, um Informationen und Input für Budget- / Ressourcenanforderungen zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen, die für die Implementierung und Ausführung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind

• Bleibt auf dem Laufenden über interne und externe Entwicklungen, Trends und andere Dynamiken, die für die Arbeit der CD relevant sind, um jederzeit eine vollständig aktuelle Ansicht und Perspektive der internen / externen Einflüsse und / oder Implikationen für die zugewiesenen therapeutischen und Krankheitsbereiche zu erhalten

• Gegebenenfalls nimmt er an wettbewerbsrelevanten Informationen und/oder anderen Markt-/Industriebewertungsaktivitäten und -projekten teil.

• Bewahrt die höchsten Standards und Niveaus der wissenschaftlichen und klinischen Kenntnisse in den spezifischen therapeutischen und Krankheitsbereichen der Zuordnung auf

• Arbeitet mit einer Vielzahl von internen und externen Partnern und Stakeholdern zusammen, wie klinischen Prüfern, Klinikern, Wissenschaftlern und wichtigen Meinungsführern (KOLs) sowie multidisziplinären internen Gruppen, einschließlich anderer Gruppen in den Bereichen PD, Forschung, Geschäftsentwicklung und kommerzieller Forschung.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. Together, we bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This position is located in the clinical science function of Roche Product Development China, home of the China ED CoE. This position is dedicated to leading and driving early development programs in oncology and hematology therapeutic areas as a clinical lead.

The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in oncology/hematology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.

• Servir de point de contact scientifique pour les équipes mondiales de développement précoce en oncologie/hématologie
• Encadrer les directeurs médicaux juniors pour renforcer davantage les capacités et les capacités du CoE ED Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en oncologie/hématologie ou d'un baccalauréat/maîtrise en médecine clinique avec au moins 3 ans de pratique clinique post-diplôme en oncologie/hématologie
• Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience d'expérience dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique et une vaste expérience de développement précoce en oncologie/hématologie
• Vous avez une expérience pratique dans le développement de CDP de développement précoce, la conception et la conduite d'essais cliniques de développement précoce, l'interaction avec les autorités sanitaires, la collaboration avec les enquêteurs et la recherche clinique. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Wir sind ein strategischer Partner globaler Frühentwicklungsteams von Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) und pharma Product Development (PD), um China in die globalen Frühentwicklungsprogramme zu integrieren. Diese Position widmet sich der Leitung und Förderung von Frühentwicklungsprogrammen in therapeutischen Bereichen der Immunologie, Neurologie, CVRM und Augenheilkunde als klinischer Leiter. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La position Dans le Centre d'excellence pour le développement précoce de la Chine (CED) de Roches, nous jouons un rôle crucial dans l'accélération du développement précoce mondial des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Nous sommes un partenaire stratégique des équipes mondiales de développement précoce de Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (PRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (GRED) et Pharmaceutical Product Development (PD) pour intégrer la Chine dans les programmes mondiaux de développement précoce. Ensemble, nous apportons rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie. Cette position est située dans la fonction de science clinique de Roche Product Development China, la maison de la Chine ED CoE. L'opportunité Ce rôle aura l'occasion de façonner la stratégie mondiale de développement précoce et le PDC, de stimuler la conception novatrice d'essais de développement précoce, d'avoir des répercussions importantes sur l'efficacité et le succès de nos programmes de développement précoce dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de la neurologie, du CVRM et de l'ophtalmologie, et de contribuer à l'écosystème d'innovation pour le développement de médicaments en Chine. Dans votre rôle, vous :
• Contribuer et influencer la stratégie mondiale en matière d'actifs et le développement rapide en tant que membre des équipes mondiales d'actifs
• Identifier de manière proactive les possibilités d'accélérer et d'optimiser le CDP mondial ED en tirant parti de l'expertise, de l'expérience, de la vitesse et de l'échelle en Chine
• Diriger l'équipe interfonctionnelle de la Chine pour évaluer les possibilités de la Chine de rejoindre les programmes mondiaux de DE ou les premiers essais de la Chine sur le plan stratégique, scientifique, réglementaire et opérationnel
• Favoriser la conception et la conduite d'essais innovants en partenariat étroit avec des experts fonctionnels mondiaux en développement précoce sur les premiers essais cliniques en Chine
• Être le moniteur médical pour les essais cliniques de DE en Chine
• Mobiliser scientifiquement les TAE chinois, les acteurs internes et externes de Roche
• Servir de point de contact scientifique avec les équipes mondiales de développement précoce des domaines thérapeutiques non oncologiques (immunologie, neurologie, CVRM, ophtalmologie)
• Mentor des directeurs médicaux juniors pour renforcer les capacités et les capacités du Conseil de l'Europe Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un MD ou d'un baccalauréat/maîtrise en médecine clinique avec au moins 3 ans de pratique clinique après l'obtention du diplôme; expertise clinique en immunologie préférée
• Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique et une expérience de développement précoce étendue, expérience de développement précoce en immunologie préférée
• Vous avez une expérience pratique du développement précoce du PDC, de la conception et du déroulement des essais cliniques de développement précoce, de l'interaction avec les autorités sanitaires, de la collaboration avec les chercheurs et les sites de recherche clinique, et de l'interprétation des données des essais cliniques de développement précoce
• Vous avez une très bonne compréhension des lignes directrices et des règlements mondiaux en matière de développement, y compris le CDE, la FDA et l'EMEA
• Vous êtes un communicateur efficace : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais, avec la capacité de présenter des concepts complexes aux équipes interfonctionnelles mondiales, aux comités de gouvernance et aux principales parties prenantes de manière logique et succincte

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Product Owner

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity

As a Technical Product Owner for our Source-to-Procure (S2P) ecosystem, you bridge the gap between technical execution and business objectives. Working at an advanced professional level alongside Senior Product Managers, you own the product backlog and drive the execution of our digital procurement roadmap. jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist - Quantum Chemistry

titleByLocale.it: Scienziato di apprendimento della macchina - Chimica quantistica
titleByLocale.fr: Scientifique en apprentissage automatique - Chimie quantique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the small-molecule team within AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), formerly Prescient Design, at Roche and Genentech’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Quantum Chemistry. You will combine machine learning methods and quantum chemistry to build fast, accurate models that power small-molecule drug discovery. You will work with world-class computational and experimental scientists and leverage proprietary datasets and state-of-the-art compute.

The Opportunity

• Create cutting-edge solutions that combine quantum chemistry and machine learning algorithm development to model small-molecule energetics and protein–ligand interactions, from conformation and reactivity to binding affinity and free energy.

• Build synthetic datasets using quantum mechanics and related methods to shape novel research directions in ML.

• Develop deployable pipelines that are robust, scalable and reproducible, and feed directly into molecular-design tools used across Roche.

• Drive scientific impact through publications, open-source releases, and talks at internal and external conferences.

• Collaborate widely with world-class computational and experimental researchers at Roche and with academic partners.

Who you are

• You bring deep machine-learning expertise with a strong theoretical foundation in linear algebra, probability and optimization, and you build models from first principles.

• You have hands-on quantum chemistry experience and fluency in toolkits such as Psi4, PySCF and ORCA, as well as semi-empirical methods like xTB.

• You are fluent in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.

• You hold a PhD or equivalent research depth in machine learning, computational chemistry, chemical engineering or a related quantitative field such as physics or statistics.

• You have a record of scientific excellence evidenced by journal and conference publications or a public portfolio of relevant projects (e.g. hosted on GitHub/GitLab).

Preferred

• Experience in scientific software development, scaling ML training, and applying models to drug discovery.

• Experience generating large-scale synthetic datasets.

Location & Travel Requirements

This position must be based in either Welwyn Garden City in the United Kingdom (preferred) or Basel, Switzerland. Although this can be a hybrid role, there is an expectation of ongoing and sustained site presence, in compliance with local company site requirements.

If building physics-grounded machine learning models that bring better medicines to patients faster is your calling, apply now and help shape the future of small-molecule drug discovery.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Unisciti al team di piccole-molecole all'interno di AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), precedentemente Prescient Design, presso il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Roche e Genentech come scienziato di apprendimento della macchina / scienziato di apprendimento della macchina senior in chimica quantistica. Combinate i metodi di apprendimento automatico e la chimica quantistica per costruire modelli veloci e accurati che alimentano la scoperta di droga di piccola molecola. Potrai lavorare con scienziati computazionali e sperimentali di livello mondiale e sfruttare i dataset proprietari e la computazione all'avanguardia. L'opportunità:
• Creare soluzioni all'avanguardia che combinano la chimica quantistica e lo sviluppo dell'algoritmo di machine learning per modellare l'energetica della piccola molecola e le interazioni della proteina-ligand, dalla conformazione e reattività all'affinità vincolante e alla libera energia.
• Costruire set di dati sintetici utilizzando meccanica quantistica e metodi correlati per modellare nuove direzioni di ricerca in ML.
• Sviluppare oleodotti dispiegabili robusti, scalabili e riproducibili, e alimentarsi direttamente in strumenti di progettazione molecolare utilizzati in Roche.
• Guidare l'impatto scientifico attraverso pubblicazioni, comunicati open source e colloqui a conferenze interne ed esterne.
• Collaborare ampiamente con ricercatori computazionali e sperimentali di livello mondiale a Roche e con partner accademici. Chi sei:
• Porti una profonda esperienza di machine-learning con una forte base teorica in algebra lineare, probabilità e ottimizzazione, e costruisci modelli dai primi principi.
• Hai esperienza di chimica quantistica pratica e fluidità in strumenti come Psi4, PySCF e ORCA, così come metodi semi-empirici come xTB.
• Sei fluente in Python e moderni framework ML come PyTorch o JAX.
• Ha una profondità di ricerca di dottorato o equivalente nell'apprendimento automatico, nella chimica computazionale, nell'ingegneria chimica o in un campo quantitativo correlato come la fisica o le statistiche.
• Hai un record di eccellenza scientifica evidenziato da pubblicazioni di riviste e conferenze o un portafoglio pubblico di progetti rilevanti (ad esempio ospitato su GitHub/GitLab). Preferito:
• Esperienza nello sviluppo del software scientifico, scalare la formazione ML e applicare modelli alla scoperta della droga.
• Esperienza generando set di dati sintetici su larga scala. Se la costruzione di modelli di machine learning basati sulla fisica che portano farmaci migliori ai pazienti più velocemente è la vostra chiamata, applicare ora e contribuire a modellare il futuro della scoperta di droga di piccola molecola. #ComputationCoE #tech4lifeComputationalScienza #tech4lifeAI Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Welwyn. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Le dichiarazioni di cui sopra sono destinate a descrivere la natura generale e il livello di lavoro svolto dai dipendenti, e non devono essere interpretate come una lista esaustiva

Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Die hierin enthaltenen Aussagen sollen die allgemeine Art und das Niveau der von den Mitarbeitern geleisteten Arbeit beschreiben und sind nicht als erschöpfende Liste von r zu verstehen.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management

The Head of Technology Vendor Management & Software Asset Management will lead RDT’s strategic technology vendor governance and Software Asset Management practice across a complex global technology landscape.

The role covers vendors across software, SaaS, cloud, platforms, on-premise infrastructure, infrastructure services and managed services. It is accountable for creating a transparent, stable, commercially disciplined and risk-managed vendor ecosystem.
This is a senior leadership role with responsibility for a large-scale technology vendor portfolio representing several hundred million CHF in spend and a team of around a dozen professionals.
The role combines vendor governance, SAM, licensing compliance, vendor risk management, service performance, operational stability, commercial oversight and senior stakeholder engagement.

Description of the area

Technology Vendor Management & Software Asset Management ensures that RDT’s critical technology vendors operate within clear standards, controls and performance expectations.
The function owns vendor governance frameworks and the SAM operating model, covering vendor lifecycle management, service performance, risk monitoring, license compliance, spend transparency and value realization.
It partners with RDT functions, IT, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Architecture and Operations to ensure technology vendor relationships are compliant, stable, cost-effective and aligned with enterprise priorities.

Job responsibilities:

• Lead the Technology Vendor Management and Software Asset Management function, including strategy, operating model, standards, governance forums and team development.

• Govern a high-value technology vendor ecosystem across software, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, platform and managed service providers.

• Define and implement baseline standards for technology vendor management, including SLAs, governance blueprint, escalation model, performance expectations and minimum control requirements.

• Own the SAM roadmap and lifecycle governance across entitlement, deployment, usage, compliance, optimization and remediation.

• Define and implement the technology vendor lifecycle model, from onboarding and classification through performance management, risk monitoring, renewal governance and exit planning.

• Establish dashboards and reporting for RDT leadership covering vendor performance, SAM status, license compliance, risk exposure, operational stability and key actions.

• Lead or coordinate vendor audit defense and remediation of licensing, contractual or compliance deviations.

• Drive software and technology spend optimization through usage analysis, renewal governance, license harvesting, reclaim, rightsizing, contract review and demand alignment.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on vendor risk, software compliance, licensing exposure, operational stability and technology vendor value.

Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in Technology Vendor Management, Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, supplier governance, software licensing, IT sourcing, technology procurement, service provider management or enterprise IT governance.

• Proven experience governing large-scale technology vendor portfolios involving complex contracts, critical vendors, material spend and senior stakeholder accountability.

• Strong understanding of vendor governance models, vendor lifecycle management, SLAs, perfor

Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Capo dei conti tecnologici e della gestione dei beni software Responsabile dei conti tecnologici e della gestione patrimoniale software (Practice Leader) è responsabile per la gestione integrata dei principali account tecnologici (Platform, Cloud e fornitori di software) e della pratica Software Asset Management (SAM). Potrai guidare un team responsabile per ottimizzare la spesa tecnologica, massimizzare il ROI e garantire una rigorosa conformità della licenza attraverso il paesaggio RDT. Questo ruolo richiede un mix distintivo di competenza tecnica negli stack tecnologici moderni e una profonda esperienza nel software di licensing e asset governance. Descrizione dell'Area Asset Management & Technology Accounts gestisce il ciclo di vita dei beni tecnologici di RDT. Questo include la governance dei principali partner tecnologici (ad esempio SAP, AWS, Microsoft) e l'esecuzione dei processi SAM per garantire la conformità e l'ottimizzazione finanziaria. Questa sotto-funzione garantisce che queste partnership di alto livello forniscono il massimo valore attraverso la governance strutturata, la gestione dei rischi e i quadri di miglioramento continuo. Mansioni - SAM Governance: proprio la roadmap funzionale per la gestione del patrimonio software. Assicurare l'intero ciclo di vita dei beni software è gestito per mantenere la conformità e minimizzare il rischio. - Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve come il principale contatto per i partner interni, gestendo attivamente le relazioni e le aspettative circa le prestazioni e i consegnabili della (sub-)funzione. Funziona a stretto contatto con le parti interessate IT e gli utenti interni per identificare, prioritizzare e affrontare le esigenze delle politiche, la loro operativizzazione e controlli associati. - Strategia dell'account tecnologico: Allineare le roadmap della tecnologia con l'architettura moderna (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) in ambienti regolamentati. - Asset Compliance: Guidare le valutazioni di rischio di tecnologia a livello aziendale e garantire una tempestiva bonifica dei risultati o delle deviazioni di licenze. - Esecuzione Operativa: implementare e supervisionare strumenti e processi per il monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e del diritto di licenza. - Eccellenza Operativa: Definire e monitorare i KPI/OKR per analizzare le prestazioni del fornitore. Utilizzare i dati per migliorare continuamente e ottimizzare il modello di consegna del servizio. - Team Leadership: Guidare e sviluppare un team di manager di account fornitori altamente performanti. Personale di mentore e garantire l'allineamento delle risorse con i requisiti di progetto RDT. - Influenza e collaborazione: collaborare a stretto contatto con Architettura, Sicurezza e Finanza per garantire che le piattaforme tecnologiche supportino in modo efficiente i processi aziendali critici.
• Requisiti - Istruzione/Esperienza: 10+ anni in IT Asset Management, Technology Sourcing o IT Operations. È richiesta un'esperienza di leadership in team multidisciplinari globali. - Competenze Funzionali: Forte comprensione dei paesaggi tecnologici moderni (Cloud, DevOps, Piattaforme digitali). Conoscenza esperta delle strutture SAM e dei principali modelli di licenza del fornitore. - Leadership: Capacità di condurre attraverso l'influenza e la partnership. Forte capacità di mentore un team tecnico in un ecosistema di stakeholder complesso e globale. Cosa? - Gamma di insalata 23.300 - 43.300 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro. - Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 20%). - Indennità di automobile o di automobile. - Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.). - Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile). - Prenda tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile. - Posizione Flex (possibilità) Contatto *(Nessun recapito fornito nel testo originale)*

jobs.description:

Buscamos un perfil dinámico, con un fuerte background técnico o comercial en el sector salud y una alta capacidad de influencia.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

F or the secondary locations the compensation data will be provided during the first interview.

INTERESED? APPLY!

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche? Check out our blog!
https://diagnostics.roc

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

F or the secondary locations the compensation data will be provided during the first interview.

INTERESED? APPLY!

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche? Check out our blog!
https://diagnostics.roc

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to spearhead the long-term category roadmap and command our high-value IT supplier landscape that drives the functioning of our Diagnostics Instruments? As our Global Category Manager for IT Software & Hardware in Sant Cugat, Spain (or in Indianapolis, U.S.), you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this rapidly evolving spend category. In this role, you will manage tier-one global technology providers, negotiate complex commercial frameworks, and translate category goals into bottom-line value creation.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category, Delivery, Procurement Center of Excellence, and global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are

We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of global IT Hardware and off-the-shelf software supply markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

• Experience: 5+ years of in-depth strategic and operational procu

descriptionByLocale.it:
La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove si è apprezzati, accettati e rispettati per chi si è, permettendo di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. È così che ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e di garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Da luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team multiculturale, siamo fonte, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo e eseguiamo strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente processi & digitalizzati che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se ami fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di Procurement ad alte prestazioni e di livello mondiale, questo è per te. Siamo DOP.

A Roche, ora facciamo quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno.

L'opportunità Sei pronto a guidare la roadmap a lungo termine della categoria e a gestire il nostro panorama di fornitori IT di alto valore che guida il funzionamento dei nostri strumenti diagnostici? Come nostro responsabile globale della categoria per il software IT e l'hardware a Sant Cugat, Spagna (o a Indianapolis, Stati Uniti), prenderai la responsabilità ultima per lo sviluppo di strategie e iniziative strategiche leader per questa categoria di spesa in rapida evoluzione. In questo ruolo, gestirai fornitori di tecnologia globali di livello uno, negozierai quadri commerciali complessi e tradurrai obiettivi di categoria in creazione di valore di base.

- Reporting Line: Direttamente reporting al Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT all'interno dell'organizzazione Category. - Wider Team e Stakeholder: Si occupa direttamente di team interfunzionali composti da rappresentanti di Category, Delivery, Procurement Center of Excellence e partner commerciali globali.

- Tipo di ruolo: un ruolo individuale di GPM con una posizione di leadership globale incentrata sulla visione strategica, sviluppo di categorie, costruzione di condotte e gestione dell'ecosistema di relazione - Impatto: si ottiene un impatto commerciale ancorando i costi e sviluppando un oleodotto di resilienza dei progetti, oltre a garantire le nostre priorità di sostenibilità. In particolare, si è responsabili per:

Responsabilità - Strategia e Conduttura Annuale: Riprendere informazioni di mercato, dati sui fornitori e requisiti aziendali per formulare una strategia e un'iniziativa di categoria formalizzate e globali, da allineare con i leader di tutta l'organizzazione. - Negoziati commerciali: negoziati commerciali e contrattuali di alto valore per i fornitori strategici della categoria. - Ecosistemi di fornitori: Gestione dei fornitori chiave a livello globale, creazione di programmi di sviluppo e innovazione, monitoraggio degli obiettivi di valore e gestione dei rischi dei fornitori.

- Guida e contenuto: sviluppare e mantenere documenti di orientamento di categoria per tradurre la strategia in contenuti chiari ed eseguibili per i colleghi di appalti e gli utenti aziendali. - Partnering di imprese: creare relazioni profonde con gli stakeholder più anziani, sfidare la domanda/specifiche per massimizzare il valore e gestire le valutazioni rischio/RSI. - Soprintendenza al team e al budget: allenare i colleghi di appalti, fornire sviluppo professionale, gestire un responsabile di categoria di saloni condivisi all'interno del team e monitorare la spesa di bilancio.

Chi sei Cerchiamo campioni di approvvigionamento strategico con una vasta conoscenza dei mercati globali di fornitura di hardware IT e software off-the-shelf e le competenze di leadership matrice necessarie per guidare cambiamenti organizzativi complessi.

Requisiti - Istruzione: Laurea richiesta (preferibile per le scienze aziendali o della vita); è preferibile una qualifica post-laurea relativa alle imprese. - Esperienza: 5+ anni di approfondimento strategico e operativo

- Rollentyp: Eine individuelle Rolle des Beitragsgebers mit globaler Führungsposition in der Kategorie, die sich auf strategische Vision, Kategorieentwicklung, Pipeline-Building und Beziehungsökosystemmanagement konzentriert - Auswirkungen: Sie erzielen wirtschaftliche Auswirkungen durch die Verankerung von Kosten und die Entwicklung einer Resilienz-Pipeline von Projekten, zusätzlich zur Sicherung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsprioritäten. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:

Verantwortung - Strategie & Jährliche Pipeline: Zusammentragen von Marktinformationen, Lieferantendaten und Geschäftsanforderungen, um eine formalisierte, globale Kategorie Strategie und Initiative Pipeline zu formulieren, die mit führenden Unternehmen in der gesamten Organisation abgestimmt werden soll. - Kommerzielle Verhandlungen: Führende kommerzielle und vertragliche Verhandlungen für strategische Lieferanten innerhalb der Kategorie. - Lieferanten Ecosystems: Managing Key Global Lieferanten, Aufbau von Entwicklungs- und Innovationsprogrammen, Überwachung von Wertzielen und Management von Lieferantenrisiken.

- Beratung & Inhalt: Entwicklung und Pflege von Leitfäden für die Kategorie, um Strategie in klare, ausführbare Inhalte für Beschaffungskollegen und Business-Nutzer zu übersetzen. - Business Partnering: Aufbau tiefer Beziehungen zu hochrangigen Stakeholdern, anspruchsvolle Nachfrage/Spezifikationen zur Maximierung des Wertes und Management von Risiko/CSR-Reviews. - Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching von Beschaffungskollegen, professionelle Entwicklung, Verwaltung eines geteilten Associate Category Managers im Team und Verfolgung von Budgetausgaben.

Wer Sie sind Wir suchen strategische Beschaffungs-Champions mit umfassenden Kenntnissen der globalen IT-Hardware- und Software-Versorgungsmärkte und den für den komplexen organisatorischen Wandel erforderlichen Führungskompetenzen der Matrix.

- Ausbildung: Hochschulabschluss erforderlich (vorzugsweise Schwerpunkt Business oder Life Sciences); eine betriebswirtschaftliche Qualifikation nach dem Studium wird bevorzugt. - Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre umfassende strategische und operative Erfahrung

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every patient deserves a personalized healthcare solution. As the IT Strategic Risk & Audit Manager , you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our digital evolution—from AI-driven drug discovery to personalized healthcare apps—is built on a foundation of trust and resilience. You will act as a strategic partner to Digital Technology leaders, ensuring that risks are managed proactively rather than reactively.
This role moves beyond tactical "checkbox" auditing to focus on strategic foresight —anticipating shifts in the threat landscape, regulatory environment, and emerging technologies (like AI and Cloud architecture)

Job Responsibilities

Scope / (Content Leadership): Defines the strategic vision for IT risk, audit, and compliance, and drives strategic initiatives for long-term risk management success. Initiates and leads large, complex projects with a significant impact on the organization. Leads the development of enterprise-wide risk and compliance policies and advises on emerging trends and best practices.

• Strategic Risk Architecture & Vision: Define and architect the global IT Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), aligning long-term digital strategy with Roche’s risk appetite to ensure "Compliance by Design" across complex, interconnected global portfolios.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of highly complex business and risk challenges with significant organizational impact, proactively identifying potential strategic issues within your sphere of influence. Develops comprehensive risk management and compliance policies, implements proactive measures to avoid repeated issues, and leads initiatives to anticipate and mitigate future risks. Contributes to framing strategic questions and facilitates strategic decision-making at the executive level.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders at the executive level and external partners, analyzing enterprise-wide stakeholder landscapes. Leads enterprise-wide risk, audit, and compliance initiatives, presenting them to executive leadership to secure support and strategic alignment for risk-related investments. Navigates highly complex and politically sensitive landscapes, acting as an organizational trust builder and providing expert counsel on critical strategic decisions.

• E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership: Lead the full lifecycle of complex IT audits and continuous monitoring programs across infrastructure and applications, ensuring the organization meets global regulatory requirements while proactively identifying systemic issues to prevent recurrence.

• Inspection Command & Control: Serve as the primary IT liaison during complex Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, etc.), leading "Front-Room/Back-Room" operations, coaching SMEs in regulatory interview techniques, and ensuring the rapid delivery of high-quality, validated evidence.

• Data Integrity & ALCOA+ Systematically audit and enforce the "Digital Thread" to ensure all health-regulated data remains Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, and Accurate, maintaining the integrity of life-saving digital health solutions.

• Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management: Navigate sensitive landscapes to lead enterprise-wide risk initiatives, partnering with IT owners to develop robust remediation CAPAs and innovating risk management approaches to drive lasting, transformative impact across the global org

descriptionByLocale.it:
La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove si è apprezzati, accettati e rispettati per chi si è, permettendo di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. È così che ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e di garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione di Roche, crediamo che ogni paziente meriti una soluzione sanitaria personalizzata. Come responsabile strategico del rischio e dell'audit IT, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire che la nostra evoluzione digitale.dalla scoperta di farmaci a base di AI ad applicazioni sanitarie personalizzate.è basata su una base di fiducia e resilienza. Tu agirai come partner strategico per i leader della tecnologia digitale, assicurando che i rischi siano gestiti in modo proattivo piuttosto che reattivo.

Questo ruolo va oltre il controllo tattico "checkbox" per concentrarsi sulla prospettiva strategica.Anticipando cambiamenti nel paesaggio di minaccia, ambiente normativo e tecnologie emergenti (come l'architettura AI e Cloud)

Responsabilità del lavoro

Ambito / (Content Leadership) - Definisce la visione strategica per il rischio IT, audit, e conformità, e guida iniziative strategiche per il successo di gestione del rischio a lungo termine. - Inizia e conduce grandi progetti complessi con un impatto significativo sull'organizzazione. - Guida lo sviluppo di politiche di rischio e conformità a livello aziendale e consiglia le tendenze emergenti e le best practice.

Strategic Risk Architecture & Vision - Define and architect the global IT Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), allineando la strategia digitale a lungo termine con l'appetito al rischio di Roche per garantire l'"Compliance by Design" in portafogli globali complessi e interconnessi.

Responsabilità/Problema di soluzione - Guida l'analisi di sfide aziendali e di rischio estremamente complesse con un impatto organizzativo significativo, identificando proattivamente potenziali questioni strategiche all'interno della vostra sfera di influenza. - Sviluppa politiche complete di gestione del rischio e conformità, implementa misure proattive per evitare problemi ripetuti e porta le iniziative ad anticipare e mitigare i rischi futuri. - Contribuisce a formulare domande strategiche e facilita il processo decisionale strategico a livello esecutivo.

Gestione delle parti interessate - Identifica e coinvolge i principali stakeholder a livello esecutivo e partner esterni, analizzando i paesaggi delle parti interessate a livello aziendale. - Leader di iniziative di rischio, audit e compliance aziendali, presentandoli alla leadership esecutiva per garantire il supporto e l'allineamento strategico per gli investimenti legati al rischio. - Navigates paesaggi estremamente complessi e politicamente sensibili, fungendo da costruttore di trust organizzativo e fornendo consulenza su decisioni strategiche critiche.

E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership - Guidare l'intero ciclo di vita di audit informatici complessi e programmi di monitoraggio continuo attraverso infrastrutture e applicazioni, assicurando che l'organizzazione soddisfi i requisiti normativi globali, identificando proattivamente le questioni sistemiche per prevenire le ricorrenza.

Comando e controllo delle ispezioni - Serve come collegamento informatico primario durante complesse ispezioni dell'Autorità Sanitaria (FDA, EMA, ecc.), operazioni "Front-Room/Back-Room" di testa, coaching delle PMI nelle tecniche di intervista regolamentare e garanzia di una rapida consegna di prove convalidate di alta qualità.

Integrità dei dati & ALCOA+ - Verificare e far rispettare il "File Digitale" per garantire che tutti i dati regolati dalla salute rimangano Attribuibili, Legibili, Conterneous, Originali e Accurati, mantenendo l'integrità delle soluzioni di salute digitale salvavita.

Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management - Navigare paesaggi sensibili per guidare iniziative di rischio a livello aziendale, collaborando con i proprietari IT per sviluppare solide CAPA di bonifica e innovando approcci di gestione del rischio per guidare l'impatto duraturo e trasformativo attraverso l'orgasmo globale

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. Sie werden als strategischer Partner der führenden Unternehmen der Digital Technology agieren und sicherstellen, dass Risiken proaktiv und nicht reaktiv verwaltet werden.

Diese Rolle geht über die taktische "Checkbox"-Prüfung hinaus, um sich auf strategische Voraussicht zu konzentrieren – vorausschauende Veränderungen in der Bedrohungslandschaft, dem regulatorischen Umfeld und neuen Technologien (wie KI- und Cloud-Architektur)

Aufgaben

Scope / (Content Leadership) - Definiert die strategische Vision für IT-Risiko, Audit und Compliance und treibt strategische Initiativen für langfristigen Risikomanagement-Erfolg voran. - Initiiert und leitet große, komplexe Projekte mit erheblichen Auswirkungen auf die Organisation. - Leitet die Entwicklung unternehmensweiter Risiko- und Compliance-Politiken und berät zu neuen Trends und Best Practices.

Strategische Risikoarchitektur & Vision - Definieren und gestalten Sie das globale IT Enterprise Risikomanagement (ERM) Framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), das die langfristige digitale Strategie mit dem Risikohunger von Roche abstimmt, um "Compliance by Design" in komplexen, vernetzten globalen Portfolios sicherzustellen.

Accountability/Problem Solving - Führt die Analyse hochkomplexer Geschäfts- und Risikoherausforderungen mit signifikanter organisatorischer Wirkung, um proaktiv strategische Fragen in Ihrem Einflussbereich zu identifizieren. - Entwickelt umfassende Risikomanagement- und Compliance-Politiken, setzt proaktive Maßnahmen um, um wiederholte Probleme zu vermeiden, und führt Initiativen zur Antizipation und Minderung künftiger Risiken. - Hilft bei der Formulierung strategischer Fragen und erleichtert strategische Entscheidungsfindung auf der Führungsebene.

Das Projekt hat die Aufgabe, die wichtigsten Stakeholder auf der Führungsebene und externe Partner zu identifizieren und zu engagieren, um unternehmensweite Stakeholderlandschaften zu analysieren. - Leitet unternehmensweite Risiko-, Audit- und Compliance-Initiativen, um sie der Führungsspitze zu präsentieren, um die Unterstützung und strategische Ausrichtung für risikobezogene Investitionen zu sichern. - Navigiert hochkomplexe und politisch sensible Landschaften, fungiert als Organisations-Trustbuilder und bietet kompetente Beratung bei kritischen strategischen Entscheidungen.

E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership - Führen Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus komplexer IT-Audits und kontinuierlicher Monitoring-Programme in Infrastruktur und Anwendungen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Organisation globalen regulatorischen
• Anforderungen entspricht und proaktiv systemische Probleme identifiziert, um Wiederholungen zu verhindern.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
A propos de Roche Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés par les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement.

La position Chez Roche, nous croyons que chaque patient mérite une solution de santé personnalisée. En tant que gestionnaire de risques et d'audits stratégiques en TI, vous jouerez un rôle central pour faire en sorte que notre évolution numérique – de la découverte de médicaments à l'IA aux applications de soins personnalisés – repose sur la confiance et la résilience.

Ce rôle va au-delà de l'audit tactique « case à cocher » pour se concentrer sur la prospective stratégique – les changements anticipés dans le paysage de la menace, l'environnement réglementaire et les technologies émergentes (comme l'IA et l'architecture Cloud)

Responsabilités professionnelles

Portée / ( Leadership en matière de contenu) - Définir la vision stratégique en matière de risque, de vérification et de conformité en matière de TI et diriger les initiatives stratégiques pour assurer la réussite à long terme de la gestion des risques. - Initie et dirige des projets complexes de grande envergure ayant une incidence importante sur l'organisation. - Dirige l'élaboration de politiques de gestion des risques et de conformité à l'échelle de l'organisation et donne des conseils sur les nouvelles tendances et les pratiques exemplaires.

Architecture et vision des risques stratégiques - Définir et concevoir le cadre mondial de gestion des risques d'entreprise des TI (RTM) (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), en harmonisant la stratégie numérique à long terme avec l'appétit de Roche pour le risque afin d'assurer la « conformité par la conception » à l'échelle de portefeuilles mondiaux complexes et interconnectés.

Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes - Dirige l'analyse des défis opérationnels et des risques très complexes ayant une incidence organisationnelle importante, en identifiant de façon proactive les problèmes stratégiques potentiels dans votre sphère d'influence. - Élaborer des politiques globales de gestion et de conformité des risques, mettre en oeuvre des mesures proactives pour éviter les problèmes répétés et mener des initiatives pour prévoir et atténuer les risques futurs. - Contribue à l'établissement de questions stratégiques et facilite la prise de décisions stratégiques au niveau des cadres de direction.

Gestion des intervenants - Identifier et mobiliser les intervenants clés au niveau de la direction et des partenaires externes, en analysant les paysages des intervenants à l'échelle de l'entreprise. - Diriger les initiatives de gestion des risques, de vérification et de conformité à l'échelle de l'entreprise, en les présentant aux dirigeants pour obtenir un soutien et un alignement stratégique pour les investissements liés aux risques. - Navigue les paysages très complexes et politiquement sensibles, en agissant comme bâtisseur de confiance organisationnelle et en fournissant des conseils d'experts sur les décisions stratégiques critiques.

Leadership en matière de vérification et de conformité E2E - Diriger le cycle de vie complet des vérifications complexes des TI et des programmes de surveillance continue dans l'ensemble de l'infrastructure et des applications, en veillant à ce que l'organisation respecte les exigences réglementaires mondiales tout en identifiant de façon proactive les problèmes systémiques afin d'éviter que les problèmes ne se reproduisent.

Contrôle et commandement des inspections - servir de liaison principale en TI lors des inspections complexes des autorités sanitaires (ADF, EMA, etc.), diriger les opérations « Chambre avant/salle arrière », entraîner les PME dans les techniques d'entrevue réglementaire et assurer la livraison rapide de preuves validées de haute qualité.

Intégrité des données et ALCOA+ - Audit systématique et application du « fil numérique » pour s'assurer que toutes les données réglementées par la santé demeurent Attributables, lisibles, contemporaines, originales et précises, en maintenant l'intégrité des solutions de santé numériques qui sauvent la vie.

Gestion mondiale des intervenants et de la transformation - Naviguer dans des paysages sensibles pour diriger des initiatives de gestion des risques à l'échelle de l'entreprise, en partenariat avec les propriétaires de TI pour élaborer des APC robustes en matière d'assainissement et en innovant des approches de gestion des risques pour favoriser des impacts durables et transformatifs dans l'ensemble de l'organisation mondiale

Design as an expert in cooperation with internal and external stakeholders You interact with different stakeholders and make IFM a value-driven management and service framework for our locations.

• You have successfully completed university studies (Master or Bachelor) in Business Engineering, Facility Management, Business Administration or a comparable field of study.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Solution Architect - DIA R&D

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a specific solution context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

Technical Skills

• General and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas.

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for solutions and interfaces.

• Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions.

• Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for the solution, including conducting vendor assessments.

Additional Qualifications

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain difficult or sensitive information and successfully build consensus.

• Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improve existing solutions, and manage technical deb

The Position

Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader for the Master Data Data Product, you will be a vital member of the MRHub Team within the Data Management & Data Quality Platforms department. titleByLocale.fr: Clinical Selling Spécialiste - Toledo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Clinician Selling Specialist , desempeñarás un papel fundamental en impulsar la adopción de nuestros biomarcadores y soluciones innovadoras dentro de las comunidades clínicas. Construirás relaciones sólidas con líderes de opinión clave (KOLs), investigadores y proveedores de atención médica para avanzar en nuestra misión de mejorar los resultados de los pacientes a través de la medicina personalizada y una mejor gestión de enfermedades crónicas.

En este rol, serás la persona de referencia para aspectos clínicos y técnicos en el área de Castilla-La Mancha . Serás responsable de promover nuestras soluciones con un enfoque técnico-científico, adaptando las estrategias globales a la realidad local de la Atención Primaria y los centros especializados, asegurando que nuestras innovaciones lleguen a los pacientes adecuados en el momento adecuado.

Tus Responsabilidades Clave

• Ventas Estratégicas y Promoción Técnica: Promover productos y servicios con mensajes científicos diferenciadores. Negociarás con centros de salud y hospitales, proporcionando explicaciones técnicas de alto nivel centradas en el tratamiento y la gestión del paciente.

• Enfoque en Atención Primaria y Diabetes: Serás un socio clave para los proveedores de Atención Primaria, especialmente en el contexto de la Diabetes , promoviendo las ventas con un enfoque orientado al tratamiento e identificando nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro de las cuentas existentes.

• Participación de las Partes Interesadas: Identificar y cultivar una red de defensores (KOLs, Líderes Clínicos, Directores Médicos). Adaptarás los planes de ventas para satisfacer sus necesidades y comunicarás las implicaciones de las licitaciones públicas al Gerente de Zona.

• Formación Clínica: Educar al personal de enfermería y a los profesionales de la salud tanto en hospitales como en centros de Atención Primaria sobre el uso del producto, coordinando la participación de las enfermeras en los protocolos de atención al paciente.

• Experiencia Científica: Actuar como el experto local, presentando las soluciones de Roche en foros regionales y simposios. Te mantendrás actualizado sobre las regulaciones IVDR y los algoritmos de gestión de pacientes.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Recopilar y compartir información sobre tendencias del mercado y competencia. Implementarás campañas de marketing y colaborarás con los Gerentes de Producto en actividades promocionales locales (congresos, talleres, etc.).

• Inversión y ROI: Proponer e implementar inversiones en tu territorio basadas en un retorno (ROI) definido y asegurar que se cumplan todos los compromisos con el cliente.

• Movilidad: Este puesto requiere una alta presencia en campo, con viajes esperados dentro del área designada (Castilla-La Mancha) 70+% del tiempo.

Quién Eres
Buscamos un perfil científico con una fuerte enfoque comercial y experiencia en el ecosistema sanitario local.

• Educación: Se necesita Licenciatura. Se valorará altamente la Licenciatura en Ciencias.

• Experiencia: 3 a 5 años de experiencia en la industria de ciencias de la vida. Es esencial una experiencia probada en Atención Primaria.

• Experiencia en la Materia: Se valora profundamente el conocimiento o la experiencia en Diabetes.

• Construcción de Relaciones: Gran capacidad para construir y mantener relaciones con profesionales de la salud a todos los niveles.

• Idiomas: Se valora mucho la fluidez en español ; un dominio sólido del inglés es obligatorio para la colaboración global.

• Ubicación: D

Technical Product Owner - Legal - RDT Group Functions

We are looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner to partner with Business Product Owners and stakeholders in Legal to translate requirements into strategic digital solutions. You will work closely with the IT Product Manager to shape the strategic vision, roadmap, and delivery of Legal-related products within Roche. This includes supporting platforms that span global teams across both Pharma and Diagnostics.

The Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner will play a key role in analyzing complex business processes, identifying optimization opportunities, and enabling the automation and digitization of workflows - ranging from review and approval to oversight, monitoring, and governance frameworks - while ensuring alignment with the "One Roche" philosophy.

Sitting within the broader Legal, Compliance & Group Communication division, our team partners with the Legal department to enable efficiency and effectiveness through legal-specific solutions. Working hand-in-hand, we blend IT expertise with business know-how to support Legal at every step of their digital journey.

The Legal Product portfolio covers solutions for legal spend and matter management, document management, and contract management, as well as workflows and reporting. We handle the entire lifecycle of these solutions - whether we build (make) or buy, manage, or operate them.
