• Conduct detailed discovery and analysis of processes across legal global teams to identify current pain points, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.

• Translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications and technical requirements for development teams.

• Develop comprehensive business cases and impact assessments for legal products, quantifying benefits (cost reduction, time savings, risk mitigation) aligned to organizational goals.

• Create and maintain detailed process maps, workflow diagrams, and requirements documentation to ensure shared understanding across stakeholders.

Strategic Alignment & Partnership

• Collaborate with the Business Product Owner to define product strategies and outcomes that address organizational business objectives.

• Actively contribute to the global legal technology strategy through technical insights and feasibility analysis, including the development and alignment of long-term goals (e.g., Data Domain & AI-driven solutions).

• Partner with external vendors and internal teams across Roche to assess existing platforms, propose innovative approaches, and ensure optimal solutions for Legal Products.

• Conduct gap analysis between current state processes and target state solutions to inform product roadmap decisions.

• Partner con fornitori esterni e team interni di Roche per valutare le piattaforme esistenti, proporre approcci innovativi e garantire soluzioni ottimali per i prodotti legali.
• Condurre l'analisi del gap tra i processi attuali dello stato e le soluzioni di stato di destinazione per informare le decisioni della roadmap del prodotto. Selezione e gestione dei requisiti
• Collaborare con il Product Manager e il Business Owner sulle valutazioni dei fornitori definendo requisiti funzionali e tecnici, valutando le funzionalità del software e contribuendo a criteri tecnici esperti alla richiesta di proposte (RFP).

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Propriétaire de produit technique - Légal - RDT Group Fonctions Nous sommes à la recherche d'un analyste technique d'affaires et propriétaire de produit expérimenté pour nous associer avec les propriétaires de produits d'affaires et les intervenants en droit afin de traduire les exigences en solutions numériques stratégiques. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le gestionnaire de produits informatiques pour définir la vision stratégique, la feuille de route et la livraison des produits liés au droit au sein de Roche. Cela inclut les plateformes de soutien qui couvrent les équipes mondiales à la fois Pharma et Diagnostics. L'analyste technique des affaires et le propriétaire du produit joueront un rôle clé dans l'analyse des processus opérationnels complexes, dans l'identification des possibilités d'optimisation et dans l'automatisation et la numérisation des workflows - allant de l'examen et de l'approbation aux cadres de surveillance, de surveillance et de gouvernance - tout en assurant l'alignement avec la philosophie « One Roche ». À propos de notre équipe: RDT Legal Product Siégeant au sein de la division juridique, Compliance & Communication de groupe, notre équipe s'associe au département juridique pour permettre l'efficience et l'efficacité grâce à des solutions juridiques spécifiques. Travaillant main dans la main, nous mélangeons l'expertise informatique avec le savoir-faire d'affaires pour soutenir Legal à chaque étape de leur parcours numérique. Le portefeuille de produits juridiques couvre les solutions pour la gestion légale des dépenses et des matières, la gestion des documents et la gestion des contrats, ainsi que les flux de travail et les rapports. Nous gérons tout le cycle de vie de ces solutions - que nous construisions (make) ou les achetions, les gérons ou les exploitions. Principales responsabilités Exigences opérationnelles et analyse des processus
• Effectuer la découverte et l'analyse détaillées des processus entre les équipes juridiques mondiales pour identifier les points de douleur actuels, les inefficacités et les possibilités d'amélioration.
• Traduire les exigences opérationnelles complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et exigences techniques pour les équipes de développement.
• Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation et des analyses d'impact complètes pour les produits juridiques, quantifier les avantages (réduction des coûts, économies de temps, atténuation des risques) alignés sur les objectifs organisationnels.
• Créer et tenir à jour des cartes de processus détaillées, des diagrammes de flux de travail et de la documentation sur les exigences afin d'assurer une compréhension partagée entre les intervenants. Alignement stratégique et partenariat
• Collaborer avec le propriétaire du produit d'entreprise pour définir des stratégies et des résultats qui répondent aux objectifs opérationnels de l'organisation.
• Contribuer activement à la stratégie mondiale en matière de technologies juridiques au moyen d'études techniques et d'analyses de faisabilité, y compris l'élaboration et l'alignement d'objectifs à long terme (par exemple, les solutions axées sur le domaine des données et l'IA).
• Partenaire avec des fournisseurs externes et des équipes internes à Roche pour évaluer les plateformes existantes, proposer des approches innovantes et garantir des solutions optimales pour les produits juridiques.
• Effectuer une analyse des écarts entre les processus actuels de l'État et les solutions de l'État cible pour éclairer les décisions relatives à la feuille de route des produits. Gestion de la sélection des fournisseurs et des besoins
• Collaborer avec le gestionnaire de produit et le propriétaire d'entreprise à l'évaluation des fournisseurs en définissant les exigences fonctionnelles et techniques, en évaluant les capacités logicielles et en fournissant des critères techniques spécialisés à la demande de propositions.
• Renforcer la confiance et agir comme interface clé entre Roche et les fournisseurs de services externes pour assurer la prestation de valeur, la faisabilité et l'alignement sur les normes Roche.
• S'engager étroitement avec les Approvisionnements pour adopter les bonnes pratiques de Roche et veiller à ce qu'une diligence raisonnable suffisante soit appliquée, non seulement sur le plan fonctionnel et technique, mais aussi pour assurer la sécurité et la protection de la vie privée

The Principal Enterprise Architect for Data & AI provides essential architectural oversight, visionary leadership, and strategic guidance across a Cross-Domain context. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture, this highly impactful role is specifically designed to architect and oversee Roche’s largest, most promising AI and Data use cases that span across multiple functions (Pharma R&D, Pharma Medicines, Diagnostics, Group Functions, Data, AI, EPIE, Information Security).
In this role, you will act as a principal orchestrator across the broader global architecture community. Rather than focusing on a single sub-function, you will guide cross-domain alignment to balance enterprise coherence with functional autonomy. By architecting scalable Data & AI ecosystems and defining the "digital laws" that govern them, you will safely accelerate the adoption of high-value AI capabilities while actively preventing technological fragmentation and agentic chaos.

The Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) Enterprise Architecture function shapes, aligns, and executes technology strategy by connecting business ambition to investment, architecture, and delivery. For this specific role, a primary domain is Informatics (RDT scope), alongside other complex cross-enterprise domains.
You will partner closely with the RDT Artificial Intelligence and RDT Data functions to bridge overarching enterprise strategy with tangible technology execution. While you will support our vertical business facing functions to implement the most complex AI solutions you will ensure that foundational AI models, data products, and agentic workflows are built for enterprise-wide reuse, aligning closely with the ambitious RDT Excellence goals to simplify our landscape and drive value through digital synergy.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Enterprise Architect

The Principal Enterprise Architect provides essential architectural oversight, visionary leadership, and strategic guidance across a broad Cross-Domain context. In this highly impactful role, you will take on the most complex, cross-functional topics that span multiple business and technology areas.
A significant focus of your mandate will be architecting "RDT as a Business" (Informatics Domain), treating our internal Roche Digital Technology organization as a critical business line. Your scope will also encompass other overarching enterprise initiatives across and beyond RDT. You will guide others in resolving highly complex issues and problems that have widespread implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes.

Description of the area

The Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) Enterprise Architecture function shapes, aligns, and executes technology strategy by connecting business ambition to investment, architecture, and delivery. For this specific role, a primary domain is Informatics (RDT scope), alongside other complex cross-enterprise domains.
You will partner closely with operational leaders, the Transformation Office, RDT Excellence, and Portfolio Management to establish a modern, integrated operating model. This area ensures that operations are built on insight generation and adhere to industry standards (e.g., IT4IT, ITIL), establishing robust architecture support for strategic internal and cross-functional initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

• Architecting the North Star for "RDT as a Business": Define target-state architectures and capability models for RDT's internal operations. Take ownership of defining and evolving the RDT Application and Technology Landscape and Data Model, ensuring robust architecture support for strategic internal initiatives.

• Operating Model optimization: Actively support the evolution of the Operating Model and integrating its elements (eg. Strategy, Portfolio, Delivery, Operations). Shift the organization toward Data-Driven Portfolio Management and Agile, AI enabled Delivery and Operations, ensuring connection to our existing IT landscape assets and providing traceability.

• Architecture Governance & Standards ("Enable & Govern"): Lead architecture governance for Informatics Domain and drive cross-domain alignment across Information, Technology, Business, and Application Architecture. Provide clarity, "paved roads," and guardrails that enable speed and effectiveness in delivery rather than creating bureaucratic friction.

• Tackling Complex Cross-Functional Topics: Guide matrixed teams in resolving the most complex cross-functional issues with broad implications on organizational processes and outcomes. Act as the architectural lead for major cross-domain initiatives that span beyond a single function, ensuring cohesive target architectures across the enterprise.

• Cross-Domain Coherence & Technical Debt Management: Conduct rigorous architectural impact assessments for cross-domain initiatives. Actively manage technical debt and support Future State Architecture by systematically simplifying the application landscape, decommissioning redundant systems, and establishing governance to prevent future complexity.

Informazioni su Roche

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso alla sanità oggi e per le generazioni future. Entra a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Architetto d'impresa

Il Principal Enterprise Architect fornisce una supervisione architettonica essenziale, una leadership visionaria e una guida strategica in un ampio contesto trasversale. In questo ruolo estremamente importante, assumerai i temi più complessi e multifunzionali che coprono molteplici aree aziendali e tecnologiche.

Un obiettivo significativo del vostro mandato sarà l'architettura di "RDT come Business" (Informatics Domain), che tratta la nostra organizzazione interna della tecnologia digitale come una linea di business critica. Il vostro scopo includerà anche altre iniziative aziendali generali attraverso e oltre RDT. Si guiderà altri nella risoluzione di problemi e problemi altamente complessi che hanno implicazioni diffuse sui processi e i risultati organizzativi cross-funzionali.

Descrizione della zona

La strategia, il portafoglio e la governance (SPS) Enterprise Architecture definisce, allinea ed esegue una strategia tecnologica collegando l'ambizione delle imprese agli investimenti, all'architettura e alla fornitura. Per questo ruolo specifico, un dominio primario è l'informatica (scope

Con il vostro partner di gruppo, l'Ufficio di Trasformazione, RDT Excellence e Portfolio Management, creeranno un modello operativo moderno e integrato, che garantirà che le operazioni siano basate sulla generazione di informazioni e si attengano agli standard del settore (ad esempio IT4IT, ITIL), stabilendo un solido supporto architettonico per iniziative strategiche interne e interfunzionali.

Responsabilità del lavoro

- Architettare la Stella Nord per "L'impresa" "L'impresa": definire architetture di target-stato e modelli di capacità per le operazioni interne dell'impresa. Assumersi la responsabilità di definire e sviluppare il modello di Landscape e dati sugli applicativi e tecnologici RDT, garantendo un solido supporto per l'architettura per iniziative strategiche interne.

- Ottimizzazione del Modello Operativo: supporta attivamente l'evoluzione del Modello Operativo e integra i suoi elementi (ad esempio Strategia, Portfolio, Consegna, Operazioni).Spostare l'organizzazione verso Data-Driven Portfolio Management e Agile, AI abilitato Delivery and Operations, garantendo la connessione ai nostri asset di paesaggio IT esistenti e fornendo tracciabilità.

- Architecture Governance & Standards ("Abilita & Governance"): Lead architecture governance for Informatica Dominio e guidare l'allineamento tra i domini attraverso l'Architettura delle Informazioni, Tecnologia, Business e Application. Fornire chiarezza, "strade asfaltate" e guardrails che consentono velocità ed efficacia nella consegna piuttosto che creare attrito burocratico.

- Affrontare i temi trasversali del complesso: guidare i team a matrice nella risoluzione dei problemi cross-funzionali più complessi con ampie implicazioni sui processi e sui risultati organizzativi. Agire come leader architettonico per importanti iniziative interdominiali che vanno oltre una singola funzione, garantendo architetture target coesive in tutta l'impresa.

- Coerenza tra i settori e gestione del debito tecnico: effettuare valutazioni d'impatto architettonico rigorose per iniziative trasversali. Gestire attivamente il debito tecnico e sostenere la futura architettura dello Stato semplificando sistematicamente il paesaggio delle applicazioni, disattivando i sistemi ridondanti e creando una governance per prevenire la complessità futura.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

Operating within an innovation-driven biotech environment, our Technology department (RDT) sits at the intersection of regulatory compliance, quality systems, risk management, and digital transformation. We focus on defining and managing governance frameworks, policies, and processes that ensure our technology platforms—supporting both GxP and non-GxP critical business processes—operate in full compliance with internal standards and external regulations. Our mission is to embed compliance by design, strengthening the quality and risk posture of our systems while simultaneously enabling speed, scalability, and technological innovation. In this collaborative environment, we partner closely with Business Quality, Regulatory, Security, Legal, and Audit functions to advise executives and drive enterprise-wide strategy.

As the Head of Compliance and Quality Governance (Practice Leader), you will be accountable for the entire lifecycle of this critical function, from strategic planning and service design to operational execution and continuous improvement. Operating as a senior escalation and decision authority, you will define the functional vision, strategy, and roadmap, transforming business needs into tangible, high-value capabilities. Leveraging a distinctive combination of deep domain expertise, technical proficiency, and business insight, you will lead multidisciplinary teams to build and deliver desirable, viable, and sustainable functional services that meet the evolving needs of our users while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

The Opportunity

• Strategy & Vision: Define and own the Technology Compliance & Quality Governance strategy, establishing clear governance frameworks, decision models, and accountabilities while translating global biotech regulations and corporate policies into clear technology outcomes.

• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted partner and senior escalation authority for executives, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Security leadership, representing Technology in executive forums, audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions.

• Risk Management & Assurance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and compliance maturity evaluations, ensuring timely and effective remediation of findings, deviations, and CAPAs.

• Team Leadership & Development: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing global team of professionals, fostering a culture of accountability and transparency while guiding senior leaders on risk-based decision-making.

• Operational Excellence & Improvement: Define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs) and leverage data analytics to drive informed decisions, immediate operational improvements, and strategic optimizations to achieve business goals.

• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the immediate team's budget and resources, developing detailed business cases—including cost-benefit analyses and resource estimates—for new functional initiatives and significant process changes.

Who You Are

• Experienced Global Leader: You bring 15+ years of IT domain experience, including 10+ years managing global multidisciplinary teams and 10+ years in Technology, Compliance, Q

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity

​ Accelerate Your Career in Precision Medicine If you are looking to transition from traditional medical sales into the frontier of genomic innovation, this permanent role offers the perfect platform for your professional evolution. As part of the Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) team within Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, this role is based in Lahore and will cover the Central and North regions. Reporting directly to the Business Manager for FMI, you won't just be managing a territory—you will be building a market, expanding your strategic business acumen, and establishing yourself as a leading expert in comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP).

• The primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche : Own your territory and build high-level partnerships by serving as the trusted, expert face of Foundation Medicine (FMI) for prominent Oncologists, Pathologists, and multidisciplinary tumor boards across the Central and North regions.

• Responsible for Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs : Champion the scientific adoption of FMI's cutting-edge genomic testing portfolio, directly influencing personalized healthcare pathways.

• Disease landscape understanding and products knowledge : Sharpen your scientific expertise by mastering complex molecular oncology, precision diagnostics, and genomic data to consult confidently with top-tier medical experts.

• Responsibility of Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support its appropriate use : Step up to the challenge of managing regional commercial targets, honing your data-driven territory planning and execution skills.

• Broad understanding of his/her therapeutic area and its respective future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions: Grow into a strategic leader by collaborating directly with the FMI Business Manager to co-create regional business blueprints, analyze market dynamics, and map long-term institutional accounts.

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community : Develop sophisticated problem-solving skills as you work across complex hospital ecosystems to streamline genomic testing workflows from sample to report.

• Awareness of disease Diagnosis : Position yourself as a thought leader by educating clinicians on the paradigm-shifting value of comprehensive genomic profiling over traditional testing.

• HCP education (pre-approved & post-approved products) : Expand your professional presentation and leadership skills by driving scientific roundtables, medical meetings, and clinical case reviews.

• Patients’ Access to available funds e.g PBM/SSP & others : Gain valuable experience in healthcare market access by exploring and leveraging institutional funding and patient support avenues.

• Proactive communication with HCPs on PSP : Drive impactful patient-centric solutions by ensuring healthcare providers are fully aware of programs designed to maximize testing accessibility.

• PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem: Develop high-level "systems thinking" capabilities by embedding FMI testing into standard hospital clinical protocols.

• Responsible to repor

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. La tua opportunità Accelera la tua carriera in medicina di precisione Se stai cercando di passare dalle vendite mediche tradizionali alla frontiera dell'innovazione genomica, questo ruolo permanente offre la piattaforma perfetta per la tua evoluzione professionale. Nell'ambito del team Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) all'interno di Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, questo ruolo è basato in Lahore e coprirà le regioni centrali e nord. Segnalando direttamente al Business Manager per FMI, non solo gestirai un territorio – costruirai un mercato, espanderai il tuo acume strategico aziendale e ti stabilirai come un esperto leader nella profilazione genomica completa (CGP).
• Il punto di contatto primario (ma non esclusivo) tra le parti interessate e Roche: Possedere il proprio territorio e costruire partnership di alto livello servendo come il volto di fiducia, esperto di medicina della Fondazione (FMI) per oncologi di spicco, patologi, e schede tumorali multidisciplinari in tutte le regioni del Centro e del Nord.
• Responsabile per i prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e supporta il loro uso appropriato, che include la condivisione dei loro meriti con HCP: Campione dell'adozione scientifica del portafoglio di test genomici all'avanguardia di FMI, influenzando direttamente percorsi sanitari personalizzati.
• Conoscenza del paesaggio delle malattie e dei prodotti: Affilare le tue competenze scientifiche masterizzando oncologia molecolare complessa, diagnostica di precisione e dati genomici per consultare con fiducia esperti medici di alto livello.
• Responsabilità dei prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e sostenere il suo uso appropriato: salire alla sfida di gestire gli obiettivi commerciali regionali, affinare le vostre capacità di pianificazione e esecuzione del territorio.
• Ampia comprensione della sua area terapeutica e della sua rispettiva futura pipeline, tale da poter lavorare su soluzioni future: Crescere in un leader strategico collaborando direttamente con FMI Business Manager per co-creare progetti di business regionali, analizzare le dinamiche di mercato e mappare conti istituzionali a lungo termine.
• Partner con stakeholder di viaggio del paziente per rimuovere i blocchi stradali e sbloccare le possibilità per fornire valore per i pazienti e la comunità: Sviluppare sofisticate capacità di problem solving mentre lavori in ecosistemi ospedalieri complessi per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro di test genomici dal campione al report.
• Consapevolezza della malattia Diagnosi: Posizionati come leader di pensiero educando i medici sul valore di cambiamento del paradigma della profilazione genomica completa sul test tradizionale.
• Istruzione HCP (prodotti pre-approvati e post-approvati) : Espandi le tue capacità professionali di presentazione e leadership guidando tavole rotonde scientifiche, riunioni mediche e recensioni di casi clinici.
• I pazienti’ Accesso ai fondi disponibili, ad esempio PBM/SSP & altri: Ottieni una preziosa esperienza nell'accesso al mercato sanitario esplorando e sfruttando i finanziamenti istituzionali e i viali di supporto dei pazienti.
• Comunicazione proattiva con HCP su PSP: Soluzioni impattanti per il paziente-centric assicurando ai fornitori di servizi sanitari la piena consapevolezza dei programmi progettati per massimizzare l'accessibilità ai test.
• PJP agisce come un pensatore di sistema con la capacità di identificare lo scopo condiviso tra le parti interessate e lo sfrutta per co-creare soluzioni con le parti interessate nell'ecosistema: Sviluppare capacità di "sistemi di pensiero" di alto livello incorporando i test FMI nei protocolli clinici ospedalieri standard.
• Responsabile del repo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Ihre Chance Beschleunigen Sie Ihre Karriere in der Präzisionsmedizin Wenn Sie den Übergang vom traditionellen medizinischen Verkauf zur Grenze der genomischen Innovation anstreben, bietet diese ständige Rolle die perfekte Plattform für Ihre berufliche Entwicklung. Als Teil des Teams von Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) innerhalb von Roche Diagnostics Pakistan hat diese Rolle ihren Sitz in Lahore und wird die zentralen und nördlichen Regionen abdecken. Wenn Sie direkt an den Business Manager für FMI berichten, verwalten Sie nicht nur ein Gebiet - Sie bauen einen Markt auf, erweitern Ihren strategischen Geschäftssinn und etablieren sich als führender Experte für umfassendes genomisches Profiling (CGP).
• Der primäre (aber nicht-exklusive) Kontaktpunkt zwischen Stakeholdern und Roche: Besitzen Sie Ihr Territorium und bauen Sie hochrangige Partnerschaften auf, indem Sie als vertrauenswürdiges, fachkundiges Gesicht der Foundation Medicine (FMI) für prominente Onkologen, Pathologen und multidisziplinäre Tumorboards in den Regionen Zentral und Nord dienen.
• Verantwortlich für die Produkte von Roche während ihres gesamten Lebenszyklus und unterstützt deren angemessene Verwendung, einschließlich des Teilens ihrer Vorzüge mit HCPs : Verfechten Sie die wissenschaftliche Übernahme des hochmodernen Portfolios von FMI für Genomtests, die direkt personalisierte Gesundheitswege beeinflussen.
• Verständnis von Krankheitslandschaften und Produktwissen: Schärfen Sie Ihre wissenschaftliche Expertise, indem Sie komplexe molekulare Onkologie, Präzisionsdiagnostik und Genomdaten beherrschen, um sich mit erstklassigen medizinischen Experten vertraut zu machen.
• Verantwortung der Roche-Produkte während ihres gesamten Lebenszyklus und Unterstützung ihrer angemessenen Nutzung: Stellen Sie sich der Herausforderung, regionale Geschäftsziele zu verwalten und Ihre datengesteuerten Fähigkeiten im Bereich Planung und Ausführung zu verbessern.
• Breites Verständnis seines/ihres therapeutischen Bereichs und seiner jeweiligen zukünftigen Pipeline, so dass sie an zukunftsorientierten Lösungen arbeiten können: Werden Sie zu einem strategischen Marktführer, indem Sie direkt mit dem FMI Business Manager zusammenarbeiten, um regionale Geschäftspläne zu erstellen, Marktdynamiken zu analysieren und langfristige institutionelle Konten abzubilden.
• Partnerschaften mit Interessengruppen der Patientenreise, um Hindernisse zu beseitigen und Möglichkeiten freizuschalten, um einen Mehrwert für Patienten und die Gemeinschaft zu schaffen: Entwickeln Sie anspruchsvolle Problemlösungskompetenzen, während Sie in komplexen Krankenhausökosystemen arbeiten, um genomische Testworkflows von der Probe bis zum Bericht zu optimieren.
• Bewusstsein für Krankheitsdiagnose: Positionieren Sie sich als Vordenker, indem Sie Kliniker über den Paradigmenwechselwert eines umfassenden genomischen Profilings gegenüber traditionellen Tests aufklären.
• HCP-Ausbildung (vorab genehmigte und nachab genehmigte Produkte): Erweitern Sie Ihre professionellen Präsentations- und Führungsfähigkeiten, indem Sie wissenschaftliche Roundtables, medizinische Meetings und klinische Fallprüfungen durchführen.
• Patienten Zugang zu verfügbaren Mitteln, z. B. PBM/SSP und andere: Gewinnen Sie wertvolle Erfahrungen im Bereich des Zugangs zum Gesundheitsmarkt, indem Sie Möglichkeiten zur institutionellen Finanzierung und Patientenunterstützung erkunden und nutzen.
• Proaktive Kommunikation mit HCPs auf PSP: Führen Sie wirkungsvolle patientenzentrierte Lösungen durch, indem Sie sicherstellen, dass Gesundheitsdienstleister sich der Programme bewusst sind, die die Zugänglichkeit von Tests maximieren.
• PJP agiert als Systemdenker mit der Fähigkeit, einen gemeinsamen Zweck unter den Interessengruppen zu identifizieren und nutzt dies, um gemeinsam mit Interessengruppen im Ökosystem Lösungen zu entwickeln: Entwickeln Sie hochrangige "Systemdenken" -Fähigkeiten, indem Sie FMI-Tests in klinische Standardprotokolle für Krankenhäuser integrieren.
• Verantwortlich für repor

Dans le cadre de l'équipe de la Fondation Médecine Inc. (FMI) au sein de Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, ce rôle est basé à Lahore et couvrira les régions du Centre et du Nord. Sous l'autorité directe du chef d'entreprise de l'IMF, vous ne gérerez pas seulement un territoire : vous créerez un marché, élargirez votre sens stratégique des affaires et vous établirez comme un expert de premier plan en profilage génomique complet (CGP).
• Point de contact principal (mais non exclusif) entre les parties prenantes et Roche : Possédez votre territoire et établissez des partenariats de haut niveau en servant de visage expert de la Fondation Médecine (FMI) pour les Oncologues, les pathologistes et les conseils tumoraux multidisciplinaires de toutes les régions du Centre et du Nord.
• Responsable des produits Roches tout au long de leur cycle de vie et soutient leur utilisation appropriée, qui inclut le partage de leurs mérites avec les HCP : Championne de l'adoption scientifique du portefeuille de tests génomiques de pointe du FMI, influençant directement les parcours de soins personnalisés.
• Connaissance du paysage des maladies et des produits : Approfondissez votre expertise scientifique en maîtrisant l'oncologie moléculaire complexe, les diagnostics de précision et les données génomiques pour consulter en toute confiance des experts médicaux de haut niveau.
• Responsabilité des produits Roches tout au long de leur cycle de vie et soutien de son utilisation appropriée : Déploiez le défi de la gestion des objectifs commerciaux régionaux, perfectionnez vos compétences de planification et d'exécution de territoire axées sur les données.
• Compréhension étendue de son domaine thérapeutique et de son avenir, de sorte qu'ils puissent travailler sur des solutions basées sur l'avenir: Devenez un chef de file stratégique en collaborant directement avec le gestionnaire d'entreprise de l'IMF pour créer des plans d'affaires régionaux, analyser la dynamique du marché et cartographier les comptes institutionnels à long terme.
• Partenaires avec les intervenants du cheminement des patients pour supprimer les barrages routiers et débloquer les possibilités de fournir de la valeur pour les patients et la communauté : Développer des compétences sophistiquées de résolution de problèmes lorsque vous travaillez à travers des écosystèmes hospitaliers complexes pour rationaliser les processus de test génomique de l'échantillon à rapport.
• Sensibilisation à la maladie Diagnostic : Positionnez-vous comme un leader de la pensée en éduquant les cliniciens sur la valeur changeante du profil génomique global par rapport aux tests traditionnels.
• Formation HCP (produits pré-approuvés et post-approuvés) : Élargissez votre présentation professionnelle et vos compétences en leadership en conduisant des tables rondes scientifiques, des réunions médicales et des examens de cas cliniques.
• Patients Accès aux fonds disponibles, p. ex. PBM/SSP et autres : acquérir une expérience précieuse en matière d'accès au marché des soins de santé en explorant et en tirant parti du financement institutionnel et des possibilités de soutien aux patients.
• Communication proactive avec les PSC sur les PSP : Conduire des solutions axées sur le patient en veillant à ce que les fournisseurs de soins de santé soient pleinement conscients des programmes conçus pour maximiser l'accessibilité aux tests.
• Le PJP agit comme un penseur système capable d'identifier des objectifs communs entre les intervenants et d'en tirer parti pour créer des solutions avec les intervenants de l'écosystème : Développer des capacités de « réflexion système » de haut niveau en intégrant les tests de l'IMF dans des protocoles cliniques hospitaliers standard.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Technical Project Manager (Data & AI)

Are you passionate about bridging high-level data strategies with world-class technical execution? As a Technical Project Manager (Data & AI) , you will lead medium to large-scale initiatives within our RDT Data & AI function. Operating across versatile framework archetypes—such as Project Manager, Agile Coach, Data Governance Coordinator, or Data Strategy Network Orchestrator—you will act as a trusted advisor connecting complex data capabilities with enterprise strategic goals.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

About RDT DATA & AI Business Operations

As the strategic engine for RDT DATA & AI Functions, our team bridges high-level vision with world-class execution. We are a high-performing collective of experts—from technical leaders to business analysts and human centered design experts—dedicated to elevating operational excellence and driving long-term strategy. By harnessing data-driven insights and managing critical shared capabilities, we ensure our division meets its global commitments with precision. Joining us means operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operational effectiveness, with the autonomy to streamline complex processes, and the influence to shape the digital future of healthcare at Roche.

The Opportunity

• Independently define, manage, and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, aligning technical delivery with overall strategic business objectives.

• Plan and execute Global Data Strategy (GDS) workpackages by actively managing intricate cross-stream dependencies, resource planning, and backlog management.

• Proactively identify, analyze, and mitigate scope-related risks to manage technical changes smoothly in a fast-paced environment.

• Provide flexible and adaptive PMO support , shifting seamlessly from active governance (driving metrics, executive slide creation, process engineering) to passive roadmap tracking for core engineering deliveries.

• Manage the delivery of complex features , services, or technical releases , including service transitions or Agile Release Train increments.

• Provide specialized PMO leadership by coordinating and driving the implementation of enterprise data policies, content strategies, and cultural change management initiatives.

• Orchestrate and drive workstreams specifically focused on Metadata Management, Master Data Management (MDM), and Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC).

• Partner closely with the Head of Data Governance , orchestrating GDS networks, fostering internal Communities of Practice, and mentoring engineering colleagues to build team accountability and spirit.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Years of Experience: 5+ years of solid experience operating across multiple Delivery Management archetypes (e.g., Technical Project Manager, Scrum Master, or Release Train Engineer).

• Proven track record in Technical PMO and Workpackage Orchestration , specifically managing intricate cross-stream dependencies, resource allocation, and backlog trackin

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Responsabile del progetto tecnico (Data & AI)

Sei appassionato di corruzione di strategie di dati di alto livello con l'esecuzione tecnica di livello mondiale? In qualità di Responsabile del Progetto Tecnico (Data & AI) , condurrai iniziative su larga scala nella nostra funzione RDT Data & AI. Operando attraverso archetipi framework versatili - come Project Manager, Agile Coach, Data Governance Coordinator, o Data Strategy Network Orchestrator - si agirà come consulente di fiducia che collega capacità di dati complesse con obiettivi strategici aziendali.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

Informazioni sulle operazioni aziendali di RDT e AI

Come motore strategico per RDT DATA & AI Functions, il nostro team collega una visione di alto livello con l'esecuzione di livello mondiale. Siamo un collettivo di esperti altamente performanti, dai leader tecnici agli analisti di business e agli esperti di design centrati sull'uomo, che si è dedicato ad elevare l'eccellenza operativa e a guidare la strategia a lungo termine. sfruttando le informazioni e gestendo le capacità condivise critiche, garantiamo che la nostra divisione soddisfi i suoi impegni globali con precisione. Unirsi a noi significa operare all'incrocio tra strategia, tecnologia e efficacia operativa, con l'autonomia di semplificare i processi complessi, e l'influenza di modellare il futuro digitale della salute a Roche.

L'opportunità

• Definire, gestire e controllare in modo indipendente la portata di iniziative da medie a grandi dimensioni, allineare la consegna tecnica con obiettivi strategici globali di business.

• Pianificare ed eseguire pacchetti di lavoro Global Data Strategy (GDS) gestendo attivamente intricate dipendenze cross-stream, pianificazione delle risorse e gestione del backlog.

• Identificare, analizzare e mitigare i rischi legati alla portata per gestire i cambiamenti tecnici in modo fluido in un ambiente frenetico.

• Fornire supporto PMO flessibile e adattativo, spostandosi senza soluzione di continuità dalla governance attiva (misure di guida, creazione di slide executive, ingegneria dei processi) al monitoraggio passivo della roadmap per le consegne di ingegneria di base.

• Gestisci la consegna di funzioni complesse , servizi o comunicati tecnici , compresi passaggi di servizio o incrementi Agile Release Train.

• Fornire leadership PMO specializzata coordinando e guidando l'attuazione di politiche di dati aziendali, strategie di contenuti e iniziative di gestione dei cambiamenti culturali.

• I flussi di lavoro dell'orchestrato e dell'azionamento sono specificamente focalizzati sulla gestione dei dati, sulla gestione dei dati master (MDM), e sul controllo di accesso basato sulle policy (PBAC).

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con il responsabile della governance dei dati, orchestrare le reti GDS, promuovere le comunità interne della pratica e aiutare i colleghi ingegneristici a costruire la responsabilità e lo spirito del team.

Chi sei

• Istruzione: Bachelor o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria dei Dati, Sistemi Informativi, Business Administration, o un campo tecnico correlato (o esperienza pratica equivalente).

• Anni di Esperienza: 5+ anni di solida esperienza che operano su più archetipi di Gestione della Consegna (ad esempio, Direttore del Progetto Tecnico, Master Scrum o Ingegnere del treno di rilascio).

• Provato record di traccia in Technical PMO e Workpackage Orchestration , specificamente la gestione intricate dipendenze cross-stream, allocazione delle risorse e trackin backlog

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Technischer Projektmanager (Data & AI)

Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, hochrangige Datenstrategien mit einer erstklassigen technischen Ausführung zu verbinden? Als technischer Projektmanager (Data & AI) leiten Sie mittlere bis große Initiativen innerhalb unserer RDT Data & AI-Funktion. Mit vielseitigen Framework-Archetypen wie Projektmanager, Agile Coach, Data Governance Coordinator oder Data Strategy Network Orchestrator fungieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater, der komplexe Datenfunktionen mit strategischen Zielen für Unternehmen verbindet.

Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Über RDT DATA & AI Business Operations

Als strategischer Motor für RDT DATA & AI Functions verbindet unser Team eine hochrangige Vision mit einer erstklassigen Ausführung. Wir sind ein leistungsstarkes Expertenkollektiv - von technischen Führungskräften über Business Analysten bis hin zu Experten für menschliches Design -, das sich der Verbesserung der operativen Exzellenz und der Förderung einer langfristigen Strategie widmet. Durch die Nutzung datengesteuerter Erkenntnisse und das Management kritischer gemeinsamer Fähigkeiten stellen wir sicher, dass unsere Abteilung ihre globalen Verpflichtungen präzise erfüllt. Zu uns zu kommen bedeutet, an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Technologie und operativer Effektivität zu arbeiten, mit der Autonomie, komplexe Prozesse zu rationalisieren, und dem Einfluss, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens bei Roche zu gestalten.

Die Chance

• Definieren, verwalten und kontrollieren Sie unabhängig den Umfang mittlerer bis großer Initiativen und richten Sie die technische Bereitstellung an den allgemeinen strategischen Geschäftszielen aus.

• Planen und implementieren Sie Global Data Strategy (GDS) Workpackages, indem Sie komplexe Cross-Stream-Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcenplanung und Backlog-Management aktiv verwalten.

• Erkennen, analysieren und mindern Sie proaktiv umfangsbezogene Risiken, um technische Änderungen in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung reibungslos zu bewältigen.

• Bieten Sie flexible und adaptive PMO-Unterstützung und wechseln Sie nahtlos von aktiver Governance (Fahrmetriken, Executive-Slide-Erstellung, Prozesstechnik) zu passivem Roadmap-Tracking für Kern-Engineering-Lieferungen.

• Verwalten Sie die Bereitstellung komplexer Funktionen, Dienste oder technischer Releases, einschließlich Serviceübergängen oder Agile Release Train-Inkrementen.

• Bieten Sie eine spezialisierte PMO-Führung, indem Sie die Implementierung von Unternehmensdatenrichtlinien, Inhaltsstrategien und Kulturwandelmanagementinitiativen koordinieren und vorantreiben.

• Orchestrieren und steuern Sie Workstreams, die sich speziell auf Metadatenmanagement, Master Data Management (MDM) und Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC) konzentrieren.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Data Governance, die Orchestrierung von GDS-Netzwerken, die Förderung interner Communities of Practice und die Betreuung von Ingenieurkollegen, um Verantwortlichkeit und Geist des Teams aufzubauen.

Wer du bist

• Ausbildung: Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Data Engineering, Informationssysteme, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich (oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung).

• Jahre Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre solide Erfahrung im Betrieb mit mehreren Delivery Management Archetypen (z. B. Technical Project Manager, Scrum Master oder Release Train Engineer).

• Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz bei Technical PMO und Workpackage Orchestration, insbesondere bei der Verwaltung komplizierter Cross-Stream-Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcenzuweisung und Backlog-Trackin
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Gestionnaire de projet technique (Data & AI)

Êtes-vous passionné par la mise en relation de stratégies de données de haut niveau avec l'exécution technique de classe mondiale? En tant que Technical Project Manager (Data & AI), vous dirigerez des initiatives de moyenne à grande échelle au sein de notre fonction RDT Data & AI. Fonctionnant à travers des archétypes-cadres polyvalents – comme le gestionnaire de projet, l'entraîneur agile, le coordonnateur de la gouvernance des données ou l'orchestreur du réseau de stratégie de données – vous agirez comme un conseiller de confiance reliant les capacités de données complexes aux objectifs stratégiques de l'entreprise.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins opérationnels, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements de collaboration.

À propos de RDT DATA & AI Business Operations

En tant que moteur stratégique pour RDT DATA & AI Functions, notre équipe établit un lien entre une vision de haut niveau et une exécution de classe mondiale. Nous sommes un collectif d'experts hautement performants – des leaders techniques aux analystes d'affaires et aux experts en design centrés sur l'humain – dédié à l'amélioration de l'excellence opérationnelle et à la mise en œuvre d'une stratégie à long terme. En mettant à profit les données recueillies et en gérant les capacités partagées essentielles, nous nous assurons que notre division respecte avec précision ses engagements mondiaux. Se joindre à nous, c'est opérer à l'intersection de la stratégie, de la technologie et de l'efficacité opérationnelle, avec l'autonomie de rationaliser les processus complexes, et l'influence de façonner l'avenir numérique des soins de santé à Roche.

L'opportunité

• Définir, gérer et contrôler de façon indépendante la portée des initiatives de taille moyenne à grande, en alignant la prestation technique avec les objectifs opérationnels stratégiques généraux.

• Planifier et exécuter les ensembles de travail de la Stratégie mondiale de données (SMD) en gérant activement les dépendances inter-streams complexes, la planification des ressources et la gestion des arriérés.

• Identifier, analyser et atténuer de façon proactive les risques liés à la portée afin de gérer les changements techniques en douceur dans un environnement accéléré.

• Fournir un soutien flexible et adaptatif aux OGP, passant de la gouvernance active (mesures de conduite, création de diapositives exécutives, ingénierie des processus) à un suivi passif de la feuille de route pour les livraisons d'ingénierie de base.

• Gérer la prestation de fonctions, de services ou de versions techniques complexes, y compris les transitions de service ou les incréments du train de dégagement agile.

• Assurer un leadership spécialisé du BGP en coordonnant et en dirigeant la mise en oeuvre des politiques d'entreprise en matière de données, des stratégies de contenu et des initiatives de gestion du changement culturel.

• Orchestrez et conduisez des flux de travail axés spécifiquement sur la gestion des métadonnées, la gestion des données maîtresses (GDM) et le contrôle d'accès axé sur les politiques (CAP).

• Collaborer étroitement avec le responsable de la gouvernance des données, orchestrer les réseaux GDS, favoriser les communautés de pratique internes et encadrer les collègues en génie pour bâtir la responsabilité et l'esprit d'équipe.

Qui vous êtes

• Études: Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, génie des données, systèmes d'information, administration des affaires, ou un domaine technique connexe (ou expérience pratique équivalente).

• Années d'expérience : 5 ans et plus d'expérience solide dans plusieurs archétypes de gestion de la prestation (p. ex., gestionnaire de projet technique, maître Scrum ou ingénieur de train de libération).

• Antécédents prouvés en PMO technique et en Orchestre Workpackage , en particulier la gestion des dépendances transversales complexes, l'allocation des ressources et le suivi des arriérés

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

This Programs and Solutions Lead - Digital and Tech (Procurement) role sits within the Strategy and Solutions Chapter, where our mission is to orchestrate strategic priorities, catalyse value delivery for the business, and amplify Procurement Excellence. We don’t just manage processes; we drive continuous improvement to strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the entire Roche organisation.

As a Programs and Solutions Lead , you will guide a high-performing, agile team focused on Digital and Tech . Your mandate is to lead the charge in bringing innovative solutions to life and accelerating procurement impact. In this role, you will lead the team to deliver against a high-impact portfolio encompassing:

• Market and Supplier-Driven Innovation: Co-creation of market-first solutions to solve complex business challenges. You will be expected to challenge the status quo and redefine ways of working, looking beyond the traditional value chain to deliver impact beyond standard procurement metrics.

• Complex Strategic Programs and projects: Acceleration and amplification of outcomes for high-stakes procurement initiatives, such as large-scale programs (e.g. cost transformations ) and critical projects (e.g. complex negotiations and sourcing ).

These initiatives are selected for their strategic weight, impact, and feasibility. You will lead a team expected to set the gold standard for quality and pace, requiring a "continuous development" mindset to stay ahead of market trends. This is a chance to deliver measurable impact while shaping a team culture that reflects Roche’s commitment to people and patients.
Beyond project delivery, you will be a community-builder, fostering a culture of curiosity, psychological safety, and radical collaboration where people feel empowered to experiment and grow.
You will coach a medium-to-large team, guiding resource allocation to the highest impact work and planning to turn high-level objectives into reality.

• Culture & Community Building: Cultivate a high-trust, inclusive environment. You will be a key driver in building a community where team members feel safe to share failures as learnings, celebrate successes together, and collaborate across boundaries to spark new ideas.

• Resource Orchestration: Dynamically balance resources to maximize impact; you will work across networks and squads to ensure the right talent is in the right place at the right time.

• Strategic Innovation & Problem Solving: Diagnose complex business needs within the Digital and Tech space, selecting the right approach (e.g. Solution versus program) seeking avenu

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

This Programs and Solutions Lead - Digital and Tech (Procurement) role sits within the Strategy and Solutions Chapter, where our mission is to orchestrate strategic priorities, catalyse value delivery for the business, and amplify Procurement Excellence. We don’t just manage processes; we drive continuous improvement to strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the entire Roche organisation.

As a Programs and Solutions Lead , you will guide a high-performing, agile team focused on Digital and Tech . Your mandate is to lead the charge in bringing innovative solutions to life and accelerating procurement impact. In this role, you will lead the team to deliver against a high-impact portfolio encompassing:

• Market and Supplier-Driven Innovation: Co-creation of market-first solutions to solve complex business challenges. You will be expected to challenge the status quo and redefine ways of working, looking beyond the traditional value chain to deliver impact beyond standard procurement metrics.

• Complex Strategic Programs and projects: Acceleration and amplification of outcomes for high-stakes procurement initiatives, such as large-scale programs (e.g. cost transformations ) and critical projects (e.g. complex negotiations and sourcing ).

These initiatives are selected for their strategic weight, impact, and feasibility. You will lead a team expected to set the gold standard for quality and pace, requiring a "continuous development" mindset to stay ahead of market trends. This is a chance to deliver measurable impact while shaping a team culture that reflects Roche’s commitment to people and patients.
Beyond project delivery, you will be a community-builder, fostering a culture of curiosity, psychological safety, and radical collaboration where people feel empowered to experiment and grow.
You will coach a medium-to-large team, guiding resource allocation to the highest impact work and planning to turn high-level objectives into reality.

(Please note: This is a IT Category focused Procurement role. This is not an internal procurement operations or Procurement technology implementation role.)

The Opportunity:

• Portfolio & Program Leadership: Lead your team in a fast-paced global environment to manage a diverse portfolio of solutions and programs (including cost transformations and critical negotiations) that deliver massive value for Digital and Tech stakeholders.

• Culture & Community Building: Cultivate a high-trust, inclusive environment. You will be a key driver in building a community where team members feel safe to share failures as learnings, celebrate successes together, and collaborate across boundaries to spark new ideas.

• Resource Orchestration: Dynamically balance resources to maximize impact; you will work across networks and squads to ensure the right talent is in the right place at the right time.

• Strategic Innovation & Problem Solving: Diagnose complex business needs within the Digital and Tech space, selecting the right approach (e.g. Solution versus program) seeking avenu

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Domain Architect – Pharma R&D is a senior, pivotal role within the SPG Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions team. This role serves as the critical connector between the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) organization and the Pharma R&D function. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions with a dotted line to the Global Head of Digital Technology - Pharma R&D, you will champion our enterprise architecture practices while deeply understanding the unique complexities of the Pharma R&D environment.

Crucially, in our federated RDT model, you will act as the principal orchestrator of the Pharma R&D architecture network. By leading this network—which includes yourself alongside all domain architects embedded directly within the Pharma R&D organization—you will drive architecture governance and strategy formulation, ensure enterprise coherence, and translate business goals into adaptable, future-ready technology roadmaps.

Description of the area
The Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions area serves as the strategic architectural interface for business domain leaders, fostering collaboration to align applications, business capabilities, and information assets with technology solutions. For the Pharma R&D domain, this involves deeply integrating with teams across Clinical Trial Execution, Discovery & Preclinical, Biometrics, and Regulatory Affairs to drive efficiency and innovation with end-to-end accountability. This role ensures that the bridge between SPG’s enterprise vision and Pharma R&D’s operational execution is seamless, collaborative, and highly effective.

Job Responsibilities

• Strategic Business Partnering: Act as the strategic liaison between SPG and Pharma R&D. Partner with the Global Head of Digital Technology - Pharma R&D and the R&D DT Leadership team to align business priorities with multi-year technology roadmaps and target-state architectures.

• Architecture Network Orchestration: Lead the Pharma R&D architecture network by shaping and promoting shared strategic priorities. Enable Domain and Solution Architects to execute efficiently while maintaining alignment and leveraging shared principles and platforms.

• Architecture Governance Leadership: Provide leadership for governance activities across Pharma R&D in collaboration with function embedded domain architects. Oversee architecture deliverables, technology guardrails, and create alignment on non-functional requirements (e.g., security, resilience).

• Critical Program Delivery & Domain Success: Drive the success of large, critical technology programs in Pharma R&D. Translate strategy into action and ensure transformative initiatives deliver intended business value while providing architectural oversight.

• Domain Architecture Deliverables: Lead the development and upkeep of core domain architecture artifacts for Pharma R&D. Ensure data accuracy across the technology and application inventory using the ArchiMEDES toolchain, delivering key outputs such as Capability Maps, Target-State Architectures, and Architecture Standards.

• Portfolio & Investment Alignment: Work with Pharma R&D Portfolio Management to embed architectural insights into investment decisions. Evaluate the impacts of strategies, address architectural gaps, and prevent fragmentation by maximizing platform reuse and minimizing technical debt.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Domain Architect – Diagnostics R&D is a senior-level, key position within the SPG Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions team. This position plays a critical role between the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) organization and the Diagnostics R&D function. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture - Business Partnering Functions with a dotted line to the Head of Dia RDT for DIA R&D, you will champion our enterprise architecture practices while deeply understanding the unique complexities of the Diagnostics R&D environment.

Crucially, in our federated RDT model, you will act as the principal orchestrator of the Diagnostics R&D architecture network. By leading this network—which includes yourself alongside all domain and solution architects embedded directly within the Diagnostics R&D organization—you will drive architecture governance and strategy formulation, ensure enterprise coherence, and translate business goals into adaptable, future-ready roadmaps.

Description of the Area
The Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions area serves as the strategic architectural point of contact for business domain leaders, fostering collaboration to align applications, business capabilities, and information assets with technology solutions. For the Diagnostics R&D domain, this involves deeply integrating with teams such as DIA R&D Labs, DIA R&D Computational Science and Engineering, DIA R&D Instrumentation, DIA Clinical Development and Medical Affairs, and DIA Portfolio & Project Management to drive efficiency and innovation with end-to-end accountability. This role ensures that the bridge between SPG’s enterprise vision and Diagnostics R&D’s operational execution is seamless, collaborative, and highly effective.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Business Partnering: Act as the strategic liaison between SPG EA and Diagnostics R&D. Partner with the Head of Dia RDT for DIA R&D and the R&D DT Leadership team to align business priorities with multi-year roadmaps and target-state architectures and ensure domain strategies are coherent with enterprise strategies.

• Architecture Network Orchestration: Lead the Diagnostics R&D architecture network by shaping and promoting shared strategic priorities. Enable Domain and Solution Architects to execute efficiently while maintaining alignment and maximizing the use of shared principles and platforms.

• Architecture Governance Leadership: Provide leadership for governance activities across Diagnostics R&D in collaboration with other embedded domain architects. Oversee architecture deliverables, technology guardrails, and create alignment on non-functional requirements (e.g., security, resilience). Represent architecture within other Governance bodies (e.g. Portfolio).

• Critical Program Delivery: Drive the success of large, critical technology programs in Diagnostics R&D. Translate strategy into action and ensure transformative initiatives deliver intended business value while providing architectural oversight.

• Domain Architecture Deliverables: Lead the development and upkeep of core architecture artifacts for Diagnostics R&D. Ensure data accuracy across the standard architecture and RDT toolchain, delivering key outputs such as Capability Maps, Target-State Architectures, Architecture Standards, and Reference Architectures.

• Portfolio & Investment Alignment: Work with Diagnostics R&D Portfolio Management and Functional Heads to embed architectural insights into investment decision

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Domain Architect - Diagnostics R&D The Domain Architect – Diagnostics R&D è una posizione chiave nel team di Strategy, Portfolio & Governance Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions. Questa posizione svolge un ruolo critico tra l'organizzazione Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) e la funzione Diagnostics R&D. Segnalandosi direttamente al Capo delle Imprese Architettura Business Partnering Functions con una linea tratteggiata al Capo di Dia RDT per DIA R&D, sarete campioni delle nostre pratiche di architettura aziendale, pur comprendendo profondamente le complessità uniche dell'ambiente Diagnostics R&D. Crucialmente, nel nostro modello Roche Digital Technology (RDT) federato, si agirà come il principale orchestratore della rete di architettura Diagnostics R&D. Con la guida di questa rete, che include te stesso insieme a tutti gli architetti di dominio e soluzioni incorporati direttamente all'interno dell'organizzazione Diagnostics R&D, guiderai la governance dell'architettura e la formulazione di strategia, garantirai la coerenza delle imprese e tradurrai gli obiettivi aziendali in roadmap adattabili e future. Descrizione dell'Area L'area Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions funge da punto di contatto architettonico strategico per i leader del dominio aziendale, favorendo la collaborazione per allineare applicazioni, capacità aziendali e asset informativi con soluzioni tecnologiche. Per il dominio Diagnostics R&D, questo implica profondamente l'integrazione con team come DIA R&D Labs, DIA R&D Computational Science and Engineering, DIA R&D Instrumentation, DIA Clinical Development and Medical Affairs, e DIA Portfolio & Project Management per guidare l'efficienza e l'innovazione con la responsabilità finale. Questo ruolo assicura che il ponte tra la visione aziendale di SPG e l'esecuzione operativa di Diagnostics R&D sia senza soluzione di continuità, collaborativo e altamente efficace. L'opportunità:
• Agirai come collegamento strategico tra SPG EA e Diagnostics R&D, collaborando con la leadership per allineare le priorità aziendali con roadmap pluriennali.
• Guidate la rete di architettura R&D Diagnostics, modellando le priorità strategiche condivise e consentendo agli architetti di eseguire mantenendo l'allineamento delle imprese.
• Fornire la leadership per le attività di governance dell'architettura, supervisionare i materiali di consegna e le protezioni tecnologiche per garantire la sicurezza e la resilienza.
• Si guida il successo di grandi e critici programmi di tecnologia, traducendo la strategia in iniziative attuabili e trasformative che forniscono valore aziendale.
• Sviluppi e mantieni manufatti di architettura di base, tra cui Capability Maps e Target-State Architectures, utilizzando la toolchain standard RDT.
• Collaborate con Portfolio Management per incorporare intuizioni architettoniche sulle decisioni di investimento, massimizzando il riutilizzo della piattaforma e la gestione del debito tecnico.
• Monitora le tendenze tecnologiche emergenti e valuta i fornitori per garantire che l'architettura R&D di Diagnostics rimanga innovativa e pronta per il futuro.
• Influenzi un modello RDT complesso e federato, bilanciando la coerenza aziendale con l'agilità necessaria per l'esecuzione operativa locale. Chi sei:
• Si possiede un Master e portare 7+ anni di esperienza nell'architettura IT e enterprise, specificamente all'interno di organizzazioni globali complesse, matrici o federazioni.
• Possiedi una profonda esperienza di dominio in Diagnostics R&D, con una comprensione completa dei processi scientifici, clinici e ingegneristici, dalla scienza computazionale e dalla strumentazione all'operazione di laboratorio a secco e umido

In un ambiente dinamico, promuoviamo la collaborazione senza soluzione di continuità tra aree e funzioni aziendali, offriamo soluzioni innovative e miglioriamo l'ambiente di lavoro per i dipendenti nelle sedi di Mannheim e Penzberg. In questo ruolo fai parte di Roche Diagnostics GmbH "Risk Management & SHE Compliance", esplicitamente del team "Implementation Management". Nel nostro team ci assumiamo la responsabilità di tradurre con successo i requisiti legali, gli standard SHE globali, nonché i processi e i sistemi in soluzioni pratiche ed economiche presso le nostre sedi. Agiamo sempre con la consapevolezza della nostra grande responsabilità nei confronti dell’ambiente e della società e garantiamo che le condizioni quadro siano attuate e vissute in modo sostenibile. • In qualità di interlocutore competente verificate i concetti di sicurezza e consigliate l'organizzazione sull'implementazione di requisiti tecnici complessi.

• Du bringst tiefgreifende Kenntnisse der relevanten Regelwerke mit, insbesondere in Bezug auf BetrSichV, TRBS, TRGS, TRAS, DIN EN 61508, DIN EN 615011 und K16.

• Ein ausgeprägtes wirtschaftliches Denken und Ha

The Position
Job Summary职位概述:
Develop and execute city-level market development and upstream government engagement strategies to protect market share, accelerate demand generation, and reduce competitor-driven brand-switching risks for the Core Lab portfolio. • Responsibilities主要工作职责 :

将地级政府利益相关者（如地方卫健委）与 Core Lab 的价值建立联系，使参与计划和体系与地方政府的医疗优先事项保持一致 。

在采购生命周期的早期阶段介入以影响相关准则，确保核心医院领导者及意见领袖与罗氏的临床和战略叙事达成一致 。

与销售（ PSL ）、市场和准入（ CAMA ）团队紧密合作，共同制定本地化的招标防御策略，提高目标招标赢标率，并确保项目端到端的贯通与转化 。
5. Coordinate internal corporate resources and drive external innovation partnerships to connect value chain partners, building a comprehensive local ecosystem supporting projects like Regional Inspection Centers and Medical Commons.
统筹跨职能的公司内部资源，推动外部创新伙伴关系，连接价值链上下游合作伙伴，构建支持区检中心和医共体等项目的完整本地生态系统 。

在地级市层面执行由 CAMA 主导的项目，利用成功的市级城市案例进行合规反馈，以此反哺并正面影响更高层面的省部级决策 。

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
You will be :

Instructional Design

• Analyze learning needs and partner with internal customers to provide input for course content. Plan, organize, and develop training content to meet specific training needs.

• Use authoring tools and software to create e-content from scratch and modify existing e-content. Focus on high-quality, well-functioning eLearning eLearning courses . Customer Engagement

Support the Global Learning Center of Excellence and our business customers with system maintenance and project activities. Actively participate in the development and implementation of Roche Learning continuous improvement initiatives . Actively participate in workshops, meetings and work-related team events . Provide guidance and advisory to the learning community at all levels. Be up to date on processes, own the knowledge development on processes, and contribute to the update of relevant documentation (SWIs, SOP, GWIs).

Operations : Excellent knowledge of Learning and Servicing tools specifically eLearning related , as well as contributing process superuser activities, such as community participation, info sharing, issue escalation and training delivery

Implement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement. Ensure end to end ownership of resolution . Ensure operations according to defined KPIs and SLAs. Raggiungere la nostra visione People Support Solutions guidando la coerenza globale attraverso la collaborazione.
