jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Software Development Technology Expert

In this role, you will provide global support for technical initiatives, share knowledge internationally, and shape the organization's technical direction. We are looking for deep expertise across multiple technology areas, a commitment to high code quality and security standards, and a proven ability to remove team obstacles while optimizing developer productivity across the software development lifecycle.

The Opportunity:

• Scope: Provide strategic technical guidance and set the direction for digital product development in alignment with business goals and priorities. Take ownership of developing new components and ideas while collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to deliver end-to-end experiences to end users.

• Architectural Evolution: Provide strategic technology and architecture advisory for AI-ready digital products while enforcing domain boundaries and maintaining high performance.

• AI-based software development: Drive the team toward adopting best practices and tools in AI-based software development.

• Stakeholder Management: Act as an advisor on technology and software development topics, providing direction for mid- to long-term goals and objectives.

• Impact/Strategy: Provide global support for innovative and technological initiatives. Share knowledge locally and on global platforms, while actively engaging in RDT Data Domain and site-related activities.

• Business/Technical ability: Actively contribute to the advancement of technical knowledge. Inspire innovation, drive solutions in line with technology trends, and focus on designing new approaches to existing problems.

• Data & AI Knowledge: Build frontier digital products that create a 'Data for AI' and 'AI for Data' portfolio, enabling Roche business units to discover the true value of Data and AI. Serve as the technology lead in a team developing digital products to manage AI and Data assets—an essential capability for implementing the Group Data Strategy and building an AI-ready organization.

Who you are:

• 7+ years of proven experience driving cross-functional collaboration to solve complex technical problems and align disparate engineering efforts toward common goals.

• Deep understanding of data processing principles and data requirements for AI readiness.

• Deep expertise across multiple technology domains with a demonstrated ability to select and apply optimal tools to solve complex challenges.

• Proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-Driven Architecture, or similar technologies.

• Strong grasp of software development lifecycle (SDLC) best practices.

• Extensive knowledge of modern software development tooling, with the ability to evaluate and integrate tools that enhance developer productivity and experience Roche-wide.

• Solid understanding of software validation, regulatory processes, and software quality management practices ( a plus ).

• Proven track record of clearing obstacles for technical teams, empowering them to deliver exceptional products.

• Proactive mindset with a proven ability to anticipate future technical challenges and opportunities, developing strategies to keep the organization ahead.

• Fluency in English (written and spoken).

What you get:

• Salary range 19,000 - 35,400 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 20% ).

• Hybrid Work Model (2 days per week in our Warsaw/Poznań office).

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Software Development Technology Expert

In this role, you will provide global support for technical initiatives, share knowledge internationally, and shape the organization's technical direction. We are looking for deep expertise across multiple technology areas, a commitment to high code quality and security standards, and a proven ability to remove team obstacles while optimizing developer productivity across the software development lifecycle.

The Opportunity:

• Scope: Provide strategic technical guidance and set the direction for digital product development in alignment with business goals and priorities. Take ownership of developing new components and ideas while collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to deliver end-to-end experiences to end users.

• Architectural Evolution: Provide strategic technology and architecture advisory for AI-ready digital products while enforcing domain boundaries and maintaining high performance.

• AI-based software development: Drive the team toward adopting best practices and tools in AI-based software development.

• Stakeholder Management: Act as an advisor on technology and software development topics, providing direction for mid- to long-term goals and objectives.

• Impact/Strategy: Provide global support for innovative and technological initiatives. Share knowledge locally and on global platforms, while actively engaging in RDT Data Domain and site-related activities.

• Business/Technical ability: Actively contribute to the advancement of technical knowledge. Inspire innovation, drive solutions in line with technology trends, and focus on designing new approaches to existing problems.

• Data & AI Knowledge: Build frontier digital products that create a 'Data for AI' and 'AI for Data' portfolio, enabling Roche business units to discover the true value of Data and AI. Serve as the technology lead in a team developing digital products to manage AI and Data assets—an essential capability for implementing the Group Data Strategy and building an AI-ready organization.

Who you are:

• 7+ years of proven experience driving cross-functional collaboration to solve complex technical problems and align disparate engineering efforts toward common goals.

• Deep understanding of data processing principles and data requirements for AI readiness.

• Deep expertise across multiple technology domains with a demonstrated ability to select and apply optimal tools to solve complex challenges.

• Proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-Driven Architecture, or similar technologies.

• Strong grasp of software development lifecycle (SDLC) best practices.

• Extensive knowledge of modern software development tooling, with the ability to evaluate and integrate tools that enhance developer productivity and experience Roche-wide.

• Solid understanding of software validation, regulatory processes, and software quality management practices ( a plus ).

• Proven track record of clearing obstacles for technical teams, empowering them to deliver exceptional products.

• Proactive mindset with a proven ability to anticipate future technical challenges and opportunities, developing strategies to keep the organization ahead.

• Fluency in English (written and spoken).

What you get:

• Salary range 19,000 - 35,400 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 20% ).

• Hybrid Work Model (2 days per week in our Warsaw/Poznań office).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity

Planning and Financial Management:

• Proactively acquires a deep understanding of the external environment (healthcare system, policies and reforms) to anticipate future trends and formulates a strategic view of market, competition and products erosion in short-term and long-term

• Localize and define life cycle management strategy for products in charge.

• Develop business models in different channels for products in charge

• Develop a deep understanding of key stakeholders, including key accounts, payers, patient advocacy groups, professional associations, and policymakers, and develop development plans for the top clinical opinion leaders for the therapy area.

• Build marketing plans analyzing the relevant markets and defining long- and short-term qualitative and quantitative objectives.

• Where relevant, implement the launch excellence framework to build leading launch plans.

• Translates the brand plan into a strong actionable operational plan with clear goals, actions, accountabilities, and measures across the cross-functional team.

• Sets responsible and challenging goals with appropriate KPIs for the brand that have a clear positive impact on business performance.

• Ensure brand-in-charge performance
Resource Management / Marketing Excellence

• Ensuring the good implementation of tactical plans by collaborating with cross-functional team (Sales Force/Market Access/Medical Affairs/SFE)

• Ensuring supply and healthy stock.

• Optimizing segmentation and targeting strategies for the products under management.

• Build brand communication package implement for activities to make sure quality and brand engagement & reach

• Key in charge for the Brand KPIs (Lead, Lag), sales performance, and A&P
Tactical Market Plan / Implementation

• Achieving Marketing objectives as agreed with management, managing the development and implementation of marketing plans consistent with approval strategy

• Ensuring the achievement of products’ budget in the approved BP and integrated marketing plan.

• Accountable for ensuring compliance’s rules & ethical code when working with healthcare professionals to strengthen the company’s image.

• Ensure all the support for the sales team/MA team comply with relevant acts, legal demand and ethical standards and in line with marketing plan

• Innovation and MCM apply in activities

Who you are

• Bachelor's or master's degree in Health/Science/Pharmaceutical or Medical disciplines

• Multinational companies' experiences in healthcare industry

• At least 5 years experience in product management

• MBA in Marketing will be a plus

• Marketing and business development experience will be a plus

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.

La tua opportunità

Pianificazione e gestione finanziaria:

• Proattivamente acquisisce una profonda comprensione dell'ambiente esterno (sistema sanitario, politiche e riforme) per anticipare le tendenze future e formula una visione strategica del mercato, della concorrenza e dell'erosione dei prodotti a breve e a lungo termine

• Localizzare e definire la strategia di gestione del ciclo di vita per i prodotti responsabili.

• Sviluppare modelli di business in diversi canali per i prodotti a carico

• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione dei principali stakeholder, tra cui account chiave, payers, gruppi di advocacy pazienti, associazioni professionali e responsabili politici, e sviluppare piani di sviluppo per i migliori leader di opinione clinica per l'area della terapia.

• Costruire piani di marketing analizzando i mercati pertinenti e definendo obiettivi qualitativi e quantitativi a lungo e a breve termine.

• Dove rilevante, implementare il framework di eccellenza di lancio per costruire i principali piani di lancio.

• Traduci il brand plan in un forte piano operativo attuabile con obiettivi chiari, azioni, responsabilità e misure attraverso il team interfunzionale.

• Imposta obiettivi responsabili e impegnativi con i KPI appropriati per il marchio che hanno un chiaro impatto positivo sulle prestazioni aziendali.

• Assicurare prestazioni di marca in carica
Gestione risorse / Eccellenza di marketing

• Garantire la buona attuazione dei piani tattici collaborando con il team interfunzionale (Sales Force/Market Access/Medical Affairs/SFE)

• Garantire la fornitura e la scorta sana.

• Ottimizzare le strategie di segmentazione e di targeting per i prodotti in gestione.

• Costruire il pacchetto di comunicazione del marchio per le attività per assicurarsi qualità e impegno del marchio & raggiungere

• Key in carica per i Brand KPI (Lead, Lag), le prestazioni di vendita e A&P
Piano di mercato tattico / Attuazione

• Raggiungere obiettivi di marketing concordati con la gestione, la gestione dello sviluppo e l'attuazione di piani di marketing coerenti con la strategia di approvazione

• Garantire il raggiungimento del bilancio dei prodotti nel BP approvato e nel piano di marketing integrato.

• Contabile per garantire le regole di conformità e il codice etico quando si lavora con i professionisti del settore sanitario per rafforzare l’immagine dell’azienda.

• Assicurarsi che tutto il supporto per il team di vendita/MA sia conforme agli atti pertinenti, alla domanda legale e agli standard etici e in linea con il piano di marketing

• Innovazione e MCM si applicano nelle attività

Chi sei

• Corso di laurea o master in Scienze della salute / Scienza/Pharmaceutica o discipline mediche

• Esperienze multinazionali nel settore sanitario

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti

• MBA in Marketing sarà un plus

• Marketing e business development experience sarà un plus

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben.

Ihre Chance

Planung und Finanzmanagement:

• Erwirbt proaktiv ein tiefes Verständnis des externen Umfelds (Gesundheitssystem, Politik und Reformen), um zukünftige Trends zu antizipieren, und formuliert einen strategischen Blick auf kurz- und langfristige Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Produkterosion

• Lokalisieren und definieren Sie die Life-Cycle-Management-Strategie für die verantwortlichen Produkte.

• Entwicklung von Geschäftsmodellen in verschiedenen Kanälen für verantwortliche Produkte

• Entwickeln Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der wichtigsten Interessengruppen, einschließlich Key Accounts, Kostenträger, Patientenvertretungsgruppen, Berufsverbände und politische Entscheidungsträger, und entwickeln Sie Entwicklungspläne für die wichtigsten klinischen Meinungsführer für den Therapiebereich.

• Erstellen Sie Marketingpläne, die die relevanten Märkte analysieren und langfristige und kurzfristige qualitative und quantitative Ziele definieren.

• Gegebenenfalls Umsetzung des Exzellenzrahmens für den Start, um führende Startpläne zu erstellen.

• Übersetzt den Markenplan in einen umsetzbaren Betriebsplan mit klaren Zielen, Maßnahmen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Maßnahmen im gesamten funktionsübergreifenden Team.

• Setzt verantwortungsvolle und herausfordernde Ziele mit geeigneten KPIs für die Marke, die sich eindeutig positiv auf die Geschäftsentwicklung auswirken.

• Gewährleistung der Brand-in-Charge-Leistung
Resource Management / Marketing Excellence

• Sicherstellung der guten Umsetzung taktischer Pläne durch die Zusammenarbeit mit dem funktionsübergreifenden Team (Sales Force / Market Access / Medical Affairs / SFE)

• Versorgung und gesunde Bestände sichern.

• Optimierung von Segmentierungs- und Targetingstrategien für die verwalteten Produkte.

• Erstellen Sie ein Markenkommunikationspaket für Aktivitäten, um Qualität und Markenbindung und -reichweite sicherzustellen

• Verantwortlich für die Marken-KPIs (Lead, Lag), die Verkaufsleistung und A&P
Taktischer Marktplan / Umsetzung

• Erreichung der mit dem Management vereinbarten Marketingziele, Verwaltung der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Marketingplänen im Einklang mit der Genehmigungsstrategie

• Sicherstellung der Erreichung des Produktbudgets im genehmigten BP und integrierten Marketingplan.

• Verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Compliance-Regeln und des Ethikkodex bei der Zusammenarbeit mit Gesundheitsexperten, um das Image des Unternehmens zu stärken.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die gesamte Unterstützung für das Verkaufsteam / MA-Team den einschlägigen Gesetzen, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und ethischen Standards sowie dem Marketingplan entspricht

• Innovation und MCM gelten in Aktivitäten

Wer du bist

• Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in den Disziplinen Gesundheit/Wissenschaft/Pharma oder Medizin

• Erfahrungen multinationaler Unternehmen in der Gesundheitsbranche

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement

• MBA in Marketing wird ein Plus sein

• Marketing und Business Development Erfahrung wird ein Plus sein

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Planning and Material Management function within our Global Instrumentation Network (GIN)—part of Global Operations—ensures manufacturing continuity across EMEA, NAM, and APAC . By seamlessly connecting our global network of suppliers and production resources, we ensure flawless product lifecycles, maximized efficiency, and unyielding market supply of critical diagnostics products worldwide .

Operating as a Global Sourcing and Material Manager across our EMEA, NAM, and APAC regions, you will partner with global procurement and category management to orchestrate seamless material flows throughout the manufacturing network . This role entails managing critical A-supplier portfolios to maximize performance, achieve TCO efficiencies, proactively mitigate VUCA and geopolitical risks, and drive tangible gains in factory productivity .

The Opportunity

• Strategic Partnering & Portfolio Management: Collaborate with Global Procurement and Category Management to manage key A-suppliers by developing tailored sourcing strategies and ensuring execution via contractual agreements (e.g., multi-sourcing, VMI, framework contracts) to optimize TCO and long-term supply resilience .

• NPI & Product Lifecycle: Engage early in development projects—shaping supplier selection and initial procurement parameters for new product launches, technical transfers, and phase-outs to configure a sustainable inbound supply chain .

• Supplier, Risk & Network Planning: Actively support global supplier relationship management, joint QBRs, and synchronized long-term demand planning with supplier capacities to mitigate VUCA/geopolitical risks, enhance resilience, and translate network requirements into actionable specifications .

• Operational Excellence: Orchestrate end-to-end requisition-to-order cycles by executing standardized tactical workflows to consistently achieve operational KPIs, maximize financial value, and advance sustainability goals while synchronizing supplier capacity with global manufacturing requirements .

• Escalations & Risk Mitigation: Manage Tier 1 and 2 supplier escalations by serving as the primary interface for dispute resolution and bottleneck management—deploying predictive risk frameworks to resolve severe material shortages and secure uninterrupted supply across the network .

• Process Excellence & Leadership: Modernize sourcing processes and maximize portfolio efficiency through standardized specifications and cross-site best practices—identifying savings, mitigating risks, and establishing scalable capabilities for future growth .

• Technology & Operational Excellence: Drive the adoption of innovative procurement and planning tools (e.g., SAP ERP MM/PP, VMI setups, and iCollab supplier portals or OMP) .

Who You Are

• Education & Professional Experience: University degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or Engineering required (Master's preferred), along with 5 to 8+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, direct procurement, supplier management, or supply chain engineering within a complex manufacturing or life sciences network .

• Track Record & Category Expertise: Demonstrated success leading cross-functional sourcing projects, partnering with global teams, and managing high-complexity spend portfolios (CHF >50M), backed by deep, hands-on sourcing expertise in direct procurement categories—specifically electronic and mechanical components—paired with strong knowledge of product lifecycles, BOM struct

Operando come Global Sourcing and Material Manager nelle nostre regioni EMEA, NAM e APAC, partnerrete con l'approvvigionamento globale e la gestione delle categorie per orchestrare flussi di materiali senza soluzione di continuità in tutta la rete di produzione. Questo ruolo comporta la gestione di portafogli A-fornitore critici per massimizzare le prestazioni, raggiungere le efficienze TCO, mitigare proattivamente i rischi VUCA e geopolitici, e guidare guadagni tangibili nella produttività di fabbrica.

L'opportunità

• NPI & Product Lifecycle: Engage all'inizio dei progetti di sviluppo: modellare la selezione dei fornitori e i parametri iniziali di approvvigionamento per i nuovi prodotti, trasferimenti tecnici e phase-out per configurare una supply chain sostenibile in entrata.

• Fornitore, Risk & Network Planning: supporta attivamente la gestione globale dei rapporti dei fornitori, QBR comuni e la pianificazione sincronizzata della domanda a lungo termine con le capacità dei fornitori per mitigare i rischi VUCA/geopolitical, migliorare la resilienza e tradurre i requisiti di rete in specifiche attuabili.

• Eccellenza operativa: Orchestrate cicli di requisizione end-to-order end-to-order eseguendo flussi di lavoro tattici standardizzati per raggiungere costantemente i KPI operativi, massimizzare il valore finanziario e avanzare obiettivi di sostenibilità, sincronizzando la capacità dei fornitori con i requisiti di produzione globali.

• Escalations & Risk Mitigation: Gestire Tier 1 e 2 escalations dei fornitori servendo come interfaccia primaria per la risoluzione delle controversie e la gestione del collo di bottiglia—deploying framework di rischio predittivo per risolvere gravi carenze di materiale e garantire la fornitura ininterrotta in tutta la rete.

• Eccellenza di processo & Leadership: Modernizzare i processi di approvvigionamento e massimizzare l'efficienza del portafoglio attraverso specifiche standardizzate e best practice cross-site, identificare risparmi, mitigare i rischi e stabilire capacità scalabili per la crescita futura.

• Tecnologia & Eccellenza Operativa: guidare l'adozione di strumenti di approvvigionamento e pianificazione innovativi (ad esempio, SAP ERP MM/PP, installazioni VMI e portali fornitori iCollab o OMP) .

Chi sei

• Istruzione & Esperienza Professionale: Laurea in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistica o Ingegneria richiesto (preferito da Master), insieme a 5-8 anni di esperienza progressiva in approvvigionamento strategico, approvvigionamento diretto, gestione dei fornitori, o ingegneria della supply chain all'interno di una complessa rete di produzione o scienze della vita .

• Track Record & Categoria Expertise: Progetti di sourcing cross-funzionali leader nel successo, collaborando con i team globali e gestendo portafogli di spesa ad alta complessità (CHF >50M), sostenuti da competenze di approvvigionamento profondo e pratico in categorie di approvvigionamento diretto, in particolare componenti elettronici e meccanici, accomunati da una forte conoscenza dei cicli di vita dei prodotti, BOM struct

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Die Planungs- und Materialverwaltungsfunktion innerhalb unseres Global Instrumentation Network (GIN) - Teil von Global Operations - gewährleistet die Kontinuität der Fertigung in EMEA, NAM und APAC. Durch die nahtlose Verbindung unseres globalen Netzwerks von Lieferanten und Produktionsressourcen gewährleisten wir einen einwandfreien Produktlebenszyklus, eine maximale Effizienz und eine unnachgiebige Marktversorgung mit kritischen Diagnoseprodukten weltweit.

Als Global Sourcing and Material Manager in unseren Regionen EMEA, NAM und APAC arbeiten Sie mit dem globalen Beschaffungs- und Kategoriemanagement zusammen, um nahtlose Materialflüsse im gesamten Fertigungsnetzwerk zu orchestrieren. Diese Rolle beinhaltet die Verwaltung kritischer A-Lieferanten-Portfolios, um die Leistung zu maximieren, TCO-Effizienz zu erreichen, VUCA- und geopolitische Risiken proaktiv zu mindern und spürbare Gewinne in der Fabrikproduktivität zu erzielen.

Die Chance

• Strategisches Partnering & Portfolio Management: Zusammenarbeit mit Global Procurement und Category Management, um wichtige A-Lieferanten zu verwalten, indem maßgeschneiderte Sourcing-Strategien entwickelt und die Umsetzung durch vertragliche Vereinbarungen (z. B. Multi-Sourcing, VMI, Rahmenverträge) sichergestellt wird, um die TCO und die langfristige Versorgungsresistenz zu optimieren.

• NPI & Product Lifecycle: Engagieren Sie sich frühzeitig in Entwicklungsprojekten – gestalten Sie die Lieferantenauswahl und die anfänglichen Beschaffungsparameter für neue Produkteinführungen, technische Transfers und Auslaufphasen, um eine nachhaltige Inbound-Lieferkette zu konfigurieren.

• Lieferanten-, Risiko- und Netzwerkplanung: Aktive Unterstützung des globalen Lieferantenbeziehungsmanagements, gemeinsamer QBRs und synchronisierter langfristiger Bedarfsplanung mit Lieferantenkapazitäten, um VUCA-/geopolitische Risiken zu mindern, die Widerstandsfähigkeit zu erhöhen und Netzwerkanforderungen in umsetzbare Spezifikationen umzusetzen.

• Operational Excellence: Orchestrieren Sie End-to-End-Requisition-to-Order-Zyklen durch die Ausführung standardisierter taktischer Workflows, um konsistent operative KPIs zu erreichen, den finanziellen Wert zu maximieren und die Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu verbessern und gleichzeitig die Lieferantenkapazität mit den globalen Fertigungsanforderungen zu synchronisieren.

• Eskalationen und Risikominderung: Verwalten Sie die Eskalationen von Tier 1 und 2, indem Sie als primäre Schnittstelle für die Streitbeilegung und das Engpassmanagement dienen und prädiktive Risikorahmen einsetzen, um schwere Materialknappheit zu beheben und eine unterbrechungsfreie Versorgung im gesamten Netzwerk zu gewährleisten.

• Process Excellence & Leadership: Modernisierung der Beschaffungsprozesse und Maximierung der Portfolioeffizienz durch standardisierte Spezifikationen und standortübergreifende Best Practices - Identifizierung von Einsparungen, Risikominderung und Etablierung skalierbarer Fähigkeiten für zukünftiges Wachstum.

• Technologie & Operational Excellence: Förderung der Einführung innovativer Beschaffungs- und Planungstools (z. B. SAP ERP MM/PP, VMI-Setups und iCollab-Lieferantenportale oder OMP).

Wer du bist

• Ausbildung & Berufserfahrung: Universitätsabschluss in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Supply Chain Management, Logistik oder Engineering erforderlich (Master bevorzugt), zusammen mit 5 bis 8+ Jahren fortschrittlicher Erfahrung in strategischer Beschaffung, Direktbeschaffung, Lieferantenmanagement oder Supply Chain Engineering in einem komplexen Fertigungs- oder Life-Sciences-Netzwerk .

• Track Record & Category Expertise: Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Leitung funktionsübergreifender Sourcing-Projekte, der Partnerschaft mit globalen Teams und der Verwaltung hochkomplexer Ausgabenportfolios (CHF > 50M), unterstützt durch fundierte, praktische Sourcing-Expertise in Direktbeschaffungskategorien - insbesondere elektronische und mechanische Komponenten - gepaart mit fundiertem Wissen über Produktlebenszyklen, Stücklistenstruktur
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
La fonction Planification et gestion des matériaux au sein de notre réseau mondial d'instrumentation (GIN), qui fait partie des Opérations mondiales, assure la continuité de la fabrication dans l'ensemble de l'EMEA, du NAM et de l'APAC. En connectant parfaitement notre réseau mondial de fournisseurs et de ressources de production, nous garantissons un cycle de vie impeccable des produits, une efficacité maximale et un approvisionnement inépuisable en produits diagnostiques critiques dans le monde entier.

En tant que gestionnaire mondial d'approvisionnement et de matériel dans nos régions de l'EMEA, du NAM et de l'APAC, vous vous associerez à la gestion globale des achats et des catégories pour orchestrer des flux de matériel sans faille dans tout le réseau de fabrication. Ce rôle implique la gestion de portefeuilles d'a-fournisseurs critiques pour maximiser les performances, réaliser des économies de TCO, atténuer proactivement les risques de VUCA et géopolitiques, et générer des gains tangibles dans la productivité des usines.

L'opportunité

• Partenariat stratégique et gestion de portefeuille : Collaborer avec la gestion globale des achats et des catégories pour gérer les fournisseurs A clés en élaborant des stratégies d'approvisionnement sur mesure et en assurant l'exécution par le biais d'accords contractuels (p. ex. multi-approvisionnement, IMV, contrats-cadres) afin d'optimiser l'ACO et la résilience à long terme de l'approvisionnement.

• NPI & Product Lifecycle: S'engager dès le début dans des projets de développement – façonner la sélection des fournisseurs et les paramètres d'approvisionnement initiaux pour les lancements de nouveaux produits, les transferts techniques et les sorties progressives pour configurer une chaîne d'approvisionnement interne durable.

• Fournisseur, Risk & Network Planning: Soutenir activement la gestion globale des relations avec les fournisseurs, les QBR conjoints et la planification à long terme synchronisée de la demande avec les capacités des fournisseurs d'atténuer les risques VUCA/géopolitiques, d'améliorer la résilience et de traduire les exigences du réseau en spécifications réalisables.

• Excellence opérationnelle : organiser des cycles de réquisition à commandes en exécutant des workflows tactiques normalisés pour atteindre systématiquement des ICR opérationnels, maximiser la valeur financière et faire progresser les objectifs de durabilité tout en synchronisant la capacité des fournisseurs avec les exigences de fabrication mondiales.

• Escalations et atténuation des risques : gérer les hausses des fournisseurs des niveaux 1 et 2 en servant d'interface principale pour le règlement des différends et la gestion des goulots d'étranglement – déployer des cadres de risque prédictifs pour résoudre les graves pénuries de matériel et assurer un approvisionnement ininterrompu dans l'ensemble du réseau.

• Excellence et leadership en matière de processus : Moderniser les processus d'approvisionnement et maximiser l'efficacité du portefeuille grâce à des spécifications normalisées et à des pratiques exemplaires inter-sites : identifier les économies, atténuer les risques et établir des capacités évolutives pour la croissance future.

• Technologie et excellence opérationnelle : Favoriser l'adoption d'outils innovateurs d'approvisionnement et de planification (p. ex. SAP ERP MM/PP, configurations VMI et portails fournisseurs iCollab ou OMP).

Qui vous êtes

• Éducation et expérience professionnelle: Diplôme universitaire en administration des affaires, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, logistique, ou l'ingénierie requise (maîtrise préférée), ainsi que 5 à 8 ans et plus d'expérience progressive dans l'approvisionnement stratégique, l'approvisionnement direct, la gestion des fournisseurs, ou l'ingénierie de la chaîne d'approvisionnement au sein d'un réseau complexe de fabrication ou de sciences de la vie .

• Expertise du suivi et de la catégorie : Succès démontré menant des projets d'approvisionnement interfonctionnels, partenariat avec des équipes mondiales et gestion de portefeuilles de dépenses à haute complexité (CHF > 50M), appuyés par une expertise approfondie et pratique dans les catégories d'approvisionnement direct – en particulier les composants électroniques et mécaniques – appariés avec une solide connaissance du cycle de vie des produits, structure BOM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Payroll Tax Analyst provides professional payroll and tax administration services for the North America Shared Services organization. In this role, you will partner with key stakeholders, leadership, and Centers of Excellence to enable data-driven decisions and support organizational strategy execution. You will be responsible for end-to-end payroll tax administration, continuous process and system improvements, and complex operational troubleshooting, while upholding strict confidentiality and employee privacy standards.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Payroll Tax Administration & Compliance

• Execute processing for U.S. payroll tax administration, ensuring strict adherence to state/local payroll regulations and tax laws.

• Address inquiries from various taxing jurisdictions, respond to official tax notices, conduct tax audits, and perform risk assessments.

• Manage SUI rate updates, tax jurisdiction updates, tax filing amendments, Power of Attorney documentation, and lock-in letters.

• Oversee monthly and quarterly tax balancing across corporate entities.

2. Payroll Operations & System Execution

• Calculate and process severance repayments and manage employee overpayment recoveries.

3. System Testing, Audit & Continuous Improvement

• Gather, document, and analyze business requirements to translate business needs into scalable process and system design solutions.

• Participate in system upgrade validation and testing within Workday, including project testing and W-2 system testing.

• Apply Lean Six Sigma and root cause analysis methodologies to investigate trends, eliminate process bottlenecks, and optimize service delivery.

• Conduct ongoing data audits to maintain high levels of data integrity and system compliance.

4. Stakeholder Engagement & Customer Support

• Deliver high-quality customer service by providing expert advice and clear solutions for routine and complex tax-related inquiries.

• Manage, research, and distribute cases using the ServiceNow case management system (People Portal).

• Handle W-2/W-2c requests, year-end adjustments, and tax correction communications.

• Develop training materials and deliver training to the user community and HR Shared Services staff regarding new functionalities, processes, and guidelines.

Who You Are

• Education: Associate’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field. Years of experience may be considered in leiu of degeee.

• Experience: Minumum 3 years payroll experience. Experience within an HR Shared Services Center environment, preferably in a complex matrix organization.

• HR & Payroll Knowledge: Broad understanding of HR services, policies, programs, and state/federal payroll tax regulations.

• Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (specifically Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis functions).

• Problem Solving & Analytics: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to troubleshoot complex issues, conduct root cause analyses, and evaluate business trends.

• Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal skills with proven stakeholder management and change management capabilities.

• Work Style: Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple competing priorities, and navigate complex HR data structures.

• Certifications: Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or APA certification. (preferred)

• Systems: Experience with U.S. Workday Payroll syst

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'opportunità

Il Payroll Tax Analyst fornisce servizi di payroll professionale e di amministrazione fiscale per l'organizzazione dei servizi condivisi in Nord America. In questo ruolo, sarete partner di principali stakeholder, leadership e centri di eccellenza per consentire decisioni basate sui dati e sostenere l'esecuzione di strategia organizzativa. Sarà responsabile per l'amministrazione fiscale payroll end-to-end, il processo continuo e i miglioramenti del sistema, e la risoluzione di problemi operativi complessi, pur mantenendo rigorosi standard di riservatezza e privacy dei dipendenti.

Responsabilità chiave:
1. Amministrazione fiscale e conformità

• Esegui il trattamento per l'amministrazione fiscale del libro paga degli Stati Uniti, assicurando una stretta adesione alle normative statali/locali e alle leggi fiscali.

• Le richieste di indirizzo da varie giurisdizioni fiscali, rispondono alle comunicazioni fiscali ufficiali, effettuano controlli fiscali e effettuano valutazioni di rischio.

• Gestisci aggiornamenti sui tassi SUI, aggiornamenti sulla giurisdizione fiscale, modifiche di deposito fiscale, documentazione del Procuratore e lettere di blocco.

• Controllare il bilanciamento mensile e trimestrale fiscale tra le entità aziendali.

2. Operazioni Payroll & Esecuzione di sistema

• Calcolare e processare i rimborsi di liquidazione e gestire i recuperi di pagamento eccessivo dei dipendenti.

3. Test di sistema, Audit e miglioramento continuo

• Raccogliere, documentare e analizzare i requisiti aziendali per tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni scalabili di processo e progettazione di sistema.

• Partecipa alla validazione e al test di aggiornamento del sistema all'interno di Workday, tra cui test di progetto e test di sistema W-2.

• Applica le metodologie di analisi Lean Six Sigma e root causa per indagare le tendenze, eliminare i colli di bottiglia di processo e ottimizzare la consegna del servizio.

• Condurre controlli di dati in corso per mantenere alti livelli di integrità dei dati e conformità del sistema.

4. Stakeholder Engagement & Customer Support

• Fornire assistenza clienti di alta qualità fornendo consigli esperti e soluzioni chiare per indagini fiscali di routine e complesse.

• Gestire, ricercare e distribuire i casi utilizzando il sistema di gestione dei casi ServiceNow (People Portal).

• Maneggiare richieste W-2/W-2c, modifiche di fine anno e comunicazioni di correzione fiscale.

• Sviluppare materiali di formazione e fornire formazione alla comunità degli utenti e personale Servizi condivisi HR per quanto riguarda nuove funzionalità, processi e linee guida.

Chi sei

• Istruzione: grado di Associate in Business Administration, Risorse umane, o un campo correlato. Gli anni di esperienza possono essere considerati in leiu di degeee.

• Esperienza: Minumum 3 anni esperienza payroll. Esperienza all'interno di un ambiente HR Shared Services Center, preferibilmente in una complessa organizzazione di matrice.

• HR & Payroll Conoscenza: ampia comprensione dei servizi HR, delle politiche, dei programmi e delle normative fiscali statali/federali.

• Competenze tecniche: competenza avanzata in Microsoft Office (in particolare Excel, comprese le tabelle pivot, VLOOKUP e le funzioni di analisi dei dati).

• Problem Solving & Analytics: Forte capacità di pensiero analitico e critico per risolvere problemi complessi, condurre analisi della causa radice e valutare le tendenze aziendali.

• Comunicazione e collaborazione: eccellenti competenze scritte, verbali e interpersonali con comprovate capacità di gestione e gestione dei cambiamenti degli stakeholder.

• Stile di lavoro: Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente frenetico, gestire più priorità concorrenti e navigare complesse strutture dati HR.

• Certificazioni: Certificato Payroll Professional (CPP) o certificazione APA. (preferito)

• Sistemi: Esperienza con la sist Payroll U.S.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Intellectual Property Counsel/Agent, Digital Pathology
Roche Diagnostics is pushing the boundaries of precision medicine by converging tissue diagnostics with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, computer vision, and spatial biology workflows. As an IP Counsel or Registered Patent Agent within our IP Legal Department, you will sit at the forefront of this digital revolution. In this hands-on role, you will directly draft and prosecute patent applications while managing outside counsel and shaping global patent strategy, portfolio development, and risk mitigation for Roche's next-generation Digital Pathology ecosystems.

The Opportunity:
In this role, you will serve as a strategic legal and technical advisor to R&D, data science, software engineering, and business development teams, directly capturing and protecting inventions in computational diagnostics.

• First-Principle Application Drafting: Directly draft high-quality US and international patent applications covering core computer vision models, agentic AI workflows, spatial biology pipelines, and clinical-grade bioinformatics algorithms.

• Hands-on Patent Prosecution: Directly prepare and file responses to Office Actions, conduct examiner interviews, and steer prosecution strategies before the USPTO and foreign patent offices to secure broad, enforceable claims for digital health software architectures.

• Outside Counsel Management: Select, direct, and manage external legal counsel for overflow drafting, global prosecution, and specialized portfolio projects to ensure technical precision, cost efficiency, and alignment with Roche's overarching IP strategy.

• Strategic Portfolio Management: Formulate and execute robust global IP strategies covering deep learning neural networks, proprietary diagnostic algorithms, and multi-modal diagnostic fusion engines.

• Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) & Risk Assessment: Conduct complex FTO analyses, landscape reviews, validity assessments, and patentability studies specifically tailored to open-source software integration and cloud-native digital health infrastructures.

• IP Harvesting & R&D Integration: Partner directly with software engineers, machine learning researchers, and pathologists to systematically harvest inventions arising from foundation models, image segmentation, and quantitative biomarker analysis.

Who You Are:

• You are a strategic, hands-on IP professional who thrives at the intersection of complex algorithmic models and advanced tissue diagnostic pathology.

• Experience: 3–7+ years of dedicated experience in hands-on patent drafting, prosecution, portfolio strategy, and legal counseling focused on software, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and/or computational biology.

• Credentials: Registered to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) as a Patent Agent or Patent Attorney. Attorney applicants must possess an active license in good standing with at least one US state bar.

• Education: B.S. required; advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Bioengineering, or a closely related quantitative field is a plus.

• Technical & Prosecution Mastery: Demonstrated track record of personally drafting and successfully prosecuting complex software and AI patent claims, alongside familiarity with deep learning frameworks, spatial transcriptomics/proteomics data processing, and automated image analysis tools.

• Legal & An

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Consulente di proprietà intellettuale/Agent, Patologia digitale
Roche Diagnostics sta spingendo i confini della medicina di precisione convergendo la diagnostica dei tessuti con i flussi di lavoro di intelligenza artificiale all'avanguardia, visione del computer e biologia spaziale. In qualità di consulente IP o agente brevettato registrato all'interno del nostro Dipartimento Legale IP, ti siederai all'avanguardia di questa rivoluzione digitale. In questo ruolo pratico, si sarà direttamente redigere e perseguire le domande di brevetti, mentre la gestione al di fuori del consiglio e la definizione della strategia globale di brevetto, sviluppo del portafoglio e mitigazione del rischio per gli ecosistemi di Patologia Digitale di nuova generazione di Roche.

L'opportunità:
In questo ruolo, servirai come consulente legale e tecnico strategico per R&D, scienza dei dati, ingegneria del software e team di sviluppo aziendale, catturando e proteggendo direttamente le invenzioni nella diagnostica computazionale.

• Redazione di applicazioni di primo piano: Direttamente la stesura di applicazioni di brevetti statunitensi e internazionali di alta qualità che coprono modelli di visione del computer core, flussi di lavoro di AI agentic, pipeline di biologia spaziale e algoritmi di bioinformatica di livello clinico.

• Hands-on Patent Prosecution: Direttamente preparare e presentare le risposte alle Azioni di Office, condurre le interviste di esaminatore e le strategie di esecuzione steer prima dell'USPTO e degli uffici di brevetti stranieri per garantire rivendicazioni ampie e applicabili per le architetture di software per la salute digitale.

• Gestione dei Consulenti Esterni: selezionare, dirigere e gestire un consulente legale esterno per la redazione di overflow, la prosecuzione globale e progetti di portafoglio specializzati per garantire precisione tecnica, efficienza dei costi e allineamento con la strategia IP di Roche.

• Gestione strategica del portafoglio: formulare ed eseguire robuste strategie IP globali che coprono reti neurali di apprendimento profondo, algoritmi diagnostici proprietari e motori di fusione diagnostici multimodali.

• Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) & Risk Assessment: analisi complesse di condotta, recensioni paesaggistiche, valutazioni di validità e studi di brevettabilità specificatamente su misura per l'integrazione di software open source e le infrastrutture sanitarie digitali cloud-native.

• IP Harvesting & R&D Integration: Partner direttamente con ingegneri software, ricercatori di machine learning e patologi per raccogliere sistematicamente invenzioni derivanti da modelli di fondazione, segmentazione delle immagini e analisi quantitativa dei biomarcatori.

Chi sei?

• Sei un professionista IP strategico e pratico che prospera all'intersezione di modelli algoritmici complessi e patologia diagnostica avanzata dei tessuti.

• Esperienza: 3–7+ anni di esperienza dedicata nella stesura di brevetti, persecuzione, strategia di portafoglio e consulenza legale focalizzata su software, intelligenza artificiale, machine learning e/o biologia computazionale.

• Credenziali: Registrato alla pratica prima dell'Ufficio brevetti e marchi degli Stati Uniti (USPTO) come agente di brevetto o avvocato di brevetto. I candidati del Procuratore devono possedere una licenza attiva in buona posizione con almeno una barra di stato degli Stati Uniti.

• Istruzione: B.S. richiesto; laurea avanzata (M.S. o Ph.D.) in Informatica, Bioinformatica, Biologia computazionale, Ingegneria elettrica, Matematica, Fisica, Bioingegneria, o un campo quantitativo strettamente correlato è un plus.

• Mastery Tecnico & Prosecuzione: Demonstrated track record di redazione personale e di esecuzione con successo di software complesso e richieste di brevetti AI, insieme alla familiarità con i quadri di apprendimento profondo, trascrizione spaziale / elaborazione dati Proteomics e strumenti di analisi dell'immagine automatizzati.

• Legale & An

Roche Diagnostics repousse les limites de la médecine de précision en convergeant le diagnostic tissulaire avec l'intelligence artificielle de pointe, la vision informatique et les flux de travail en biologie spatiale. En tant que conseiller en propriété intellectuelle ou agent de brevets enregistré au sein de notre service juridique en propriété intellectuelle, vous serez à l'avant-garde de cette révolution numérique. Dans ce rôle pratique, vous rédigerez et poursuivrez directement les demandes de brevet tout en gérant des conseils extérieurs et en façonnant la stratégie mondiale en matière de brevets, le développement de portefeuilles et l'atténuation des risques pour les écosystèmes de la prochaine génération de Roche.

La possibilité :
Dans ce rôle, vous serez un conseiller juridique et technique stratégique auprès des équipes de R-D, de sciences des données, d'ingénierie logicielle et de développement des entreprises, captant et protégeant directement les inventions dans les diagnostics informatiques.

• Élaboration d'une demande de premier principe : Rédiger directement des demandes de brevet américaines et internationales de haute qualité couvrant des modèles de vision informatique de base, des flux de travail sur l'IA, des pipelines de biologie spatiale et des algorithmes de bioinformatique de qualité clinique.

• Poursuite pratique en matière de brevets : Préparer et déposer directement les réponses aux actions de l'Office, mener des entrevues d'examinateurs et orienter les stratégies de poursuite devant l'USPTO et les offices de brevets étrangers pour obtenir des revendications générales et exécutoires pour les architectures de logiciels de santé numériques.

• Gestion externe des conseils : Choisir, diriger et gérer des conseils juridiques externes pour la rédaction d'un trop-plein, les poursuites à l'échelle mondiale et les projets de portefeuille spécialisés afin d'assurer la précision technique, la rentabilité et l'alignement sur la stratégie globale de la PI de Roche.

• IP Harvesting & R&D Integration: S'associer directement aux ingénieurs en logiciels, aux chercheurs en apprentissage automatique et aux pathologistes pour récolter systématiquement les inventions issues des modèles de fondation, de la segmentation des images et de l'analyse quantitative des biomarqueurs.

Qui vous êtes :

• Vous êtes un professionnel de l'IP stratégique et pratique qui prospère à l'intersection de modèles algorithmiques complexes et d'une pathologie avancée de diagnostic tissulaire.

The Patient Insights Software Chapter, within the Architecture and Software Engineering global function, aims to leverage software engineering as a competitive advantage for Roche, empowering patients and healthcare professionals to deliver better care.

Ti troverai qui, nel cuore di Vienna, non importa se lavori su mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® o qualsiasi altro prodotto o soluzione Roche. Potete leggere di più sulla storia di mySugr & Roche qui .

Ecco cosa stiamo cercando:

Il Customer Insights Software Chapter, all'interno della funzione globale di Architettura e Software Engineering, mira a sfruttare l'ingegneria del software come vantaggio competitivo per Roche, consentendo ai pazienti e ai professionisti sanitari di fornire una migliore assistenza.

Siamo alla ricerca di un Delivery Manager per guidare ed elevare la consegna del software attraverso la nostra organizzazione di gestione delle malattie Centrota dei pazienti. Come pietra angolare del nostro ecosistema digitale, questa linea di prodotti presenta una soluzione innovativa e leader di mercato che mira a supportare le persone con diabete attraverso una gestione quotidiana senza soluzione di continuità.

Come Delivery Manager, si guida e prendere la proprietà della consegna del prodotto all'interno di Ingegneria . Questo è un ruolo operativamente pratico focalizzato sulle best practice ingegneristiche, standard di tooling, conformità normativa, gestione del progetto e leadership agile scalata. Sei l'orchestratore con un unico obiettivo: garantire una consegna efficace ed efficiente del prodotto, all'interno del budget e con il livello atteso di qualità del prodotto, sfruttando attivamente gli strumenti di analisi e AI-enabled per migliorare la prevedibilità, le prestazioni e l'efficacia del modello operativo in scala.

Se siete appassionati di fornitura di software agile, un leader di persone forti, un comunicatore empatico, un giocatore di squadra e entusiasta di contribuire a costruire un ecosistema di consegna potenziato dall'IA, questo ruolo è per voi.

Le tue responsabilità

1. Leadership di consegna e coordinamento

• Allineamento del disco, supporto decisionale e garantire che il team distribuisca il valore in modo efficace, nel tempo, nel budget e con il livello atteso di qualità del prodotto.

• Mantenere il Piano di Consegna come un'unica fonte di verità auto-aggiornamento per la consegna dei prodotti, coordinando tra le parti interessate interfunzionali per gestire pietre miliari, dipendenze, percorsi di esecuzione chiari e blocchi di indirizzi.

• Proattivamente mappare le dipendenze trasversali, monitorare i rischi tecnici/di consegna e rendere visibili gli impedimenti per risolverli in anticipo, sfruttando le previsioni AI-powered.

• Superare il processo di rilascio, la priorità backlog, le esigenze di integrazione e il flusso end-to-end di valore attraverso la piattaforma per consentire la consegna prevedibile, sostenibile e ad alto rendimento.

• Facilitate le cerimonie chiave (PPI Plannings, Demos, Inspect & Adapt, Refinements, Syncs and Retrospectives) assicurando che il team mantieni l'allineamento e la messa a fuoco su priorità chiare.

• Controllare il bilancio assegnato per informare la pianificazione delle capacità e la progettazione organizzativa. Adatta dinamicamente le topologie del team alle esigenze in evoluzione per garantire efficienza e stabilire il modello operativo ottimale per il successo del prodotto.

• Sostenere la disponibilità di audit generale e il coordinamento interfunzionale, assicurando che le pietre miliari di consegna naturalmente allineano con gli standard organizzativi e liberare guardrails.

2. Modi di lavoro e miglioramento continuo

• Sostenere l'evoluzione di ruoli, cerimonie, processi e strumenti per ridurre la complessità, eliminare i rifiuti e armonizzare i modi di lavoro per rendere il lavoro quotidiano più facile per le squadre.

• Miglioramento continuo attraverso l'identificazione di inefficienze sistemiche attraverso informazioni basate sui dati e analisi automatizzate, tra cui l'ottimizzazione dei processi abilitata all'intelligenza artificiale.

• Promuovere pratiche ingegneristiche robuste che naturalmente incorporano guardrails di qualità, la consapevolezza della sicurezza informatica e la documentazione tecnica direttamente in continuo integrazione e consegna (CI/CD).

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen! Durch die Kombination unserer einzigartigen Stärken definieren wir das Gesundheitswesen durch nachhaltiges Handeln und Innovation neu. Für einen Blick hinter die Kulissen, schauen Sie sich dieses Video an, um zu sehen, wie wir bei Roche personalisierte Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lassen.

Die mySugr GmbH wurde 2017 von Roche übernommen und unser Büro in Wien ist einer der globalen Standorte von Roche. Sie befinden sich hier im Herzen von Wien, egal ob Sie an einem mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® oder einem anderen Roche Produkt oder einer anderen Lösung arbeiten. Mehr über die Geschichte von mySugr & Roche erfahren Sie hier.

Hier ist, was wir suchen:

Das „Patient Insights Software Chapter innerhalb der globalen Funktion Architecture and Software Engineering zielt darauf ab, Software Engineering als Wettbewerbsvorteil für Roche zu nutzen und Patienten und medizinisches Fachpersonal in die Lage zu versetzen, eine bessere Versorgung zu liefern.

Wir suchen einen Delivery Manager, der die Softwarebereitstellung in unserer Organisation für patientenzentriertes Krankheitsmanagement leitet und verbessert. Als Eckpfeiler unseres digitalen Ökosystems bietet diese Produktlinie eine innovative, marktführende Lösung, die Menschen mit Diabetes durch ein nahtloses, alltägliches Management unterstützt.

Als Delivery Manager führen und übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für Product Delivery im Engineering. Dies ist eine operative Rolle, die sich auf Best Practices für das Engineering, Tooling-Standards, Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften, Projektmanagement und skalierte agile Führung konzentriert. Sie sind der Orchestrator mit einem einzigen Ziel: eine effektive und effiziente Produktbereitstellung innerhalb des Budgets und mit der erwarteten Produktqualität zu gewährleisten, während Sie Analysen und KI-fähige Tools aktiv nutzen, um die Vorhersagbarkeit, Leistung und die Effektivität des Betriebsmodells in großem Maßstab zu verbessern.

Wenn Sie sich für agile Software-Bereitstellung, eine starke Führungskraft, einen empathischen Kommunikator, einen Teamplayer interessieren und sich freuen, beim Aufbau eines KI-erweiterten Bereitstellungs-Ökosystems mitzuwirken, ist diese Rolle für Sie.

Ihre Aufgaben

1. Delivery Leadership & Koordination

• Lenken Sie die Ausrichtung, unterstützen Sie die Entscheidungsfindung und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Team effektiv, pünktlich, innerhalb des Budgets und mit der erwarteten Produktqualität Wert liefert.

• Pflegen Sie den Lieferplan als selbstaktualisierende Single Source of Truth für die Produktlieferung und koordinieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder, um Meilensteine, Abhängigkeiten, klare Ausführungspfade und Adressblocker zu verwalten.

• Planen Sie proaktiv teamübergreifende Abhängigkeiten, überwachen Sie technische / Lieferrisiken und machen Sie Hindernisse sichtbar, um sie frühzeitig zu beheben, indem Sie KI-gestützte Prognosen nutzen.

• Überwachen Sie den Release-Prozess, die Backlog-Priorisierung, die Integrationsanforderungen und den End-to-End-Wertfluss auf der gesamten Plattform, um eine vorhersehbare, nachhaltige und leistungsstarke Lieferung zu ermöglichen.

• Ermöglichen Sie wichtige Zeremonien (PI-Planungen, Demos, Inspect & Adapt, Refinements, Syncs und Retrospektiven), um sicherzustellen, dass das Team sich auf klare Prioritäten konzentriert.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie das zugewiesene Budget, um die Kapazitätsplanung und die Organisationsgestaltung zu informieren. Teamtopologien dynamisch an sich verändernde Anforderungen anpassen, um Effizienz zu gewährleisten und das optimale Betriebsmodell für den Produkterfolg zu etablieren.

• Unterstützung der allgemeinen Auditbereitschaft und der funktionsübergreifenden Koordination, um sicherzustellen, dass Liefermeilensteine auf natürliche Weise mit den organisatorischen Standards übereinstimmen und Leitplanken freigeben.

2. Arbeitsweise und kontinuierliche Verbesserung

• Unterstützen Sie die Entwicklung von Rollen, Zeremonien, Prozessen und Tools, um Komplexität zu reduzieren, Verschwendung zu vermeiden und Arbeitsmethoden zu harmonisieren, um die tägliche Arbeit für Teams zu erleichtern.

• Steigern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen durch die Identifizierung systemischer Ineffizienzen durch datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse und automatisierte Analysen, einschließlich KI-fähiger Prozessoptimierung.

• Förderung robuster Engineering-Praktiken, die auf natürliche Weise Qualitätsleitplanken, Cybersicherheitsbewusstsein und technische Dokumentation direkt in Continuous Integration and Delivery (CI/CD)-Pipelines einbetten.

• Zusammenarbeit mit anderen RTEs in der gesamten Organisation zu teilen und nutzen Lernen, st
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Laissez-les construire un avenir plus sain, ensemble! En combinant nos forces uniques, nous redéfinissons les soins de santé par une action durable et l'innovation. Pour un look en coulisses, regardez cette vidéo pour voir comment nous, à Roche, faisons des soins de santé personnalisés une réalité.

La mySugr GmbH a été acquise par Roche en 2017 et notre bureau de Vienne est l'un des sites mondiaux de Roche. Vous serez situé ici, au cœur de Vienne, peu importe si vous travaillez sur un mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® ou tout autre produit ou solution Roche. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur l'histoire de mySugr & Roche ici.

Voici ce que nous cherchons :

Le chapitre du logiciel Patient Insights, dans le cadre de la fonction mondiale Architecture et génie logiciel, vise à tirer parti de l'ingénierie logicielle comme avantage concurrentiel pour Roche, donnant aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé les moyens de fournir de meilleurs soins.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de la prestation pour diriger et améliorer la prestation de logiciels dans notre organisation de gestion des maladies centrées sur le patient. En tant que pierre angulaire de notre écosystème numérique, cette gamme de produits propose une solution innovante, leader sur le marché, qui vise à soutenir les personnes diabétiques par une gestion transparente et quotidienne.

En tant que gestionnaire de livraison, vous dirigez et prenez en charge la livraison de produits au sein de Engineering . Il s'agit d'un rôle opérationnel axé sur les pratiques exemplaires en génie, les normes d'outillage, la conformité à la réglementation, la gestion de projet et le leadership agile à grande échelle. Vous êtes l'orchestreur avec un seul objectif : assurer une livraison efficace et efficiente des produits, dans les limites du budget et avec le niveau attendu de qualité des produits tout en exploitant activement les outils d'analyse et d'IA pour améliorer la prévisibilité, la performance et l'efficacité des modèles d'exploitation à l'échelle.

Si vous êtes passionné par la livraison de logiciels agiles, un leader de personnes fortes, un communicateur empathique, un joueur d'équipe et excité d'aider à construire un écosystème de livraison augmenté par l'IA, ce rôle est pour vous.

Vos responsabilités

1. Leadership et coordination de l'exécution

• Diriger l'alignement, appuyer la prise de décisions et s'assurer que l'équipe offre de la valeur efficacement, dans les délais, dans les limites du budget et du niveau prévu de qualité du produit.

• Maintenir le plan de livraison comme source unique de vérité auto-mise à jour pour la livraison des produits, coordonner les intervenants interfonctionnels pour gérer les étapes, les dépendances, les voies d'exécution claires et les bloqueurs d'adresses.

• Cartographier proactivement les dépendances entre les équipes, surveiller les risques techniques et de livraison et rendre visibles les obstacles pour les résoudre rapidement, en tirant parti des prévisions alimentées par l'IA.

• Superviser le processus de publication, la hiérarchisation des arriérés, les besoins d'intégration et le flux de valeur de bout en bout dans la plate-forme pour permettre une prestation prévisible, durable et performante.

• Faciliter les cérémonies clés (planifications d'IP, démos, inspection et adaptation, raffinements, synthèses et rétrospectives) en veillant à ce que l'équipe maintienne l'alignement et se concentre sur des priorités claires.

• Superviser le budget alloué pour éclairer la planification des capacités et la conception organisationnelle. Adapter dynamiquement les topologies de l'équipe à l'évolution des besoins pour assurer l'efficacité et établir le modèle d'exploitation optimal pour la réussite des produits.

• Appuyer l'état de préparation de la vérification et la coordination interfonctionnelle, en veillant à ce que les étapes d'exécution soient naturellement conformes aux normes organisationnelles et à ce que les garde-corps soient libérés.

2. Méthodes de travail et amélioration continue

• Appuyer l'évolution des rôles, des cérémonies, des processus et des outils pour réduire la complexité, éliminer les gaspillages et harmoniser les méthodes de travail pour faciliter le travail quotidien des équipes.

• Diriger l'amélioration continue en identifiant les inefficacités systémiques grâce à des informations basées sur les données et à des analyses automatisées, y compris l'optimisation des processus grâce à l'IA.

• Promouvoir des pratiques d'ingénierie robustes qui intègrent naturellement les garde-corps de qualité, la sensibilisation à la cybersécurité et la documentation technique directement dans les pipelines d'intégration et de livraison continues (CI/CD).

• Collaborer avec d'autres ETP de l'ensemble de l'organisation pour partager et tirer parti des apprentissages

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position title: Analytics & Intelligence - Lead / Senior Analyst (Medical Analytics)
Roche India - Roche Services and Solutions
Reports to: Analytics & Intelligence – Manager
Location: Hyderabad & Chennai

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. As a Senior Analyst – Medical Analytics, you will collaborate closely with Field analytics & Insights - Medical, U.S. Medical Affairs (USMA) teams. You will play a key role in enabling data-driven medical strategy and enhancing patient outcomes through advanced analytics.

Your Opportunity

• Lead complex analytics initiatives supporting Medical Affairs across areas such as real-world data analysis, patient outcomes, treatment pathways, pre & post launch tracking, customer list generation and disease progression

• Partner with Field Medical and Medical Networks teams to generate insights from HCP/KOL engagement data, enabling optimization of medical strategies and field effectiveness

• Develop and implement scalable data pipelines, automation solutions, and analytical frameworks to process and analyze large healthcare datasets

• Work on analytics use cases spanning HEOR, medical impact assessment, patient journey analytics, and health equity research

• Leverage diverse datasets such as claims, EHR/EMR, clinical trial data, and interaction data (MSL/HCP engagements) to derive actionable insights

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate scientific and business questions into analytical solutions and deliver high-quality outputs

• Create clear and impactful presentations to communicate complex clinical and scientific insights to stakeholders

• Act as a thought partner by delivering high-quality, scientifically grounded analytics solutions and recommendations

• Manage end-to-end project delivery, ensuring quality, timeliness, and stakeholder alignment

• Work across global teams and time zones to support business needs

• Mentor junior team members and contribute to capability building within the team

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in Technology, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine, Biostatistics, or a related discipline, with 4–8 years of analytics/consulting experience, including 2–5 years in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics. A Master’s degree is an added advantage

• Strong experience in Medical Analytics, real-world data analysis, clinical analytics, or outcomes research

• Hands-on experience working with healthcare datasets such as claims, EHR/EMR, clinical trials, and field medical interaction data

• Good understanding of U.S. Medical Affairs ecosystem, including Field Medical, Medical Networks, and Scientific Operations

• Proficiency in SQL and Excel, along with strong programming skills in Python, R, or SAS

• Experience in building data pipelines, automation workflows, and scalable analytical solutions

• Strong understanding of statistical techniques, data modelling, and analytical problem-solving

• Exposure to therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, neurology, etc., is preferred

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ab

Roche India - Roche Services and Solutions

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate scientific and business questions into analytical solutions and deliver high-quality outputs

• Act as a thought partner by delivering high-quality, scientifically grounded analytics solutions and recommendations

• Work across global teams and time zones to support business needs

• Mentor junior team members and contribute to capability building within the team

Who you are

• Strong experience in Medical Analytics, real-world data analysis, clinical analytics, or outcomes research

• Hands-on experience working with healthcare datasets such as claims, EHR/EMR, clinical trials, and field medical interaction data

• Good understanding of U.S. Medical Affairs ecosystem, including Field Medical, Medical Networks, and Scientific Operations

• Proficiency in SQL and Excel, along with strong programming skills in Python, R, or SAS

• Experience in building data pipelines, automation workflows, and scalable analytical solutions

• Strong understanding of statistical techniques, data modelling, and analytical problem-solving

• Exposure to therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, neurology, etc., is preferred

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ab

• Translates customers’ defined business/technical and personal goals into internal action while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Balances the need to advocate for customers while also demonstrating the drive and ability to negotiate and achieve strong business results for Roche

• Develops territory-specific executional strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Conducts system demonstrations & presentations where applicable; POC Committee Meetings, Trade Shows, VIPS, etc.

Who you are

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Demonstrates strong oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Preferred experience in the Point of Care diagnostic and Integrated Health Network space.
